33: type CoverVisibleCallback = () => void;
34: const coverListeners = new Map<Element, CoverVisibleCallback>();
35: let sharedCoverObserver: IntersectionObserver | null = null;
36: 
37: function getSharedCoverObserver(): IntersectionObserver | null {
38:   if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return null;
39:   if (!sharedCoverObserver) {
40:     sharedCoverObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
41:       (entries) => {
42:         for (const entry of entries) {
43:           if (entry.isIntersecting) {
44:             const cb = coverListeners.get(entry.target);
45:             if (cb) {
46:               coverListeners.delete(entry.target);
47:               sharedCoverObserver?.unobserve(entry.target);
48:               cb();
49:             }
50:           }
51:         }
52:       },
53:       { rootMargin: '100px 0px' },
54:     );
55:   }
56:   return sharedCoverObserver;

59: export function observeCoverVisibility(

61:   callback: CoverVisibleCallback,
62: ): () => void {
63:   const observer = getSharedCoverObserver();
64:   if (!observer) {
65:     callback();
66:     return () => {};
67:   }
68:   coverListeners.set(el, callback);
69:   observer.observe(el);
70:   return () => {

3: export function formatAddedDate(timestamp?: number): string {
4:   if (!timestamp) return '';
5:   const d = new Date(timestamp);
6:   if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
7:   const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
8:   const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
9:   const year = d.getFullYear();
10:   return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
11: }
12: 
13: export function formatWholeDate(timestamp?: number): string {
14:   if (!timestamp) return '';
15:   const d = new Date(timestamp);
16:   if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
17:   return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
18:     weekday: 'long',
19:     year: 'numeric',
20:     month: 'long',
21:     day: 'numeric',
22:   });
23: }

6:   library: readonly Summary[],
7:   shelfSort: Settings['shelfSort'] = 'recent',
8: ): Summary[] {
9:   return [...library].sort((a, b) => {
10:     const byTitle = shelfCollator.compare(a.title, b.title);
11:     return (
12:       (shelfSort === 'title'
13:         ? byTitle

18:               a.chaptersRead / Math.max(1, a.chapterCount)
19:             : b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt) ||
20:       byTitle ||
21:       shelfCollator.compare(a.id, b.id)
22:     );
23:   });

193:   if (!p.path) throw new Error('Desktop page is missing path');
194:   assertPathLimits(p.path);
195:   if (m.localPath || desktopAPI.resolvePath) {
196:     const sep = m.localPath?.includes('\\') ? '\\' : '/';
197:     const fallbackPath = m.localPath
198:       ? `${m.localPath.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '')}${sep}${p.path.split('/').join(sep)}`
199:       : p.path;
200:     const resolvedPath = desktopAPI.resolvePath
201:       ? await desktopAPI.resolvePath(m.id, p.path, m.localPath)
202:       : fallbackPath;
203:     const buffer = await withinTime(
204:       desktopAPI.readFile(resolvedPath),
205:       limits.ioTimeoutMs,
206:       'Reading file',
207:     );
208:     if (!buffer) throw new Error(`Could not read desktop file at: ${resolvedPath}`);
209:     return new File([buffer], p.name || p.path.split('/').at(-1) || 'image.webp');
210:   }
211:   const f = sessionFiles.get(m.id)?.get(p.path);
212:   if (f) {
213:     return withinTime(
214:       f instanceof File ? Promise.resolve(f) : f.getFile(),
215:       limits.ioTimeoutMs,
216:       'Reading file',
217:     );
218:   }
219:   throw new Error('Desktop manga is missing localPath');
220: }

222: export async function access(
223:   manga: Pick<Manga, 'id' | 'localPath'>,
224:   request = false,
225: ): Promise<boolean> {
226:   if (!manga) return false;
227:   if (sessionFiles.has(manga.id)) return true;
228: 
229:   const now = Date.now();
230:   if (!request) {
231:     const cached = accessCache.get(manga.id);
232:     if (cached && now < cached.expiresAt) {
233:       return cached.granted;
234:     }
235:     const inflight = accessInFlight.get(manga.id);
236:     if (inflight) return inflight;
237:   } else {
238:     accessInFlight.delete(manga.id);
239:   }
240: 
241:   const task = (async () => {
242:     try {
243:       const granted = desktopAPI.checkAccess
244:         ? await desktopAPI.checkAccess(manga.id, manga.localPath)
245:         : Boolean(manga.localPath);
246: 
247:       const finishNow = Date.now();
248:       accessCache.set(manga.id, {
249:         expiresAt: finishNow + ACCESS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
250:         timestamp: finishNow,
251:         granted,
252:       });
253:       return granted;
254:     } catch {
255:       const finishNow = Date.now();
256:       accessCache.set(manga.id, {
257:         expiresAt: finishNow + ACCESS_CACHE_TTL_MS,
258:         timestamp: finishNow,
259:         granted: false,
260:       });
261:       return false;
262:     } finally {
263:       accessInFlight.delete(manga.id);
264:     }
265:   })();
266: 
267:   if (!request) {
268:     accessInFlight.set(manga.id, task);
269:   }
270:   return task;
271: }

=== FILE: C:\Users\VKPs\Documents\manga-reader\src\reader-tsx\pageStore.ts ===
1: export interface PageStore {
2:   getPage: () => number;
3:   setPage: (page: number) => void;
4:   subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
5: }
6: 
7: export function createPageStore(initialPage = 0): PageStore {
8:   let current = initialPage;
9:   const listeners = new Set<() => void>();
10:   return {
11:     getPage: () => current,
12:     setPage: (page: number) => {
13:       if (current === page) return;
14:       current = page;
15:       for (const listener of listeners) {
16:         listener();
17:       }
18:     },
19:     subscribe: (listener: () => void) => {
20:       listeners.add(listener);
21:       return () => listeners.delete(listener);
22:     },
23:   };
24: }

3: export function parseFsError(err: unknown): FsErrorPayload | null {
4:   if (err && typeof err === 'object') {
5:     if ('code' in err && typeof (err as any).code === 'string') {
6:       return err as FsErrorPayload;
7:     }
8:   }
9:   if (typeof err === 'string') {
10:     try {
11:       const parsed = JSON.parse(err);
12:       if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'code' in parsed) {
13:         return parsed as FsErrorPayload;
14:       }
15:     } catch {
16:       // not JSON
17:     }
18:   }
19:   return null;
20: }
21: 
22: export function parseTauriError(err: unknown): TauriErrorPayload {
23:   const fsErr = parseFsError(err);
24:   if (fsErr) return fsErr;
25:   if (err && typeof err === 'object' && 'code' in err && typeof (err as any).code === 'string') {
26:     return err as DbErrorPayload;
27:   }
28:   if (typeof err === 'string') {
29:     try {
30:       const parsed = JSON.parse(err);
31:       if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'code' in parsed) {
32:         return parsed as DbErrorPayload;
33:       }
34:     } catch {
35:       // not JSON
36:     }
37:     return { code: 'Unknown', message: err };
38:   }
39:   if (err instanceof Error) {
40:     return { code: 'Unknown', message: err.message };
41:   }
42:   return { code: 'Unknown', message: String(err) };
43: }

14: ): Promise<{ width: number; height: number }> {
15:   const url = URL.createObjectURL(f);
16:   try {
17:     return await new Promise<{ width: number; height: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
18:       const im = new Image();
19:       let settled = false;
20:       const finish = (error?: Error) => {
21:         if (settled) return;
22:         settled = true;
23:         clearTimeout(timer);
24:         signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);

26:         im.onerror = null;

28:           if (error) reject(error);
29:           else {

32:           }
33:         } catch (e) {
34:           reject(e);
35:         } finally {
36:           im.src = '';
37:         }
38:       };

42:         limits.imageTimeoutMs,

45:       im.onload = () => finish();

17: export async function listFolder(
18:   folderPath: string,
19:   options?: ListFolderOptions,
20: ): Promise<FolderEntry[]> {
21:   let unlisten: (() => void) | undefined;
22:   const scanId =
23:     options?.scanId ??
24:     (options?.signal || options?.onProgress
25:       ? `scan-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`
26:       : undefined);
27: 
28:   let abortHandler: (() => void) | undefined;
29:   if (options?.signal && scanId) {
30:     if (options.signal.aborted) {
31:       throw new DOMException('The operation was aborted', 'AbortError');
32:     }
33:     abortHandler = () => {
34:       void cancelScan(scanId);
35:     };
36:     options.signal.addEventListener('abort', abortHandler, { once: true });
37:   }
38: 
39:   try {
40:     if (options?.onProgress && isTauri) {
41:       try {
42:         unlisten = await listen<ScanProgress>('scan-progress', (event) => {
43:           if (!scanId || event.payload.scanId === scanId) {
44:             options.onProgress?.(event.payload);
45:           }
46:         });
47:       } catch (err) {
48:         console.warn('Tauri scan-progress listen failed:', err);
49:       }
50:     }
51: 
52:     return await invokeCommand('list_folder', { folderPath, scanId });
53:   } catch (err) {
54:     const fsErr = parseFsError(err);
55:     if (fsErr?.code === 'Cancelled') {
56:       throw new DOMException('The operation was aborted', 'AbortError');
57:     }
58:     console.error('Tauri listFolder failed:', fsErr ?? err);
59:     return [];
60:   } finally {
61:     if (abortHandler && options?.signal) {
62:       options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
63:     }
64:     unlisten?.();
65:   }
66: }

204: export function convertFileSrc(filePath: string, protocol = 'mangaimg'): string {
205:   if (typeof tauriConvertFileSrc === 'function' && isTauri) {
206:     try {
207:       return tauriConvertFileSrc(filePath, protocol);
208:     } catch {
209:       // fallback below
210:     }
211:   }
212:   const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
213:   const isWindowsDrive = /^([a-zA-Z]):/.test(normalized);
214:   const drivePrefix = isWindowsDrive ? normalized.slice(0, 1) + '%3A' : '';
215:   const rest = isWindowsDrive
216:     ? normalized.slice(2).replace(/^\/+/, '')
217:     : normalized.replace(/^\/+/, '');
218:   const segments = rest.split('/').filter(Boolean);
219:   const encoded = segments.map((s) => encodeURIComponent(s)).join('/');
220:   const cleanPath = drivePrefix ? drivePrefix + '/' + encoded : encoded;
221:   return `http://${protocol}.localhost/${cleanPath}`;
222: }

24: export async function getHeaderDimensions(
25:   file: File,
26: ): Promise<{ width: number; height: number } | undefined> {
27:   try {
28:     const cacheKey = `${file.name}:${file.size}:${file.lastModified}`;
29:     const buffer = await withinTime(
30:       file.slice(0, limits.headerBytes).arrayBuffer(),
31:       limits.ioTimeoutMs,
32:       'Reading image header',
33:     );
34:     const res = await invoke<{ width: number; height: number } | null>(
35:       'get_header_dimensions',
36:       new Uint8Array(buffer),
37:       {
38:         headers: {
39:           'x-cache-key': encodeURIComponent(cacheKey),
40:         },
41:       },
42:     );
43:     if (res && res.width > 0 && res.height > 0) {
44:       assertImageDimensions(res.width, res.height);
45:       return res;
46:     }
47:     return undefined;
48:   } catch {
49:     return undefined;
50:   }

82:   file: File,
83:   quality = 0.65,
84:   signal?: AbortSignal,

87:   const buffer = await withinTime(

89:     limits.ioTimeoutMs,

100:     limits.coverTimeoutMs,
101:     'Encoding cover',
102:     signal,
103:   );

105:     res instanceof ArrayBuffer

12: export async function indexTitle(
13:   root: string,
14:   options?: IndexTitleOptions,
15:   onProgress?: (progress: IndexScanProgress) => void,
16: ): Promise<IndexTitleDto> {
17:   const channel = new Channel<IndexScanProgress>();
18:   const jobId =
19:     options?.jobId ??
20:     (options?.signal ? `index-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}` : undefined);
21: 
22:   let abortHandler: (() => void) | undefined;
23:   if (options?.signal && jobId) {
24:     if (options.signal.aborted) {
25:       throw new DOMException('The operation was aborted', 'AbortError');
26:     }
27:     abortHandler = () => {
28:       void cancelScan(jobId);
29:     };
30:     options.signal.addEventListener('abort', abortHandler, { once: true });
31:   }
32: 
33:   if (onProgress) {
34:     channel.onmessage = (progress) => {
35:       if (options?.signal?.aborted) {
36:         if (jobId) void cancelScan(jobId);
37:         return;
38:       }
39:       onProgress(progress);
40:     };
41:   }
42: 
43:   try {
44:     return await invokeCommand('index_title', {
45:       root,
46:       options: options
47:         ? {
48:             sort: options.sort,
49:             warmChapters: options.warmChapters,
50:             jobId,
51:             title: options.title,
52:             targetId: options.targetId ?? options.previous?.id,
53:             previous: options.previous
54:               ? {
55:                   id: options.previous.id,
56:                   title: options.previous.title,
57:                   slug: options.previous.slug,
58:                   lastChapter: options.previous.lastChapter,
59:                   addedAt: options.previous.addedAt,
60:                   revision: options.previous.revision,
61:                   chapters: options.previous.chapters.map((c) => ({
62:                     name: c.name,
63:                     read: c.read,
64:                     position: c.position,
65:                     bookmarks: c.bookmarks,
66:                     pages: c.pages.map((p) => ({
67:                       name: p.name,
68:                       path: p.path,
69:                       width: p.width,
70:                       height: p.height,
71:                       size: p.size,
72:                       modified: p.modified,
73:                       dimensionsPending: p.dimensionsPending,
74:                     })),
75:                   })),
76:                 }
77:               : undefined,
78:           }
79:         : undefined,
80:       onProgress: channel,
81:     } as any);
82:   } catch (err) {
83:     const fsErr = parseFsError(err);
84:     if (
85:       fsErr?.code === 'Cancelled' ||
86:       (typeof err === 'string' && err.includes('Indexing cancelled')) ||
87:       (err instanceof Error && err.message.includes('Indexing cancelled'))
88:     ) {
89:       throw new DOMException('The operation was aborted', 'AbortError');
90:     }
91:     throw err;
92:   } finally {
93:     if (abortHandler && options?.signal) {
94:       options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
95:     }
96:   }
97: }

3: export function getPageImageUrl(options: PageImageResourceOptions): string {
4:   const { mangaId, pagePath, version = 1, transform = 'full', localPath } = options;
5:   const encodedMangaId = encodeURIComponent(mangaId);
6:   const encodedVersion = encodeURIComponent(String(version));
7:   const encodedTransform = encodeURIComponent(transform);
8:   const normalizedPath = pagePath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/^\/+/, '');
9:   const segments = normalizedPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).map(encodeURIComponent);
10:   const encodedPagePath = segments.join('/');
11: 
12:   let url = `http://mangaimg.localhost/page/${encodedMangaId}/${encodedVersion}/${encodedTransform}/${encodedPagePath}`;
13:   if (localPath) {
14:     url += `?root=${encodeURIComponent(localPath)}`;
15:   }
16:   return url;
17: }
18: 
19: export function getCoverImageUrl(
20:   mangaId: string,
21:   version?: string | number,
22:   size?: number,
23: ): string {
24:   const encodedMangaId = encodeURIComponent(mangaId);
25:   const ver =
26:     version !== undefined && version !== null ? `/${encodeURIComponent(String(version))}` : '';
27:   const query = size ? `?size=${size}` : '';
28:   return `http://mangaimg.localhost/cover/${encodedMangaId}${ver}${query}`;
29: }

285:   async computeOffsets(
286:     pages: Array<Pick<Page, 'width' | 'height'>>,
287:     options: GeometryOptions,
288:     measuredHeights?: Record<number, number>,
289:   ): Promise<PageOffset[]> {
290:     const offsets: PageOffset[] = [];
291:     let currentTop = 0;
292:     const safeZoom = Math.max(0.1, options.zoom || 1);
293:     for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
294:       let height = measuredHeights?.[i];
295:       if (height === undefined || height <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(height)) {
296:         const p = pages[i];
297:         const nativeWidth = Math.max(1, p.width) * safeZoom;
298:         const aspect = Math.max(1, p.width) / Math.max(1, p.height);
299:         const readingW =
300:           options.maxWidth > 0 ? options.maxWidth * safeZoom : options.containerWidth;
301:         const targetW = Math.max(
302:           1,
303:           Math.round(Math.min(options.containerWidth, readingW, nativeWidth)),
304:         );
305:         height = Math.max(1, Math.round(targetW / aspect));
306:       }
307:       const bottom = currentTop + height;
308:       offsets.push({ page: i, top: currentTop, height, bottom });
309:       currentTop = bottom;
310:     }
311:     return offsets;
312:   }
313: 
314:   async getWindowRange(
315:     offsets: PageOffset[],
316:     _scrollY: number,
317:     _viewportHeight: number,
318:   ): Promise<WindowRange> {
319:     return {
320:       startIndex: 0,
321:       endIndex: Math.max(0, offsets.length - 1),
322:       topSpacer: 0,
323:       bottomSpacer: 0,
324:     };
325:   }

33:   if (typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function') return crypto.randomUUID();
34:   const b = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
35:   b[6] = (b[6]! & 0x0f) | 0x40;
36:   b[8] = (b[8]! & 0x3f) | 0x80;
37:   const h = Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
38:   return `${h.slice(0, 8)}-${h.slice(8, 12)}-${h.slice(12, 16)}-${h.slice(16, 20)}-${h.slice(20)}`;
39: }
40: 
41: const natural = new Intl.Collator(undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
42: const lexical = new Intl.Collator(undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' });
43: 
44: export function naturalOrder(a: string, b: string): number {
45:   const tokens = (s: string) =>
46:     s
47:       .normalize('NFC')
48:       .toLowerCase()
49:       .replace(/\b(chapter|ch)\.?\s*(?=\d)/g, 'ch ')
50:       .replace(/\b(volume|vol)\.?\s*(?=\d)/g, 'vol ')
51:       .match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?|[^\d]+/g) || [];
52:   const category = (s: string) =>
53:     /^(prologue|opening)\b/i.test(s) ? -1 : /^(extra|bonus|special|epilogue)\b/i.test(s) ? 1 : 0;
54:   const categoryDiff = category(a) - category(b);
55:   if (categoryDiff) return categoryDiff;
56:   const aa = tokens(a),
57:     bb = tokens(b);
58:   for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(aa.length, bb.length); i++) {
59:     const x = aa[i],
60:       y = bb[i],
61:       nx = Number(x),
62:       ny = Number(y);
63:     const both = x.trim() !== '' && y.trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(nx) && Number.isFinite(ny);
64:     const result = both ? nx - ny : natural.compare(x, y);
65:     if (result) return result;
66:   }
67:   return aa.length - bb.length || natural.compare(a, b);
68: }
69: 
70: export async function naturalSortPaths(paths: string[]): Promise<string[]> {
71:   if (paths.length <= 1) return paths;
72:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.naturalSortPaths) {
73:     return await desktopAPI.naturalSortPaths(paths);
74:   }
75:   return [...paths].sort(naturalOrder);
76: }

79:   path
80:     .split('/')
81:     .some(
82:       (p) =>
83:         p.startsWith('.') ||
84:         p === '__MACOSX' ||
85:         p.toLowerCase() === 'thumbs.db' ||
86:         p.toLowerCase() === 'desktop.ini',
87:     );

89: const tick = () => {
90:   const sched = (
91:     typeof globalThis !== 'undefined'
92:       ? (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>).scheduler
93:       : undefined
94:   ) as { yield?: () => Promise<void> } | undefined;
95:   return typeof sched?.yield === 'function'
96:     ? sched.yield()
97:     : new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, 0));
98: };

100: function getDecodeConcurrency(): number {
101:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && typeof navigator !== 'undefined') {
102:     const cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4;
103:     const mem = (navigator as unknown as { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory;
104:     if (cores >= 8 && (!mem || mem >= 8)) return 6;
105:     if (cores >= 4 && (!mem || mem >= 4)) return 4;
106:   }
107:   return limits.decodeConcurrency;
108: }

196: export function scanImage(entry: SourceFile, signal?: AbortSignal) {
197:   let task = scanned.get(entry);
198:   if (!task) {
199:     task = (async () => {
200:       alive(signal);
201:       const file = await readFile(entry);
202:       if (!file.size) throw new Error('Empty file.');
203:       const size = await dimensions(file, signal);
204:       alive(signal);
205:       return { file, ...size };
206:     })();
207:     scanned.set(entry, task);
208:     void task.catch(() => {
209:       if (scanned.get(entry) === task) scanned.delete(entry);
210:     });
211:   }
212:   return task;
213: }

215: export function discardScan(sources: Source[]) {
216:   for (const source of sources) for (const entry of source.files.values()) scanned.delete(entry);

219: export async function warmSources(
220:   sources: Source[],
221:   options: ScanOptions = {},
222:   sort: Manga['sort'] = 'natural',
223: ) {
224:   assertSourcesLimits(sources);
225:   for (const source of sources) {
226:     options.update?.({ phase: 'discover', done: source.files.size, total: 0, title: source.title });
227:     const compare =
228:       sort === 'name'
229:         ? lexical.compare
230:         : sort === 'reverse'
231:           ? (a: string, b: string) => naturalOrder(b, a)
232:           : naturalOrder;
233:     let chapterKeys = [...chapterGroups(source).keys()];
234:     if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.naturalSortPaths && sort !== 'name') {
235:       chapterKeys = await desktopAPI.naturalSortPaths(chapterKeys);
236:       if (sort === 'reverse') chapterKeys.reverse();
237:     } else {
238:       chapterKeys.sort(compare);
239:     }
240:     const chapters = new Set(chapterKeys.slice(0, limits.warmChapters));
241:     const entries = [...source.files].filter(([path, entry]) => {
242:       if (entry instanceof DesktopHandle && entry.width && entry.height) return false;
243:       return chapters.has(
244:         path.includes('/') ? path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join(' / ') : 'Root pages',
245:       );
246:     });
247:     await pooled(
248:       entries,
249:       async ([, entry]) => {
250:         try {
251:           await scanImage(entry, options.signal);
252:         } catch (e) {
253:           alive(options.signal);
254:           if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') {
255:             scanned.delete(entry);
256:             try {
257:               await scanImage(entry, options.signal);
258:             } catch {
259:               alive(options.signal);
260:             }
261:           }
262:         }
263:       },
264:       options.signal,
265:     );
266:   }
267: }

269: function assertSourceLimits(source: Source) {
270:   assertAtMost(source.files.size, limits.pagesPerTitle, 'Image candidates per title');
271:   for (const path of source.files.keys()) assertPathLimits(path);
272:   assertAtMost(chapterGroups(source).size, limits.chaptersPerTitle, 'Chapters per title');
273: }

275: function assertSourcesLimits(sources: Source[]) {
276:   assertAtMost(sources.length, limits.titles, 'Selected titles');
277:   let total = 0;
278:   for (const source of sources) {
279:     total += source.files.size;
280:     assertAtMost(total, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Selected image candidates');
281:     assertSourceLimits(source);
282:   }
283: }

285: async function* directoryEntries(dir: Directory, signal?: AbortSignal) {
286:   const iterator = dir.values();
287:   try {
288:     for (let count = 0; count <= limits.discoveryEntries; count++) {
289:       alive(signal);
290:       const result = await withinTime(
291:         iterator.next(),
292:         limits.ioTimeoutMs,
293:         'Reading folder',
294:         signal,
295:       );
296:       if (result.done) return;
297:       assertAtMost(count + 1, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Folder entries');
298:       yield result.value;
299:     }
300:   } finally {
301:     if (iterator.return)
302:       await withinTime(iterator.return(), limits.ioTimeoutMs, 'Closing folder iterator');
303:   }
304: }

306: export async function fromHandle(handle: Directory, options: ScanOptions = {}): Promise<Source> {
307:   if (typeof __DESKTOP_BUILD__ !== 'undefined' && __DESKTOP_BUILD__) {
308:     throw new Error('fromHandle is not supported in desktop builds');
309:   }
310:   const source: Source = { title: handle.name, handle, files: new Map(), issues: [] };
311:   let count = 0;
312:   const chapterNames = new Set<string>();
313:   const queue: SourceFile[] = [];
314:   const tasks = new Set<Promise<void>>();
315:   let discovered = 0;
316:   let active = 0;
317:   const pump = () => {
318:     while (active < getDecodeConcurrency() && queue.length && !options.signal?.aborted) {
319:       const entry = queue.shift()!;
320:       active++;
321:       const task = scanImage(entry, options.signal)
322:         .then(
323:           () => {},
324:           () => {},
325:         )
326:         .finally(() => {
327:           active--;
328:           tasks.delete(task);
329:           pump();
330:         });
331:       tasks.add(task);
332:     }
333:   };
334:   const add = async (path: string, entry: SourceFile) => {
335:     assertPathLimits(path);
336:     assertAtMost(
337:       source.files.size + (source.files.has(path) ? 0 : 1),
338:       limits.pagesPerTitle,
339:       'Image candidates per title',
340:     );
341:     source.files.set(path, entry);
342:     const chapter = path.includes('/') ? path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join(' / ') : 'Root pages';
343:     if (path.includes('/') || !/^(thumbnail|cover)\./i.test(path)) chapterNames.add(chapter);
344:     assertAtMost(chapterNames.size, limits.chaptersPerTitle, 'Chapters per title');
345:     if ([...chapterNames].sort(naturalOrder).slice(0, limits.warmChapters).includes(chapter)) {
346:       while (queue.length >= limits.queuedJobs) {
347:         alive(options.signal);
348:         await Promise.race(tasks);
349:       }
350:       alive(options.signal);
351:       queue.push(entry);
352:       pump();
353:     }
354:   };
355: 
356:   interface StackFrame {
357:     dir: Directory;
358:     prefix: string;
359:     depth: number;
360:   }
361:   const stack: StackFrame[] = [{ dir: handle, prefix: '', depth: 0 }];
362:   let lastYield = performance.now();
363: 
364:   try {
365:     while (stack.length > 0) {
366:       alive(options.signal);
367:       const { dir, prefix, depth } = stack.pop()!;
368:       if (depth > limits.directoryDepth) {
369:         source.issues.push({
370:           path: prefix,
371:           reason: `Folder nesting exceeds ${limits.directoryDepth} levels.`,
372:         });
373:         continue;
374:       }
375:       try {
376:         const entries: FileSystemHandle[] = [];
377:         for await (const entry of directoryEntries(dir, options.signal)) {
378:           alive(options.signal);
379:           assertAtMost(++discovered, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Discovered entries');
380:           assertAtMost(
381:             (prefix + entry.name).length,
382:             limits.pathChars,
383:             'Relative path length (characters)',
384:           );
385:           if (!ignored(prefix + entry.name)) entries.push(entry);
386:         }
387:         entries.sort((a, b) => naturalOrder(a.name, b.name));
388: 
389:         for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
390:           const entry = entries[i];
391:           const path = prefix + entry.name;
392:           if (entry.kind === 'directory') {
393:             stack.push({ dir: entry as Directory, prefix: path + '/', depth: depth + 1 });
394:           }
395:         }
396: 
397:         for (const entry of entries) {
398:           if (entry.kind === 'directory') continue;
399:           alive(options.signal);
400:           const path = prefix + entry.name;
401:           try {
402:             if (imageFile({ name: entry.name, type: '' }))
403:               await add(path, entry as FileSystemFileHandle);
404:             else {
405:               const file = await readFile(entry as FileSystemFileHandle);
406:               if (imageFile(file)) await add(path, entry as FileSystemFileHandle);
407:             }
408:           } catch (e) {
409:             alive(options.signal);
410:             if (e instanceof LimitError) throw e;
411:             source.issues.push({ path, reason: errorMessage(e) });
412:           }
413:           count++;
414:           const now = performance.now();
415:           if (count % 16 === 0 || now - lastYield >= 10) {
416:             lastYield = now;
417:             options.update?.({ phase: 'discover', done: count, total: 0, title: handle.name });
418:             await tick();
419:           }
420:         }
421:       } catch (e) {
422:         alive(options.signal);
423:         if (e instanceof LimitError) throw e;
424:         source.issues.push({ path: prefix || handle.name, reason: errorMessage(e) });
425:       }
426:     }
427: 
428:     while (active || queue.length) {
429:       alive(options.signal);
430:       await Promise.all(tasks);
431:     }
432:     await warmSources([source], options);
433:     alive(options.signal);
434:     options.update?.({ phase: 'discover', done: count, total: count, title: handle.name });
435:     return source;
436:   } catch (e) {
437:     queue.length = 0;
438:     await Promise.all(tasks);
439:     discardScan([source]);
440:     throw e;
441:   }
442: }

444: export function fromFiles(list: File[]): Source[] {
445:   if (typeof __DESKTOP_BUILD__ !== 'undefined' && __DESKTOP_BUILD__) return [];
446:   assertAtMost(list.length, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Selected files');
447:   const groups = new Map<string, Source>();
448:   for (const f of list) {
449:     const parts = (f.webkitRelativePath || f.name).split('/');
450:     const title = parts.length > 1 ? parts.shift()! : 'Selected images';
451:     const path = parts.join('/');
452:     if (ignored(path) || !imageFile(f)) continue;
453:     assertPathLimits(path);
454:     const group = groups.get(title) || { title, files: new Map(), issues: [] };
455:     group.files.set(path, f);
456:     groups.set(title, group);
457:     assertAtMost(group.files.size, limits.pagesPerTitle, 'Image candidates per title');
458:     assertAtMost(groups.size, limits.titles, 'Selected titles');
459:   }
460:   const sources = [...groups.values()];
461:   sources.forEach(assertSourceLimits);
462:   return sources;
463: }

465: export async function fromDesktopFolder(
466:   folderPath: string,
467:   options: ScanOptions = {},
468: ): Promise<Source> {
469:   if (!desktopAPI.isDesktop) throw new Error('Desktop API not available.');
470:   void desktopAPI.recordOpenedRoot?.(folderPath);
471:   const folderName = folderPath.split(/[\\/]/).at(-1) ?? folderPath;
472:   const source: Source = { title: folderName, localPath: folderPath, files: new Map(), issues: [] };
473: 
474:   if (desktopAPI.discoverLibrary) {
475:     try {
476:       const discovery = await withinTime(
477:         desktopAPI.discoverLibrary(folderPath, {
478:           signal: options.signal,
479:           onProgress: (prog) => {
480:             options.update?.({
481:               phase: 'discover',
482:               done: prog.done,
483:               total: prog.total,
484:               title: folderName,
485:             });
486:             if (prog.total > 0) {
487:               desktopAPI.setProgressBar(prog.done / prog.total);
488:             }
489:           },
490:         }),
491:         limits.ioTimeoutMs * 5,
492:         'Discovering library',
493:         options.signal,
494:       );
495: 
496:       if (discovery && discovery.titles.length > 0) {
497:         source.discoveredTitles = discovery.titles;
498:         let discovered = 0;
499:         for (const title of discovery.titles) {
500:           for (const ch of title.chapters) {
501:             for (const p of ch.pages) {
502:               alive(options.signal);
503:               const relPath =
504:                 discovery.titles.length > 1 ? `${title.title}/${p.relativePath}` : p.relativePath;
505:               assertPathLimits(relPath);
506:               assertAtMost(++discovered, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Discovered entries');
507:               assertAtMost(
508:                 source.files.size + 1,
509:                 limits.pagesPerTitle,
510:                 'Image candidates per title',
511:               );
512:               source.files.set(
513:                 relPath,
514:                 new DesktopHandle(
515:                   p.name,
516:                   p.absolutePath,
517:                   p.size,
518:                   p.modified,
519:                   p.width,
520:                   p.height,
521:                 ) as unknown as FileSystemFileHandle,
522:               );
523:             }
524:           }
525:         }
526:         options.update?.({
527:           phase: 'discover',
528:           done: source.files.size,
529:           total: source.files.size,
530:           title: folderName,
531:         });
532:         return source;
533:       }
534:     } catch (e) {
535:       if (e instanceof DOMException && e.name === 'AbortError') throw e;
536:       if (e instanceof LimitError) throw e;
537:     }
538:   }
539: 
540:   let entries: FolderEntry[];
541:   try {
542:     entries = await withinTime(
543:       desktopAPI.listFolder(folderPath, {
544:         signal: options.signal,
545:         onProgress: (prog) => {
546:           options.update?.({
547:             phase: 'discover',
548:             done: prog.done,
549:             total: prog.total,
550:             title: folderName,
551:           });
552:           if (prog.total > 0) {
553:             desktopAPI.setProgressBar(prog.done / prog.total);
554:           }
555:         },
556:       }),
557:       limits.ioTimeoutMs * 5,
558:       'Listing folder',
559:       options.signal,
560:     );
561:   } catch (e) {
562:     throw new Error(errorMessage(e));
563:   }
564:   let discovered = 0;
565:   for (const entry of entries) {
566:     alive(options.signal);
567:     const relPath = normalizeRelativePath(entry.relativePath);
568:     if (ignored(relPath) || !imageFile({ name: relPath, type: '' })) continue;
569:     try {
570:       assertPathLimits(relPath);
571:       assertAtMost(++discovered, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Discovered entries');
572:       assertAtMost(source.files.size + 1, limits.pagesPerTitle, 'Image candidates per title');
573:       const name = relPath.split('/').at(-1) ?? relPath;
574:       source.files.set(
575:         relPath,
576:         new DesktopHandle(
577:           name,
578:           entry.absolutePath,
579:           entry.size,
580:           entry.modified,
581:           entry.width,
582:           entry.height,
583:         ) as unknown as FileSystemFileHandle,
584:       );
585:     } catch (e) {
586:       if (e instanceof LimitError) throw e;
587:       source.issues.push({ path: relPath, reason: errorMessage(e) });
588:     }
589:     if (discovered % 256 === 0)
590:       options.update?.({ phase: 'discover', done: source.files.size, total: 0, title: folderName });
591:   }
592:   options.update?.({
593:     phase: 'discover',
594:     done: source.files.size,
595:     total: source.files.size,
596:     title: folderName,
597:   });
598:   await warmSources([source], options);
599:   return source;
600: }

610: export function droppedSources(
611:   items: DataTransferItem[],
612:   options: ScanOptions,
613: ): () => Promise<Source[]> {
614:   if (typeof __DESKTOP_BUILD__ !== 'undefined' && __DESKTOP_BUILD__) {
615:     return async () => [];
616:   }
617:   if (items.length > limits.discoveryEntries)
618:     return async () => {
619:       throw new LimitError(`Dropped items exceed the limit of ${limits.discoveryEntries}.`);
620:     };
621:   const entries = items
622:     .filter((i) => i.kind === 'file')
623:     .map((item) => {
624:       const typed = item as DataTransferItem & {
625:         getAsFileSystemHandle?: () => Promise<FileSystemHandle | null>;
626:       };
627:       return {
628:         entry: item.webkitGetAsEntry?.() as unknown as Entry | null,
629:         file: item.getAsFile(),
630:         handle: typed.getAsFileSystemHandle
631:           ? withinTime(
632:               typed.getAsFileSystemHandle(),
633:               limits.ioTimeoutMs,
634:               'Reading dropped handle',
635:               options.signal,
636:             ).catch(() => null)
637:           : undefined,
638:       };
639:     });
640:   return async () => {
641:     let discovered = 0;
642:     const sources: Source[] = [],
643:       loose: File[] = [];
644:     for (const item of entries) {
645:       alive(options.signal);
646:       assertAtMost(sources.length + 1, limits.titles, 'Dropped titles');
647:       const handle = await item.handle;
648:       if (handle?.kind === 'directory') {
649:         sources.push(await fromHandle(handle as Directory, options));
650:         assertSourcesLimits(sources);
651:         continue;
652:       }
653:       if (item.entry?.isDirectory) {
654:         const files = new Map<string, SourceFile>(),
655:           issues: Issue[] = [];
656:         async function walk(e: Entry, path: string, depth: number) {
657:           alive(options.signal);
658:           if (ignored(path)) return;
659:           if (!e.isFile && depth > limits.directoryDepth) {
660:             issues.push({
661:               path,
662:               reason: `Folder nesting exceeds ${limits.directoryDepth} levels.`,
663:             });
664:             return;
665:           }
666:           try {
667:             assertAtMost(path.length, limits.pathChars, 'Relative path length (characters)');
668:             if (e.isFile) {
669:               if (imageFile({ name: e.name, type: '' })) {
670:                 assertPathLimits(path);
671:                 assertAtMost(
672:                   files.size + (files.has(path) ? 0 : 1),
673:                   limits.pagesPerTitle,
674:                   'Image candidates per title',
675:                 );
676:                 files.set(
677:                   path,
678:                   await withinTime(
679:                     new Promise<File>((r, j) => e.file(r, j)),
680:                     limits.ioTimeoutMs,
681:                     'Reading dropped file',
682:                     options.signal,
683:                   ),
684:                 );
685:               }
686:               return;
687:             }
688:             const reader = e.createReader();
689:             while (true) {
690:               alive(options.signal);
691:               const list = await withinTime(
692:                 new Promise<Entry[]>((r, j) => reader.readEntries(r, j)),
693:                 limits.ioTimeoutMs,
694:                 'Reading dropped folder',
695:                 options.signal,
696:               );
697:               if (!list.length) break;
698:               discovered += list.length;
699:               assertAtMost(discovered, limits.discoveryEntries, 'Discovered entries');
700:               for (const child of list.sort((a, b) => naturalOrder(a.name, b.name)))
701:                 await walk(child, path ? path + '/' + child.name : child.name, depth + 1);
702:               await warmSources([{ title: item.entry?.name || 'Manga', files, issues }], options);
703:               options.update?.({
704:                 phase: 'discover',
705:                 done: files.size,
706:                 total: 0,
707:                 title: item.entry?.name,
708:               });
709:               await tick();
710:             }
711:           } catch (e) {
712:             alive(options.signal);
713:             if (e instanceof LimitError) throw e;
714:             issues.push({ path, reason: errorMessage(e) });
715:           }
716:         }
717:         await walk(item.entry, '', 0);
718:         sources.push({ title: item.entry.name, files, issues });
719:         assertSourcesLimits(sources);
720:       } else if (item.file) loose.push(item.file);
721:     }
722:     sources.push(...fromFiles(loose));
723:     assertSourcesLimits(sources);
724:     return sources;
725:   };
726: }

728: export async function splitSource(source: Source): Promise<Source[]> {
729:   assertSourceLimits(source);
730:   if (source.discoveredTitles && source.discoveredTitles.length > 1) {
731:     const splitTitles: Source[] = [];
732:     for (const dt of source.discoveredTitles) {
733:       const s: Source = {
734:         title: dt.title,
735:         localPath: dt.rootPath,
736:         files: new Map(),
737:         issues: [],
738:       };
739:       for (const ch of dt.chapters) {
740:         for (const p of ch.pages) {
741:           s.files.set(
742:             p.relativePath,
743:             new DesktopHandle(
744:               p.name,
745:               p.absolutePath,
746:               p.size,
747:               p.modified,
748:               p.width,
749:               p.height,
750:             ) as unknown as FileSystemFileHandle,
751:           );
752:         }
753:       }
754:       splitTitles.push(s);
755:       assertAtMost(splitTitles.length, limits.titles, 'Selected titles');
756:     }
757:     return splitTitles.length > 0 ? splitTitles : [source];
758:   }
759: 
760:   const result = new Map<string, Source>();
761:   const sep = source.localPath?.includes('\\') ? '\\' : '/';
762:   for (const [path, file] of source.files) {
763:     const parts = path.split('/');
764:     const isSub = parts.length > 1;
765:     const title = isSub ? parts.shift()! : source.title + ' — root pages';
766:     let s = result.get(title);
767:     if (!s) {
768:       const childLocalPath =
769:         source.localPath && isSub
770:           ? `${source.localPath.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '')}${sep}${title}`
771:           : source.localPath;
772:       s = { title, localPath: childLocalPath, files: new Map(), issues: [] };
773:       result.set(title, s);
774:       assertAtMost(result.size, limits.titles, 'Selected titles');
775:     }
776:     s.files.set(parts.join('/'), file);
777:   }
778:   for (const s of result.values())
779:     if (source.handle && s.title !== source.title + ' — root pages') {
780:       try {
781:         s.handle = (await withinTime(
782:           source.handle.getDirectoryHandle(s.title),
783:           limits.ioTimeoutMs,
784:           'Opening subfolder',
785:         )) as Directory;
786:       } catch (e) {
787:         s.issues.push({ path: s.title, reason: errorMessage(e) });
788:       }
789:     }
790:   return result.size > 0 ? [...result.values()] : [source];
791: }

793: export function chapterGroups(source: Source) {
794:   const groups = new Map<string, number>();
795:   for (const path of source.files.keys()) {
796:     const parts = path.split('/');
797:     const name = parts.length === 1 ? 'Root pages' : parts.slice(0, -1).join(' / ');
798:     if (parts.length === 1 && /^(thumbnail|cover)\./i.test(path) && source.files.size > 1) continue;
799:     groups.set(name, (groups.get(name) || 0) + 1);
800:   }
801:   return groups;
802: }

804: export function chapterPreviews(source: Source): ChapterPreview[] {
805:   const groups = chapterGroups(source);
806:   return Array.from(groups.entries(), ([name, pageCount]) => ({ name, pageCount }));
807: }
808: 
809: function chapterMatch(name: string, pages: Page[], old: Manga | undefined) {
810:   const exact = old?.chapters.find((c) => c.name === name);
811:   if (exact) return exact;
812:   const signature = (p: Page) => `${p.name}\0${p.size ?? ''}\0${p.modified ?? ''}`;
813:   const values = new Set(pages.map(signature));
814:   const matches = old?.chapters.filter(
815:     (c) => c.pages.length === pages.length && c.pages.every((p) => values.has(signature(p))),
816:   );
817:   return matches?.length === 1 ? matches[0] : undefined;
818: }
819: 
820: export async function pooled<T>(
821:   items: T[],
822:   work: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
823:   signal?: AbortSignal,
824: ) {
825:   let next = 0;
826:   const results = await Promise.allSettled(
827:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(getDecodeConcurrency(), items.length) }, async () => {
828:       while (next < items.length) {
829:         alive(signal);
830:         await work(items[next++]);
831:       }
832:     }),
833:   );
834:   const failure = results.find((r) => r.status === 'rejected');
835:   if (failure?.status === 'rejected') throw failure.reason;
836: }

838: export async function indexSource(
839:   source: Source,
840:   options: ScanOptions = {},
841:   previous?: Manga,
842:   sort: Manga['sort'] = 'natural',
843: ) {
844:   assertSourceLimits(source);
845:   if (previous) stopBackground(previous.id);
846: 
847:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.indexTitle && source.localPath) {
848:     alive(options.signal);
849:     const confirmedTitle = source.title?.trim() || undefined;
850:     const jobId = `index-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
851: 
852:     let abortHandler: (() => void) | undefined;
853:     if (options.signal) {
854:       abortHandler = () => {
855:         void desktopAPI.cancelScan?.(jobId);
856:       };
857:       options.signal.addEventListener('abort', abortHandler, { once: true });
858:     }
859: 
860:     try {
861:       const dto = await desktopAPI.indexTitle(
862:         source.localPath,
863:         {
864:           sort,
865:           previous,
866:           targetId: previous?.id,
867:           title: confirmedTitle,
868:           jobId,
869:           signal: options.signal,
870:         },
871:         (progress) => {
872:           alive(options.signal);
873:           options.update?.({
874:             phase: progress.phase as 'discover' | 'index',
875:             done: progress.done,
876:             total: progress.total,
877:             title: confirmedTitle || progress.title,
878:           });
879:           if (progress.total > 0) {
880:             desktopAPI.setProgressBar(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, progress.done / progress.total)));
881:           }
882:         },
883:       );
884:       alive(options.signal);
885: 
886:       const m: Manga = {
887:         id: dto.id,
888:         title: confirmedTitle || dto.title,
889:         slug: dto.slug,
890:         localPath: dto.localPath,
891:         lastChapter: dto.lastChapter,
892:         addedAt: dto.addedAt,
893:         updatedAt: dto.updatedAt,
894:         revision: dto.revision,
895:         sort: dto.sort as 'natural' | 'name' | 'reverse',
896:         chapters: (dto.chapters || []).map((c: any) => ({
897:           ...(c.id ? { id: c.id } : {}),
898:           name: c.name,
899:           read: c.read,
900:           position: c.position,
901:           bookmarks: c.bookmarks,
902:           pages: (c.pages || []).map((p: any) => ({
903:             name: p.name,
904:             path: p.path,
905:             width: p.width,
906:             height: p.height,
907:             size: p.size,
908:             modified: p.modified,
909:             dimensionsPending: p.dimensionsPending,
910:           })),
911:         })),
912:       };
913: 
914:       alive(options.signal);
915:       invalidateSummaryCache();
916:       invalidateBookmarkCache();
917:       clearDirHandleCache(m.id);
918:       broadcastSync({ type: 'library', id: m.id });
919: 
920:       return {
921:         m,
922:         issues: [...source.issues, ...dto.issues],
923:         reused: dto.reused,
924:       };
925:     } finally {
926:       if (abortHandler && options.signal) {
927:         options.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abortHandler);
928:       }
929:     }
930:   }
931: 
932:   const issues = [...source.issues];
933:   const grouped = new Map<string, Page[]>();
934:   const oldPages = new Map(
935:     previous?.chapters.flatMap((c) => c.pages.map((p) => [p.path, p] as const)) || [],
936:   );
937:   let reused = 0;
938:   const compare =
939:     sort === 'name'
940:       ? lexical.compare
941:       : sort === 'reverse'
942:         ? (a: string, b: string) => naturalOrder(b, a)
943:         : naturalOrder;
944:   for (const [path, entry] of source.files) {
945:     alive(options.signal);
946:     if (!path.includes('/') && /^(thumbnail|cover)\./i.test(path) && source.files.size > 1)
947:       continue;
948:     const parts = path.split('/');
949:     const name = parts.length === 1 ? 'Root pages' : parts.slice(0, -1).join(' / ');
950:     const cached = oldPages.get(path);
951:     const desktop = entry instanceof DesktopHandle ? entry : undefined;
952:     const known = entry instanceof File ? entry : desktop;
953:     const knownModified = entry instanceof File ? entry.lastModified : desktop?.lastModified;
954:     const hasDesktopDim = Boolean(desktop?.width && desktop?.height);
955:     const unchanged = Boolean(
956:       known &&
957:       cached &&
958:       !cached.dimensionsPending &&
959:       cached.size === known.size &&
960:       cached.modified === knownModified,
961:     );
962:     const pages = grouped.get(name) || [];
963:     pages.push({
964:       name: parts.at(-1)!,
965:       path,
966:       width: desktop?.width ?? cached?.width ?? 800,
967:       height: desktop?.height ?? cached?.height ?? 1200,
968:       size: known?.size ?? cached?.size,
969:       modified: knownModified ?? cached?.modified,
970:       dimensionsPending: !unchanged && !hasDesktopDim,
971:     });
972:     grouped.set(name, pages);
973:   }
974:   const naturalSort = desktopAPI.isDesktop ? desktopAPI.naturalSortPaths : undefined;
975:   let chapterNames = [...grouped.keys()];
976:   if (naturalSort && sort !== 'name') {
977:     chapterNames = await naturalSort(chapterNames);
978:     if (sort === 'reverse') chapterNames.reverse();
979:   } else {
980:     chapterNames.sort(compare);
981:   }
982:   const first = chapterNames.slice(0, limits.warmChapters);
983:   const initial = first.flatMap((name) => grouped.get(name)!);
984:   let done = 0;
985:   let lastYield = performance.now();
986:   options.update?.({
987:     phase: 'index',
988:     done,
989:     total: initial.length,
990:     title: source.title + ' · first 5 chapters',
991:   });
992:   const failed = new Set<string>();
993:   await pooled(
994:     initial,
995:     async (page) => {
996:       try {
997:         const entry = source.files.get(page.path)!;
998:         const desktop = entry instanceof DesktopHandle ? entry : undefined;
999:         if (desktop?.width && desktop?.height && !page.dimensionsPending) {
1000:           assertImageDimensions(desktop.width, desktop.height);
1001:           done++;
1002:           return;
1003:         }
1004:         if (desktop && desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.getImageDimensions) {
1005:           const dim = await desktopAPI.getImageDimensions(desktop.absPath);
1006:           if (dim && dim.width > 0 && dim.height > 0) {
1007:             assertImageDimensions(dim.width, dim.height);
1008:             Object.assign(page, {
1009:               width: dim.width,
1010:               height: dim.height,
1011:               size: desktop.size,
1012:               modified: desktop.lastModified,
1013:               dimensionsPending: false,
1014:             });
1015:             done++;
1016:             return;
1017:           }
1018:         }
1019:         const staged = scanned.get(entry);
1020:         const measured = staged ? await staged : undefined;
1021:         const f = measured?.file || (await readFile(entry));
1022:         alive(options.signal);
1023:         if (!f.size) throw new Error('Empty file.');
1024:         const cached = oldPages.get(page.path);
1025:         let size;
1026:         if (measured) size = measured;
1027:         else if (
1028:           cached &&
1029:           !cached.dimensionsPending &&
1030:           cached.size === f.size &&
1031:           cached.modified === f.lastModified
1032:         ) {
1033:           size = cached;
1034:           reused++;
1035:         } else size = await dimensions(f, options.signal);
1036:         assertImageDimensions(size.width, size.height);
1037:         Object.assign(page, {
1038:           width: size.width,
1039:           height: size.height,
1040:           size: f.size,
1041:           modified: f.lastModified,
1042:           dimensionsPending: false,
1043:         });
1044:       } catch (e) {
1045:         alive(options.signal);
1046:         issues.push({ path: page.path, reason: errorMessage(e) });
1047:         failed.add(page.path);
1048:       }
1049:       done++;
1050:       const now = performance.now();
1051:       if (done % 8 === 0 || done === initial.length || now - lastYield >= 10) {
1052:         lastYield = now;
1053:         options.update?.({
1054:           phase: 'index',
1055:           done,
1056:           total: initial.length,
1057:           title: source.title + ' · first 5 chapters',
1058:         });
1059:         await tick();
1060:       }
1061:     },
1062:     options.signal,
1063:   );
1064:   for (const [name, pages] of grouped) {
1065:     const kept = pages.filter((p) => !failed.has(p.path));
1066:     if (kept.length) grouped.set(name, kept);
1067:     else grouped.delete(name);
1068:   }
1069:   const sortedNames =
1070:     naturalSort && sort !== 'name'
1071:       ? await (async () => {
1072:           const names = await naturalSort([...grouped.keys()]);
1073:           return sort === 'reverse' ? names.reverse() : names;
1074:         })()
1075:       : [...grouped.keys()].sort(compare);
1076: 
1077:   const chapters = await Promise.all(
1078:     sortedNames.map(async (name) => {
1079:       const p = grouped.get(name)!;
1080:       let pages: Page[];
1081:       if (naturalSort && sort !== 'name' && p.length > 1) {
1082:         const pageNames = p.map((pg) => pg.name);
1083:         const sortedPageNames = await naturalSort(pageNames);
1084:         if (sort === 'reverse') sortedPageNames.reverse();
1085:         const pMap = new Map(p.map((pg) => [pg.name, pg]));
1086:         pages = sortedPageNames.map((n) => pMap.get(n)!).filter(Boolean);
1087:       } else {
1088:         pages = p.sort((a, b) => compare(a.name, b.name));
1089:       }
1090:       const old = chapterMatch(name, pages, previous);
1091:       const oldNames = new Set(old?.pages.map((p) => p.name));
1092:       return {
1093:         name,
1094:         pages,
1095:         read: Boolean(old?.read && pages.every((p) => oldNames.has(p.name))),
1096:         position: matchingPosition(old?.position, pages, old?.pages),
1097:         bookmarks: (old?.bookmarks || [])
1098:           .map((p) => matchingPosition(p, pages, old?.pages)!)
1099:           .filter(Boolean),
1100:       };
1101:     }),
1102:   );
1103:   if (!chapters.length)
1104:     throw new Error(
1105:       issues.length
1106:         ? `No readable pages. ${issues[0].path}: ${issues[0].reason}`
1107:         : 'No image pages found in this selection.',
1108:     );
1109:   const coverEntry = [...source.files]
1110:     .sort(([a], [b]) => natural.compare(a, b))
1111:     .find(([p]) => !p.includes('/') && /^(thumbnail|cover)\./i.test(p))?.[1];
1112:   let cover = previous?.cover;
1113:   const mangaId = previous?.id || generateUUID();
1114: 
1115:   const targetEntry = coverEntry || source.files.get(chapters[0].pages[0].path);
1116:   if (
1117:     !cover &&
1118:     desktopAPI.isDesktop &&
1119:     desktopAPI.generateThumbnail &&
1120:     targetEntry &&
1121:     'absPath' in targetEntry &&
1122:     typeof (targetEntry as any).absPath === 'string'
1123:   ) {
1124:     try {
1125:       await desktopAPI.generateThumbnail((targetEntry as any).absPath, mangaId);
1126:     } catch {
1127:       // Fallback to JS canvas thumbnail path
1128:     }
1129:   }
1130: 
1131:   if (!cover && !desktopAPI.isDesktop) {
1132:     try {
1133:       cover = await thumbnail(
1134:         await readFile(coverEntry || source.files.get(chapters[0].pages[0].path)!),
1135:       );
1136:     } catch {
1137:       try {
1138:         cover = await thumbnail(await readFile(source.files.get(chapters[0].pages[0].path)!));
1139:       } catch {
1140:         /* A text cover is displayed if no preview can be decoded. */
1141:       }
1142:     }
1143:   }
1144:   alive(options.signal);
1145:   const oldChapter = previous?.chapters[previous.lastChapter];
1146:   const oldName = oldChapter?.name;
1147:   let lastChapter = chapters.findIndex((c) => c.name === oldName);
1148:   if (lastChapter < 0 && oldChapter)
1149:     lastChapter = chapters.findIndex(
1150:       (c) =>
1151:         c.position?.path &&
1152:         oldChapter.pages.some((p) => p.name === c.position?.path?.split('/').at(-1)),
1153:     );
1154:   const m: Manga = {
1155:     id: mangaId,
1156:     title: source.title.trim(),
1157:     chapters,
1158:     handle: source.handle,
1159:     localPath: source.localPath,
1160:     cover,
1161:     lastChapter: Math.max(0, lastChapter),
1162:     addedAt: previous?.addedAt || Date.now(),
1163:     updatedAt: Date.now(),
1164:     sort,
1165:   };
1166:   const used = new Set(
1167:     (await listLibrary()).map((x) => x.slug).filter((s): s is string => Boolean(s)),
1168:   );
1169:   m.slug = uniqueSlug(m.title, used);
1170:   await saveManga(m);
1171:   if (!source.handle && !source.localPath) sessionFiles.set(m.id, source.files);
1172:   else sessionFiles.delete(m.id);
1173:   return { m, issues, reused };
1174: }

1176: export async function prepareChapter(m: Manga, index: number, options: PrepareChapterOptions = {}) {
1177:   const chapter = m.chapters[index];
1178:   if (!chapter) return [];
1179:   const database = typeof indexedDB !== 'undefined' && !desktopAPI.isDesktop ? await db : undefined;
1180:   const cached = database ? ((await database.get('manga', m.id)) as Manga | undefined) : undefined;
1181:   alive(options.signal);
1182:   const savedChapter =
1183:     cached?.updatedAt === m.updatedAt || cached?.chapters[index]?.name === chapter.name
1184:       ? cached.chapters[index]
1185:       : undefined;
1186:   const savedMap = new Map(savedChapter?.pages.map((p) => [p.path, p]));
1187:   const pages = chapter.pages.map((p) => {
1188:     const hit = savedMap.get(p.path);
1189:     if (hit && !hit.dimensionsPending) {
1190:       sessionDimensions.set(`${m.id}:${p.path}`, { width: hit.width, height: hit.height });
1191:       return { ...hit };
1192:     }
1193:     const sessionHit = sessionDimensions.get(`${m.id}:${p.path}`);
1194:     if (sessionHit) {
1195:       return { ...p, ...sessionHit, dimensionsPending: false };
1196:     }
1197:     return { ...p };
1198:   });
1199:   const pending = pages.filter((p) => p.dimensionsPending);
1200:   if (!pending.length) {
1201:     m.chapters[index] = { ...chapter, pages };
1202:     return [];
1203:   }
1204: 
1205:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.prepareChapter) {
1206:     const dto = await desktopAPI.prepareChapter(
1207:       m.id,
1208:       index,
1209:       (prog) => {
1210:         alive(options.signal);
1211:         options.update?.({
1212:           phase: 'index',
1213:           done: prog.done,
1214:           total: prog.total,
1215:           title: chapter.name,
1216:         });
1217:       },
1218:       options.signal,
1219:     );
1220:     alive(options.signal);
1221:     if (dto.pages.length > 0) {
1222:       m.chapters[index] = {
1223:         ...chapter,
1224:         pages: dto.pages.map((p) => ({
1225:           name: p.name,
1226:           path: p.path,
1227:           width: p.width,
1228:           height: p.height,
1229:           size: p.size,
1230:           modified: p.modified,
1231:           dimensionsPending: p.dimensionsPending,
1232:         })),
1233:       };
1234:     }
1235:     if (dto.updated) {
1236:       m.updatedAt = dto.updatedAt;
1237:       m.revision = dto.revision;
1238:     }
1239:     return dto.issues;
1240:   }
1241: 
1242:   const remainingPending = pending;
1243: 
1244:   const issues: Issue[] = [];
1245:   let done = 0;
1246:   let lastYield = performance.now();
1247:   await pooled(
1248:     remainingPending,
1249:     async (page) => {
1250:       try {
1251:         if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.getImageDimensions && m.localPath) {
1252:           const sep = m.localPath.includes('\\') ? '\\' : '/';
1253:           const absPath = m.localPath.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '') + sep + page.path.split('/').join(sep);
1254:           const dim = await desktopAPI.getImageDimensions(absPath);
1255:           if (dim && dim.width > 0 && dim.height > 0) {
1256:             assertImageDimensions(dim.width, dim.height);
1257:             Object.assign(page, dim, { dimensionsPending: false });
1258:             sessionDimensions.set(`${m.id}:${page.path}`, {
1259:               width: dim.width,
1260:               height: dim.height,
1261:             });
1262:             done++;
1263:             const now = performance.now();
1264:             if (done % 8 === 0 || done === pending.length || now - lastYield >= 10) {
1265:               lastYield = now;
1266:               options.update?.({
1267:                 phase: 'index',
1268:                 done,
1269:                 total: pending.length,
1270:                 title: chapter.name,
1271:               });
1272:               await tick();
1273:             }
1274:             return;
1275:           }
1276:         }
1277:         const file = await fileFor(m, page);
1278:         alive(options.signal);
1279:         if (!file.size) throw new Error('Empty file.');
1280:         const size = await dimensions(file, options.signal);

1349: export function scheduleBackground(manga: Manga) {
1350:   if (
1351:     backgroundJobs.has(manga.id) ||

1353:   )

1357:     id: manga.id,
1358:     revision: manga.revision,
1359:     updatedAt: manga.updatedAt,
1360:     controller: new AbortController(),
1361:   });

1365: async function runDrainPass() {
1366:   let remaining = backgroundJobs.size;
1367:   while (backgroundJobs.size && remaining-- > 0) {
1368:     const [id, job] = backgroundJobs.entries().next().value!;
1369:     try {
1370:       const initial = await getManga(id);
1371:       if (
1372:         !initial ||
1373:         initial.updatedAt !== job.updatedAt ||
1374:         (job.revision !== undefined && initial.revision !== job.revision)
1375:       ) {
1376:         continue;
1377:       }
1378:       for (let i = 0; i < initial.chapters.length; i++) {
1379:         alive(job.controller.signal);
1380:         if (!initial.chapters[i].pages.some((p) => p.dimensionsPending)) continue;
1381:         await new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
1382:         alive(job.controller.signal);
1383:         if (!(await access(initial))) break;
1384:         const stored = await getManga(id);
1385:         if (
1386:           !stored ||
1387:           stored.updatedAt !== job.updatedAt ||
1388:           (job.revision !== undefined && stored.revision !== job.revision)
1389:         ) {
1390:           break;
1391:         }
1392:         const issues = await prepareChapter(stored, i, { signal: job.controller.signal });
1393:         job.updatedAt = stored.updatedAt;
1394:         job.revision = stored.revision;
1395:         if (issues.length > 0 && stored.chapters[i]?.pages.some((p) => p.dimensionsPending)) {
1396:           break;
1397:         }
1398:       }
1399:     } catch {
1400:       /* Interrupted jobs remain pending in saved metadata and can resume later. */
1401:     } finally {
1402:       if (backgroundJobs.get(id) === job) backgroundJobs.delete(id);
1403:     }
1404:   }
1405: }
1406: 
1407: async function drainBackground() {
1408:   if (backgroundRunning) return;
1409:   backgroundRunning = true;
1410:   try {
1411:     if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'locks' in navigator && navigator.locks?.request) {
1412:       await navigator.locks.request('manga-reader:bg-prep', { ifAvailable: true }, async (lock) => {
1413:         if (!lock) return;
1414:         await runDrainPass();
1415:       });
1416:     } else {
1417:       await runDrainPass();
1418:     }
1419:   } finally {
1420:     backgroundRunning = false;
1421:     if (backgroundJobs.size) setTimeout(() => void drainBackground(), 0);
1422:   }
1423: }

411: export async function saveMangaIdb(m: Manga): Promise<void> {
412:   assertMangaLimits(m);
413:   const updatedAt = Date.now();
414:   const tx = (await db).transaction(['manga', 'summaries', 'progress', 'covers'], 'readwrite');

416:   if (!existing && (await tx.objectStore('summaries').count()) >= limits.titles) {
417:     tx.abort();

420:       `Library title limit is ${limits.titles}. Remove a title before importing.`,
421:     );

430:     ...metadata,

435:       ...c,
436:       read: false,
437:     })),
438:   });
439:   await tx.objectStore('summaries').put(summary({ ...m, updatedAt, revision, slug }));
440:   if (cover) await tx.objectStore('covers').put(cover, m.id);

485:   const chapter = m.chapters[index];
486:   if (!chapter) return 'missing';
487:   if (bookmarks)
488:     assertAtMost(bookmarks.length, limits.bookmarksPerChapter, 'Bookmarks per chapter');
489:   const tx = (await db).transaction(['progress', 'summaries'], 'readwrite');
490:   const s = (await tx.objectStore('summaries').get(m.id)) as Summary | undefined;
491:   if (!s) {
492:     await tx.done;
493:     return 'missing';
494:   }
495:   if (s.indexedAt !== m.updatedAt || (m.revision && s.revision && s.revision !== m.revision)) {
496:     await tx.done;
497:     return 'stale';
498:   }
499:   const key: [string, string] = [m.id, chapter.name];
500:   const old = (await tx.objectStore('progress').get(key)) as Progress | undefined;
501:   const isRead = Boolean(old?.read || read);
502:   await tx.objectStore('progress').put({
503:     mangaId: m.id,
504:     chapter: chapter.name,
505:     read: isRead,
506:     position,
507:     bookmarks: bookmarks ?? old?.bookmarks ?? [],
508:   });
509:   await tx.objectStore('summaries').put({
510:     ...s,
511:     ...(updateLast
512:       ? {
513:         lastChapter: index,
514:         lastChapterName: chapter.name,
515:         hasProgress: true,
516:         updatedAt: Date.now(),
517:       }
518:       : {}),
519:     chaptersRead: s.chaptersRead + (!old?.read && isRead ? 1 : 0),
520:   });
521:   await tx.done;
522:   if (cachedSummaries) {
523:     const idx = cachedSummaries.findIndex((x) => x.id === m.id);
524:     if (idx >= 0) {
525:       const cur = cachedSummaries[idx];
526:       cachedSummaries[idx] = {
527:         ...cur,
528:         ...(updateLast
529:           ? {
530:             lastChapter: index,
531:             lastChapterName: chapter.name,
532:             hasProgress: true,
533:             updatedAt: Date.now(),
534:           }
535:           : {}),
536:         chaptersRead: cur.chaptersRead + (!old?.read && isRead ? 1 : 0),
537:       };
538:       cachedSummaries.sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt);
539:     } else {
540:       cachedSummaries = null;
541:     }
542:   }
543:   if (bookmarks) {
544:     invalidateBookmarkCache();
545:   }
546:   broadcastSync({ type: 'progress', id: m.id });
547:   return 'saved';
548: }
549: 
550: async function ensureBookmarkCaches(): Promise<void> {
551:   if (cachedBookmarkedMangaIds && cachedMangaBookmarkedIds) {
552:     return;
553:   }
554:   if (bookmarkCachePromise) {
555:     return bookmarkCachePromise;
556:   }
557:   const currentGen = ++bookmarkGeneration;
558:   bookmarkCachePromise = (async () => {
559:     try {
560:       if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') {
561:         if (bookmarkGeneration === currentGen) {
562:           cachedBookmarkedMangaIds = new Set();
563:           cachedMangaBookmarkedIds = new Set();
564:         }
565:         return;
566:       }
567:       const d = await db;
568:       const progress = await d.getAll('progress');
569:       const allBookmarked = new Set<string>();
570:       const mangaBookmarked = new Set<string>();
571: 
572:       for (const p of progress) {
573:         if (!p.bookmarks || p.bookmarks.length === 0) continue;
574:         allBookmarked.add(p.mangaId);
575:         for (const b of p.bookmarks) {
576:           if (b.mangaBookmark) {
577:             mangaBookmarked.add(p.mangaId);
578:             break;
579:           }
580:         }
581:       }
582: 
583:       if (bookmarkGeneration === currentGen) {
584:         cachedBookmarkedMangaIds = allBookmarked;
585:         cachedMangaBookmarkedIds = mangaBookmarked;
586:       }
587:     } finally {
588:       bookmarkCachePromise = null;
589:     }
590:   })();
591:   return bookmarkCachePromise;
592: }
593: 
594: export async function getBookmarkedMangaIdsIdb(): Promise<Set<string>> {
595:   await ensureBookmarkCaches();
596:   return new Set(cachedBookmarkedMangaIds ?? []);
597: }
598: 
599: export async function getMangaBookmarkedIdsIdb(): Promise<Set<string>> {
600:   await ensureBookmarkCaches();
601:   return new Set(cachedMangaBookmarkedIds ?? []);
602: }

604: export async function addBookmarkIdb(
605:   mangaId: string,
606:   chapterName: string,
607:   position: Position,
608: ): Promise<Position[]> {
609:   const database = await db;
610:   const tx = database.transaction('progress', 'readwrite');
611:   const key: [string, string] = [mangaId, chapterName];
612:   const old = (await tx.store.get(key)) as Progress | undefined;
613:   const marks = Array.isArray(old?.bookmarks) ? [...old.bookmarks] : [];
614: 
615:   const exists = marks.some((p: Position) => {
616:     if (position.mangaBookmark) {
617:       return Boolean(p.mangaBookmark);
618:     }
619:     return position.path ? p.path === position.path : p.page === position.page;
620:   });
621: 
622:   if (!exists) {
623:     assertAtMost(marks.length + 1, limits.bookmarksPerChapter, 'Bookmarks per chapter');
624:     marks.push(position);
625:     await tx.store.put({
626:       mangaId,
627:       chapter: chapterName,
628:       read: Boolean(old?.read),
629:       position: old?.position,
630:       bookmarks: marks,
631:     });
632:   }
633: 
634:   await tx.done;
635:   invalidateBookmarkCache();
636:   broadcastSync({ type: 'progress', id: mangaId });
637:   return marks;
638: }

640: export async function removeBookmarkIdb(
641:   mangaId: string,
642:   chapterName: string,
643:   position: Position,
644: ): Promise<Position[]> {
645:   const database = await db;
646:   const tx = database.transaction('progress', 'readwrite');
647:   const key: [string, string] = [mangaId, chapterName];
648:   const old = (await tx.store.get(key)) as Progress | undefined;
649:   const marks = (old?.bookmarks || []).filter((p: Position) => {
650:     if (position.mangaBookmark) {
651:       return !p.mangaBookmark;
652:     }
653:     if (p.mangaBookmark) {
654:       return true;
655:     }
656:     return position.path ? p.path !== position.path : p.page !== position.page;
657:   });
658: 
659:   if (old) {
660:     await tx.store.put({
661:       ...old,
662:       bookmarks: marks,
663:     });
664:   }
665: 
666:   await tx.done;
667:   invalidateBookmarkCache();
668:   broadcastSync({ type: 'progress', id: mangaId });
669:   return marks;
670: }

672: export async function deleteMangaIdb(id: string): Promise<void> {
673:   notifyDelete(id);
674:   const tx = (await db).transaction(['manga', 'summaries', 'covers', 'progress'], 'readwrite');
675:   const progressStore = tx.objectStore('progress');
676:   const keys = await progressStore.index('mangaId').getAllKeys(id);
677:   await Promise.all([
678:     tx.objectStore('manga').delete(id),
679:     tx.objectStore('summaries').delete(id),
680:     tx.objectStore('covers').delete(id),
681:     ...keys.map((k) => progressStore.delete(k)),
682:   ]);
683:   await tx.done;
684:   cachedSummaries = null;
685:   invalidateBookmarkCache();
686:   clearDirHandleCache(id);
687:   sessionFiles.delete(id);
688:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.deleteThumbnail) {
689:     desktopAPI.deleteThumbnail(id).catch((err) => {
690:       console.warn(`[deleteManga] Failed to delete thumbnail from disk for "${id}":`, err);
691:     });
692:   }
693:   broadcastSync({ type: 'library', id });
694: }

696: export async function clearLibraryIdb(): Promise<void> {

698:   const tx = (await db).transaction(['manga', 'summaries', 'covers', 'progress'], 'readwrite');
699:   await Promise.all(
700:     (['manga', 'summaries', 'covers', 'progress'] as const).map((name) =>
701:       tx.objectStore(name).clear(),
702:     ),
703:   );
704:   await tx.done;
705:   cachedSummaries = [];
706:   invalidateBookmarkCache();
707:   clearDirHandleCache();
708:   sessionFiles.clear();
709:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.clearThumbnails) {
710:     desktopAPI.clearThumbnails().catch((err) => {
711:       console.warn(`[clearLibrary] Failed to clear disk thumbnails:`, err);
712:     });
713:   }
714:   broadcastSync({ type: 'library' });

719: export async function restoreBackupIdb(backup: {
720:   manga: Manga[];
721:   settings: Settings;
722: }): Promise<Settings> {
723:   if (isRestoring) {
724:     throw new Error('Another restore operation is already in progress.');
725:   }
726:   isRestoring = true;
727:   try {
728:     assertAtMost(backup.manga.length, limits.titles, 'Library titles in backup');
729:     const validatedSettings = parseSettings(backup.settings);
730: 
731:     for (const m of backup.manga) {
732:       assertMangaLimits(m);
733:     }
734: 
735:     const database = await db;
736: 
737:     const existingSummaries = await listLibraryIdb();
738:     const backupIds = new Set(backup.manga.map((m) => m.id));
739:     const usedSlugs = new Set<string>(
740:       existingSummaries.filter((s) => !backupIds.has(s.id) && Boolean(s.slug)).map((s) => s.slug!),
741:     );
742:     const existingManga = new Map<string, Manga>();
743:     for (const m of backup.manga) {
744:       const existing = await getMangaIdb(m.id);
745:       if (existing) {
746:         existingManga.set(m.id, existing);
747:       }
748:     }
749: 
750:     const now = Date.now();
751:     const preparedList: {
752:       manga: Omit<Manga, 'cover'>;
753:       summary: Summary;
754:       coverBlob?: Blob;
755:       progress: {
756:         mangaId: string;
757:         chapter: string;
758:         read: boolean;
759:         position?: Position;
760:         bookmarks?: Position[];
761:       }[];
762:     }[] = [];
763: 
764:     for (const raw of backup.manga) {
765:       const old = existingManga.get(raw.id);
766:       const handle = old?.handle;
767:       const localPath = old?.localPath;
768:       const coverBlob = old?.cover;
769: 
770:       const slug =
771:         old?.slug && !usedSlugs.has(old.slug) ? old.slug : uniqueSlug(raw.title, usedSlugs);
772:       usedSlugs.add(slug);
773: 
774:       const m: Manga = {
775:         ...raw,
776:         handle,
777:         localPath,
778:         slug,
779:         updatedAt: now,
780:       };
781: 
782:       const { cover: _c, ...metadata } = m;
783:       const mangaRecord = {
784:         ...metadata,
785:         updatedAt: now,
786:         slug,
787:         chapters: m.chapters.map(({ position: _p, bookmarks: _b, ...c }: Chapter) => ({
788:           ...c,
789:           read: false,
790:         })),
791:       };
792: 
793:       const summaryRecord = summary(m);
794: 
795:       const progressRecords = m.chapters.map((c: Chapter) => ({
796:         mangaId: m.id,
797:         chapter: c.name,
798:         read: Boolean(c.read),
799:         position: c.position,
800:         bookmarks: c.bookmarks,
801:       }));
802: 
803:       preparedList.push({
804:         manga: mangaRecord,
805:         summary: summaryRecord,
806:         coverBlob,
807:         progress: progressRecords,
808:       });
809:     }
810: 
811:     const tx = database.transaction(
812:       ['manga', 'summaries', 'covers', 'progress', 'settings'],
813:       'readwrite',
814:     );
815: 
816:     try {
817:       for (const item of preparedList) {
818:         await tx.objectStore('manga').put(item.manga);
819:         await tx.objectStore('summaries').put(item.summary);
820:         if (item.coverBlob) {
821:           await tx.objectStore('covers').put(item.coverBlob, item.manga.id);
822:         }
823:         const progressStore = tx.objectStore('progress');
824:         const oldKeys = await progressStore.index('mangaId').getAllKeys(item.manga.id);
825:         await Promise.all(oldKeys.map((k) => progressStore.delete(k)));
826:         await Promise.all(item.progress.map((p) => progressStore.put(p)));
827:       }
828: 
829:       await tx.objectStore('settings').put(validatedSettings, 'global');
830:       await tx.done;
831:       cachedSummaries = null;
832:       invalidateBookmarkCache();
833:       clearDirHandleCache();
834: 
835:       if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && desktopAPI.saveThumbnail) {
836:         for (const item of preparedList) {
837:           if (item.coverBlob) {
838:             try {
839:               const buffer = await item.coverBlob.arrayBuffer();
840:               await desktopAPI.saveThumbnail(item.manga.id, buffer);
841:             } catch (err) {
842:               console.warn(
843:                 `[restoreBackup] Failed to cache thumbnail to disk for "${item.manga.id}":`,
844:                 err,
845:               );
846:             }
847:           }
848:         }
849:       }
850:       broadcastSync({ type: 'library' });
851:     } catch (err) {
852:       try {
853:         tx.abort();
854:       } catch { }
855:       throw err;
856:     }
857: 
858:     return validatedSettings;
859:   } finally {
860:     isRestoring = false;
861:   }
862: }

864: export async function resetProgressIdb(): Promise<void> {
865:   const database = await db;
866:   const tx = database.transaction(['progress', 'summaries'], 'readwrite');
867:   try {
868:     let cursor = await tx.objectStore('progress').openCursor();
869:     while (cursor) {
870:       const p = cursor.value;
871:       if (p.read || p.position) {
872:         await cursor.update({
873:           ...p,
874:           read: false,
875:           position: undefined,
876:         });
877:       }
878:       cursor = await cursor.continue();
879:     }
880: 
881:     let sCursor = await tx.objectStore('summaries').openCursor();
882:     while (sCursor) {
883:       const s = sCursor.value;
884:       await sCursor.update({
885:         ...s,
886:         chaptersRead: 0,
887:         lastChapter: 0,
888:         hasProgress: false,
889:       });
890:       sCursor = await sCursor.continue();
891:     }
892: 
893:     await tx.done;
894:     cachedSummaries = null;
895:     invalidateBookmarkCache();
896:     broadcastSync({ type: 'progress' });
897:   } catch (err) {
898:     try {
899:       tx.abort();
900:     } catch { }
901:     throw err;
902:   }
903: }
