1066: export function errorMessage(e: unknown): string {
1067:   const err = e as { name?: string; message?: string };
1068:   if (err?.name === 'QuotaExceededError')
1069:     return 'Browser storage is full. Export a backup and remove unused library entries before retrying.';
1070:   if (err?.name === 'NotAllowedError' || err?.name === 'SecurityError')
1071:     return 'Folder permission was denied. Re-link the folder or use standard file selection.';
1072:   if (err?.name === 'NotFoundError')
1073:     return 'A file or folder moved or disappeared. Re-link the folder to update its index.';
1074:   if (err?.name === 'InvalidStateError')
1075:     return 'Storage is unavailable or another tab is upgrading it. Close other Reader tabs and reopen.';
1076:   return err?.message || 'The operation could not complete. Please try again.';
1077: }

1086: export async function fileFor(m: Manga, p: Page): Promise<File> {
1087:   assertPathLimits(p.path);
1088:   if (desktopAPI.isDesktop && (m.localPath || desktopAPI.resolvePath)) {
1089:     const sep = m.localPath?.includes('\\') ? '\\' : '/';
1090:     const fallbackAbs = m.localPath
1091:       ? `${m.localPath.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '')}${sep}${p.path.split('/').join(sep)}`
1092:       : p.path;

30: export function validateRelativePath(path: unknown): string {
31:   if (typeof path !== 'string' || !path.trim()) {
32:     throw new ValidationError('Path must be a non-empty string.');
33:   }
34:   if (path.startsWith(' ') || path.endsWith(' ')) {
35:     throw new ValidationError(`Path cannot start or end with whitespace: "${path}"`);
36:   }
37:   const trimmed = path.trim();
38:   if (trimmed.includes(':')) {
39:     throw new ValidationError(`Path cannot contain drive prefixes or colons: "${trimmed}"`);
40:   }
41:   if (trimmed.startsWith('/') || trimmed.endsWith('/')) {
42:     throw new ValidationError(`Path cannot start or end with a slash: "${trimmed}"`);
43:   }
44:   if (trimmed.startsWith('//')) {
45:     throw new ValidationError(`Path cannot start with UNC prefix: "${trimmed}"`);
46:   }
47:   if (trimmed.includes('\\')) {
48:     throw new ValidationError(`Path must use forward slashes only: "${trimmed}"`);
49:   }
50:   if (trimmed.includes('\0')) {
51:     throw new ValidationError('Path contains invalid null byte.');
52:   }
53:   if (/[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]/.test(trimmed)) {
54:     throw new ValidationError('Path contains invalid control character.');
55:   }
56:   assertPathLimits(trimmed);
57:   const segments = trimmed.split('/');
58:   for (const seg of segments) {
59:     if (!seg || seg === '.' || seg === '..') {
60:       throw new ValidationError(`Path contains invalid traversal segment: "${trimmed}"`);
61:     }
62:     if (seg.endsWith(' ') || seg.endsWith('.')) {
63:       throw new ValidationError(`Path segment cannot end with a space or dot: "${seg}"`);
64:     }
65:     const stem = seg.split('.')[0].toLowerCase();
66:     if (RESERVED_DOS_NAMES.has(stem)) {
67:       throw new ValidationError(`Path segment uses reserved device name: "${seg}"`);
68:     }
69:   }
70:   return trimmed;
71: }

73: export function matchingPosition(
74:   p: Position | undefined,
75:   pages: Page[],
76:   oldPages: Page[] = [],
77: ): Position | undefined {
78:   if (!p || !pages.length) return;
79:   const path = p.path || oldPages[p.page]?.path;
80:   let page = path ? pages.findIndex((x) => x.path === path) : -1;
81:   if (page < 0 && path) {
82:     const name = path.split('/').at(-1);
83:     const matches = pages.map((x, i) => (x.name === name ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
84:     if (matches.length === 1) page = matches[0];
85:   }
86:   if (page < 0) page = Math.min(p.page, pages.length - 1);
87:   const validIndex = Math.max(0, page);
88:   return {
89:     page: validIndex,
90:     path: pages[validIndex].path,
91:     fraction: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number.isFinite(p.fraction) ? p.fraction : 0)),
92:     ...(p.mangaBookmark ? { mangaBookmark: true } : {}),
93:     ...(typeof p.timestamp === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p.timestamp)

154: export function parsePage(value: unknown, seenPaths: Set<string>): Page {
155:   if (!isRecord(value)) {

168: 
169:   const isPending = value.dimensionsPending === true;
170:   const isWidthPending = isPending && value.width === 0;
171:   const isHeightPending = isPending && value.height === 0;

174:     typeof value.width !== 'number' ||
175:     !Number.isInteger(value.width) ||

179:     (value.height <= 0 && !isHeightPending)

203:     }
204:     modified = value.modified;
205:   }

208:     typeof value.dimensionsPending === 'boolean' ? value.dimensionsPending : undefined;

211:     name: value.name.trim(),

213:     width: value.width,
214:     height: value.height,

566: export function validateBackup(value: unknown): { manga: Manga[]; settings: Settings } {
567:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
568:     try {
569:       value = JSON.parse(value);
570:     } catch {
571:       throw new ValidationError('Backup must be valid JSON');
572:     }
573:   }
574:   if (!isRecord(value)) {
575:     throw new ValidationError('Backup must be an object.');
576:   }
577: 
578:   if (value.version !== 1 && value.version !== 2) {
579:     throw new ValidationError('Invalid backup version. Supported versions: 1, 2.');
580:   }
581: 
582:   if (!Array.isArray(value.manga)) {
583:     throw new ValidationError('Backup manga list must be an array.');
584:   }
585: 
586:   assertAtMost(value.manga.length, limits.titles, 'Backup titles');
587: 
588:   const seenIds = new Set<string>();
589:   let totalBackupPages = 0;
590: 
591:   const manga: Manga[] = value.manga.map((rawManga, index) => {
592:     if (!isRecord(rawManga) || typeof rawManga.id !== 'string') {
593:       throw new ValidationError(`Manga item ${index + 1} has an invalid or missing ID.`);
594:     }
595:     const id = rawManga.id.trim();
596:     if (!id) {
597:       throw new ValidationError(`Manga item ${index + 1} has an invalid or missing ID.`);
598:     }
599:     if (seenIds.has(id)) {
600:       throw new ValidationError(`Duplicate manga ID found in backup: "${id}"`);
601:     }
602:     seenIds.add(id);
603: 
604:     const parsed = parseManga(rawManga, undefined, { preserveHardwarePointers: false });
605:     for (const ch of parsed.chapters) {
606:       totalBackupPages += ch.pages.length;
607:       assertAtMost(totalBackupPages, limits.backupPages, 'Backup pages');
608:     }
609:     return parsed;
610:   });
611: 
612:   const settings = parseSettings(value.settings);
613: 
614:   return {
615:     manga,
616:     settings,
617:   };
618: }

3: export interface ImageTaskOptions {
4:   key: string;
5:   priority?: number;
6:   run: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>;
7:   onComplete?: () => void;
8:   onError?: (err: unknown) => void;

11: export type CancelHandle = () => void;

13: interface Subscriber {
14:   onComplete?: () => void;
15:   onError?: (err: unknown) => void;
16: }
17: 
18: interface QueuedItem {
19:   key: string;
20:   priority: number;
21:   primaryRun: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<void>;
22:   subscribers: Map<number, Subscriber>;
23:   controller: AbortController;

27: let mobileQuery: MediaQueryList | null = null;
28: let cachedIsMobile: boolean | null = null;
29: 
30: function getIsMobile(): boolean {
31:   if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
32:     return false;
33:   }
34:   if (!mobileQuery) {
35:     try {
36:       mobileQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width:700px)');
37:       cachedIsMobile = mobileQuery.matches;
38:       const onChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent | MediaQueryList) => {
39:         cachedIsMobile = e.matches;
40:       };
41:       if (typeof mobileQuery.addEventListener === 'function') {
42:         mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', onChange);
43:       } else if (typeof (mobileQuery as any).addListener === 'function') {
44:         (mobileQuery as any).addListener(onChange);
45:       }
46:     } catch {
47:       return false;
48:     }
49:   }
50:   return cachedIsMobile ?? false;
51: }
52: 
53: let cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit: number | null = null;
54: 
55: function getHardwareConcurrencyLimit(): number {
56:   if (cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit !== null) {
57:     return cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit;
58:   }
59:   if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined') {
60:     const nav = navigator as unknown as {
61:       hardwareConcurrency?: number;
62:       deviceMemory?: number;
63:     };
64:     const cores = nav.hardwareConcurrency;
65:     const mem = nav.deviceMemory;
66: 
67:     if ((cores && cores <= 2) || (mem && mem <= 2)) {
68:       cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit = 1;
69:       return 1;
70:     }
71:     if ((cores && cores <= 4) || (mem && mem <= 4)) {
72:       cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit = Math.min(2, limits.desktopPageConcurrency);
73:       return cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit;
74:     }
75:   }
76: 
77:   cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit = limits.desktopPageConcurrency;
78:   return cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit;
79: }

81: export function resetConcurrencyCacheForTesting(): void {
82:   mobileQuery = null;
83:   cachedIsMobile = null;
84:   cachedHardwareConcurrencyLimit = null;

87: export class ImageQueue {
88:   private queue: QueuedItem[] = [];
89:   private waiting = new Map<string, QueuedItem>();
90:   private activeCount = 0;
91:   private inFlight = new Map<string, QueuedItem>();
92:   private queueDirty = false;
93:   private nextSubscriberId = 0;
94: 
95:   get pendingCount(): number {
96:     return this.queue.length;
97:   }
98: 
99:   get runningCount(): number {
100:     return this.activeCount;
101:   }
102: 
103:   private getMaxConcurrency(): number {
104:     if (getIsMobile()) {
105:       return limits.mobilePageConcurrency;
106:     }
107:     return getHardwareConcurrencyLimit();
108:   }
109: 
110:   reprioritize(key: string, priority: number): void {
111:     const item = this.waiting.get(key);
112:     if (item && item.priority !== priority) {
113:       item.priority = priority;
114:       this.queueDirty = true;
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:   enqueue(options: ImageTaskOptions): CancelHandle | null {
119:     const { key, priority = 0, run, onComplete, onError } = options;
120:     const subId = ++this.nextSubscriberId;
121:     const sub: Subscriber = { onComplete, onError };
122: 
123:     const existingWaiting = this.waiting.get(key);
124:     if (existingWaiting) {
125:       existingWaiting.subscribers.set(subId, sub);
126:       if (priority > existingWaiting.priority) {
127:         existingWaiting.priority = priority;
128:         this.queueDirty = true;
129:       }
130:       return () => this.cancelSubscriber(key, subId);
131:     }
132: 
133:     const existingInFlight = this.inFlight.get(key);
134:     if (existingInFlight && !existingInFlight.canceled) {
135:       existingInFlight.subscribers.set(subId, sub);
136:       return () => this.cancelSubscriber(key, subId);
137:     }
138: 
139:     if (this.queue.length >= limits.queuedJobs) {
140:       return null;
141:     }
142: 
143:     const item: QueuedItem = {
144:       key,
145:       priority,
146:       primaryRun: run,
147:       subscribers: new Map([[subId, sub]]),
148:       controller: new AbortController(),
149:       canceled: false,
150:     };
151: 
152:     this.queue.push(item);
153:     this.waiting.set(key, item);
154:     this.queueDirty = true;
155:     this.pump();
156: 
157:     return () => this.cancelSubscriber(key, subId);
158:   }
159: 
160:   private cancelSubscriber(key: string, subId: number): void {
161:     const waitingItem = this.waiting.get(key);
162:     if (waitingItem) {
163:       waitingItem.subscribers.delete(subId);
164:       if (waitingItem.subscribers.size === 0) {
165:         this.waiting.delete(key);
166:         waitingItem.canceled = true;
167:         waitingItem.controller.abort();
168:         const index = this.queue.indexOf(waitingItem);
169:         if (index >= 0) {
170:           this.queue.splice(index, 1);
171:         }
172:       }
173:       return;
174:     }
175: 
176:     const running = this.inFlight.get(key);
177:     if (running) {
178:       running.subscribers.delete(subId);
179:       if (running.subscribers.size === 0) {
180:         running.canceled = true;
181:         running.controller.abort();
182:       }
183:     }
184:   }
185: 
186:   cancel(key: string): void {
187:     const waitingItem = this.waiting.get(key);
188:     if (waitingItem) {
189:       this.waiting.delete(key);
190:       waitingItem.canceled = true;
191:       waitingItem.controller.abort();
192:       const index = this.queue.indexOf(waitingItem);
193:       if (index >= 0) {
194:         this.queue.splice(index, 1);
195:       }
196:       return;
197:     }
198: 
199:     const running = this.inFlight.get(key);
200:     if (running) {
201:       running.canceled = true;
202:       running.controller.abort();
203:     }
204:   }
205: 
206:   clear(): void {
207:     for (const item of this.queue) {
208:       item.canceled = true;
209:       item.controller.abort();
210:     }
211:     this.queue.length = 0;
212:     this.waiting.clear();
213:     this.queueDirty = false;
214: 
215:     for (const running of this.inFlight.values()) {
216:       running.canceled = true;
217:       running.controller.abort();
218:     }
219:   }
220: 
221:   private ensureSorted(): void {
222:     if (!this.queueDirty) return;
223:     for (let i = 1; i < this.queue.length; i++) {
224:       const item = this.queue[i];
225:       let j = i - 1;
226:       while (j >= 0 && this.queue[j].priority < item.priority) {
227:         this.queue[j + 1] = this.queue[j];
228:         j--;
229:       }
230:       this.queue[j + 1] = item;
231:     }
232:     this.queueDirty = false;
233:   }
234: 
235:   private pump(): void {
236:     const maxConcurrency = this.getMaxConcurrency();
237:     this.ensureSorted();
238: 
239:     while (this.activeCount < maxConcurrency && this.queue.length > 0) {
240:       const item = this.queue.shift();
241:       if (!item) break;
242: 
243:       this.waiting.delete(item.key);
244: 
245:       if (item.canceled || item.subscribers.size === 0) {
246:         continue;
247:       }
248: 
249:       this.activeCount++;
250:       this.inFlight.set(item.key, item);
251: 
252:       void (async () => {
253:         try {
254:           if (!item.canceled && !item.controller.signal.aborted) {
255:             await item.primaryRun(item.controller.signal);
256: 
257:             if (!item.canceled && !item.controller.signal.aborted) {
258:               for (const sub of Array.from(item.subscribers.values())) {
259:                 try {
260:                   sub.onComplete?.();
261:                 } catch (e) {
262:                   console.error(`[imageQueue] Task ${item.key} onComplete error:`, e);
263:                 }
264:               }
265:             }
266:           }
267:         } catch (err) {
268:           if (!item.controller.signal.aborted) {
269:             console.warn(`[imageQueue] Task ${item.key} failed:`, err);
270:             for (const sub of Array.from(item.subscribers.values())) {
271:               try {
272:                 sub.onError?.(err);
273:               } catch (e) {
274:                 console.error(`[imageQueue] Task ${item.key} onError error:`, e);
275:               }
276:             }
277:           }
278:         } finally {
279:           this.activeCount = Math.max(0, this.activeCount - 1);
280:           if (this.inFlight.get(item.key) === item) {
281:             this.inFlight.delete(item.key);
282:           }
283:           this.pump();
284:         }
285:       })();
286:     }
287:   }
288: }

77:   milliseconds: number,
78:   operation: string,
79:   signal?: AbortSignal,
80: ): Promise<T> {
81:   return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
82:     let settled = false;
83:     const finish = (success: boolean, value: unknown) => {
84:       if (settled) return;
85:       settled = true;
86:       clearTimeout(timer);
87:       signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
88:       if (success) resolve(value as T);
89:       else reject(value);
90:     };
91:     const abort = () =>
92:       finish(false, signal?.reason ?? new DOMException('Cancelled', 'AbortError'));
93:     const timer = setTimeout(
94:       () => finish(false, new Error(`${operation} timed out. Please retry.`)),
95:       milliseconds,
96:     );
97:     signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
98:     Promise.resolve(task).then(
99:       (value) => finish(true, value),
100:       (error) => finish(false, error),
101:     );
102:     if (signal?.aborted) abort();
103:   });

1: interface PoolEntry {
2:   url: string;
3:   refCount: number;
4:   inCache: boolean;
5: }
6: 
7: export class ObjectUrlPool {
8:   private entries = new Map<string, PoolEntry>();
9:   private readonly maxEntries: number;
10: 
11:   constructor(maxEntries = 32) {
12:     this.maxEntries = Math.max(1, maxEntries);
13:   }
14: 
15:   get size(): number {
16:     let count = 0;
17:     for (const entry of this.entries.values()) {
18:       if (entry.inCache) count++;
19:     }
20:     return count;
21:   }
22: 
23:   get totalAllocated(): number {
24:     return this.entries.size;
25:   }
26: 
27:   get(key: string): string | undefined {
28:     const entry = this.entries.get(key);
29:     if (!entry || !entry.inCache) return undefined;
30:     this.entries.delete(key);
31:     this.entries.set(key, entry);
32:     return entry.url;
33:   }
34: 
35:   retain(key: string): () => void {
36:     const entry = this.entries.get(key);
37:     if (!entry) return () => { };
38:     entry.refCount++;
39:     let done = false;
40:     return () => {
41:       if (done) return;
42:       done = true;
43:       entry.refCount = Math.max(0, entry.refCount - 1);
44:       if (!entry.inCache && entry.refCount <= 0) {
45:         if (this.entries.get(key) === entry) this.entries.delete(key);
46:         try {
47:           URL.revokeObjectURL(entry.url);
48:         } catch { }
49:       }
50:     };
51:   }
52: 
53:   release(key: string): void {
54:     const entry = this.entries.get(key);
55:     if (!entry) return;
56:     entry.refCount = Math.max(0, entry.refCount - 1);
57:     if (!entry.inCache && entry.refCount <= 0) {
58:       if (this.entries.get(key) === entry) this.entries.delete(key);
59:       try {
60:         URL.revokeObjectURL(entry.url);
61:       } catch { }
62:     }
63:   }
64: 
65:   set(key: string, url: string): void {
66:     const existing = this.entries.get(key);
67:     if (existing) {
68:       this.entries.delete(key);
69:       if (existing.url !== url) {
70:         existing.inCache = false;
71:         if (existing.refCount <= 0) {
72:           try {
73:             URL.revokeObjectURL(existing.url);
74:           } catch { }
75:         }
76:       } else {
77:         existing.inCache = true;
78:         this.entries.set(key, existing);
79:         return;
80:       }
81:     } else if (this.size >= this.maxEntries) {
82:       for (const [oldKey, oldEntry] of this.entries.entries()) {
83:         if (oldEntry.inCache) {
84:           oldEntry.inCache = false;
85:           if (oldEntry.refCount <= 0) {
86:             this.entries.delete(oldKey);
87:             try {
88:               URL.revokeObjectURL(oldEntry.url);
89:             } catch { }
90:           }
91:           break;
92:         }
93:       }
94:     }
95: 
96:     this.entries.set(key, {
97:       url,
98:       refCount: 0,
99:       inCache: true,
100:     });
101:   }
102: 
103:   has(key: string): boolean {
104:     const entry = this.entries.get(key);
105:     return Boolean(entry && entry.inCache);
106:   }
107: 
108:   revoke(key: string): void {
109:     const entry = this.entries.get(key);
110:     if (entry) {
111:       entry.inCache = false;
112:       if (entry.refCount <= 0) {
113:         this.entries.delete(key);
114:         try {
115:           URL.revokeObjectURL(entry.url);
116:         } catch { }
117:       }
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   clear(): void {
122:     for (const [key, entry] of Array.from(this.entries.entries())) {

134: export function getAdaptivePoolSize(): number {
135:   if (typeof navigator === 'undefined') return 32;
136:   const nav = navigator as Navigator & { deviceMemory?: number; hardwareConcurrency?: number };
137:   const mem = nav.deviceMemory ?? 4;
138:   const cores = nav.hardwareConcurrency ?? 4;
139:   if (mem <= 2 || cores <= 2) return 12;
140:   if (mem <= 4 || cores <= 4) return 24;
141:   if (mem >= 8 && cores >= 8) return 64;
142:   return 40;
143: }

18: export function folderSlug(name = '') {
19:   return (
20:     (name || '')
21:       .normalize('NFKD')
22:       .replace(/[0-9#*]\uFE0F?\u20E3/g, '')
23:       .replace(
24:         /[\p{Extended_Pictographic}\p{Regional_Indicator}\p{Emoji_Modifier}\uFE0F\u200D\u{E0020}-\u{E007F}]/gu,
25:         '',
26:       )
27:       .replace(/([A-Za-z])\p{M}+/gu, '$1')
28:       .toLowerCase()
29:       .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\p{M}]+/gu, '-')
30:       .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
31:       .slice(0, 100)
32:       .replace(/-+$/, '')
33:       .normalize('NFC') || 'manga'
34:   );
35: }

40:     const slug = attempt === 0 ? base : base + '-' + (attempt + 1);
41:     if (!used.has(slug) && !reserved.includes(slug)) return slug;
42:   }
43:   throw new Error('Could not allocate a unique title URL.');
44: }

193:   private async ensureBookmarks(): Promise<void> {
194:     if (this.cachedAllBookmarkedIds && this.cachedMangaBookmarkedIds) {

368: export type LegacyReadResult =
369:   | { status: 'unavailable' }
370:   | { status: 'empty' }
371:   | { status: 'failed'; error: Error }
372:   | { status: 'data'; titles: Manga[]; settings?: Settings };

374: export async function readLegacyIndexedDB(): Promise<LegacyReadResult> {
375:   if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.indexedDB === 'undefined') {
376:     return { status: 'unavailable' };
377:   }
378: 
379:   return new Promise<LegacyReadResult>((resolve) => {
380:     let existed = true;
381:     let req: IDBOpenDBRequest;
382:     try {
383:       req = window.indexedDB.open('manga-reader');
384:     } catch (err) {
385:       return resolve({
386:         status: 'failed',
387:         error: err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),
388:       });
389:     }
390: 
391:     req.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
392:       if (event.oldVersion === 0) {
393:         existed = false;
394:         try {
395:           req.transaction?.abort();
396:         } catch { }
397:       }
398:     };
399: 
400:     req.onerror = () => {
401:       if (!existed) {
402:         return resolve({ status: 'empty' });
403:       }
404:       return resolve({
405:         status: 'failed',
406:         error: req.error ?? new Error('IndexedDB open error'),
407:       });
408:     };
409: 
410:     req.onsuccess = () => {
411:       const db = req.result;
412:       try {
413:         if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('manga')) {
414:           db.close();
415:           return resolve({ status: 'empty' });
416:         }
417: 
418:         const storeNames = ['manga'];
419:         if (db.objectStoreNames.contains('settings')) {
420:           storeNames.push('settings');
421:         }
422:         if (db.objectStoreNames.contains('progress')) {
423:           storeNames.push('progress');
424:         }
425: 
426:         const tx = db.transaction(storeNames, 'readonly');
427:         const mangaReq = tx.objectStore('manga').getAll();
428:         const settingsReq = db.objectStoreNames.contains('settings')
429:           ? tx.objectStore('settings').get('global')
430:           : null;
431:         const progressReq = db.objectStoreNames.contains('progress')
432:           ? tx.objectStore('progress').getAll()
433:           : null;
434: 
435:         tx.oncomplete = () => {
436:           db.close();
437:           try {
438:             const rawManga = (mangaReq.result || []) as Manga[];
439:             let settings: Settings | undefined = undefined;
440:             if (settingsReq?.result) {
441:               try {
442:                 settings = parseSettings(settingsReq.result);
443:               } catch { }
444:             }
445: 
446:             const rawProgress = (progressReq?.result || []) as any[];
447:             const progressByManga = new Map<string, Map<string, any>>();
448:             for (const p of rawProgress) {
449:               if (p && p.mangaId && p.chapter) {
450:                 let m = progressByManga.get(p.mangaId);
451:                 if (!m) {
452:                   m = new Map();
453:                   progressByManga.set(p.mangaId, m);
454:                 }
455:                 m.set(p.chapter, p);
456:               }
457:             }
458: 
459:             const titles: Manga[] = [];
460:             for (const item of rawManga) {
461:               if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
462:               const mangaProgress = progressByManga.get(item.id);
463:               if (mangaProgress && Array.isArray(item.chapters)) {
464:                 for (const ch of item.chapters) {
465:                   const prog = mangaProgress.get(ch.name);
466:                   if (prog) {
467:                     if (prog.read !== undefined) ch.read = prog.read;
468:                     if (prog.position) ch.position = prog.position;
469:                     if (prog.bookmarks) ch.bookmarks = prog.bookmarks;
470:                   }
471:                 }
472:               }
473:               titles.push(item);
474:             }
475: 
476:             if (titles.length === 0 && !settings) {
477:               return resolve({ status: 'empty' });
478:             }
479:             return resolve({ status: 'data', titles, settings });
480:           } catch (processErr) {
481:             return resolve({
482:               status: 'failed',
483:               error: processErr instanceof Error ? processErr : new Error(String(processErr)),
484:             });
485:           }
486:         };
487: 
488:         tx.onerror = () => {
489:           db.close();
490:           return resolve({
491:             status: 'failed',
492:             error: tx.error ?? new Error('IndexedDB transaction error'),
493:           });
494:         };
495:       } catch (err) {
496:         try {
497:           db.close();
498:         } catch { }
499:         return resolve({
500:           status: 'failed',
501:           error: err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),
502:         });
503:       }
504:     };
505:   });
506: }

508: export async function ensureLibraryMigrated(idbRepo?: LibraryRepo): Promise<boolean> {
509:   if (!desktopAPI.isDesktop || !desktopAPI.isLibraryMigrated) {
510:     return false;
511:   }
512:   const alreadyMigrated = await desktopAPI.isLibraryMigrated();
513:   if (alreadyMigrated) {
514:     return true;
515:   }
516: 
517:   let titles: Manga[] = [];
518:   let settings: Settings | undefined;
519: 
520:   if (idbRepo) {
521:     try {
522:       titles = await idbRepo.allManga();
523:       settings = await idbRepo.getStoredSettings();
524:     } catch (err) {
525:       throw new Error(
526:         `Failed to read from provided migration repo: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
527:       );
528:     }
529:   } else {
530:     const legacyResult = await readLegacyIndexedDB();
531:     if (legacyResult.status === 'failed') {
532:       throw new Error(`Legacy IndexedDB migration read failed: ${legacyResult.error.message}`);
533:     }
534:     if (legacyResult.status === 'unavailable') {
535:       console.warn(
536:         '[ensureLibraryMigrated] IndexedDB unavailable in environment; skipping legacy migration',
537:       );
538:       return false;
539:     }
540:     if (legacyResult.status === 'data') {
541:       titles = legacyResult.titles;
542:       settings = legacyResult.settings;
543:     }
544:   }
545: 
546:   if (titles.length === 0 && !settings) {
547:     if (!desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary) {
548:       throw new Error('desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary is required on desktop');
549:     }
550:     await desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary({ manga: [], settings: {} });
551:     return true;
552:   }
553: 
554:   const localPathsById = new Map<string, string>();
555:   for (const t of titles) {
556:     if (t && typeof t.id === 'string' && typeof t.localPath === 'string' && t.localPath.trim()) {
557:       localPathsById.set(t.id.trim(), t.localPath.trim());
558:     }
559:   }
560: 
561:   const validated = validateBackup({
562:     version: 2,
563:     manga: titles,
564:     settings: settings ?? {},
565:   });
566: 
567:   for (const m of validated.manga) {
568:     const savedLocalPath = localPathsById.get(m.id);
569:     if (savedLocalPath && !m.localPath) {
570:       m.localPath = savedLocalPath;
571:     }
572:   }
573: 
574:   if (!desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary) {
575:     throw new Error('desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary is required on desktop');
576:   }
577:   const ok = await desktopAPI.importLegacyLibrary(validated);
578:   if (!ok) {
579:     throw new Error('SQLite legacy library import failed');
580:   }
581: 
582:   return true;
583: }

18: async function withTimeout<T>(task: Promise<T>, message: string) {
19:   let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
20:   try {
21:     return await Promise.race([
22:       task,
23:       new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
24:         timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(message)), limits.updateTimeoutMs);
25:       }),
26:     ]);
27:   } finally {
28:     clearTimeout(timer!);

32: export async function applyUpdate() {
33:   if (applying) return;
34:   applying = true;
35:   try {
36:     const tasks: Promise<unknown>[] = [];
37:     window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('reader-before-update', { detail: tasks }));
38:     await withTimeout(Promise.all(tasks), 'Saving took too long. Try again before refreshing.');
39: 
40:     // On Desktop, download and install the signed release via Tauri updater
41:     if (isDesktop || desktopAPI.isDesktop) {
42:       if (desktopAPI.installUpdate) {
43:         await desktopAPI.installUpdate();
44:       }
45:       return;
46:     }
47: 
48:     // Another tab may already have activated the worker advertised by this banner.
49:     const worker = registration?.waiting;
50:     if (worker && worker.state !== 'activated')
51:       await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
52:         const finish = (error?: Error) => {
53:           clearTimeout(timer);
54:           worker.removeEventListener('statechange', changed);
55:           navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener('controllerchange', controlled);
56:           error ? reject(error) : resolve();
57:         };
58:         const changed = () => {
59:           if (worker.state === 'activated') finish();
60:           else if (worker.state === 'redundant')
61:             finish(new Error('The update was replaced. Try again.'));
62:         };
63:         const controlled = () => finish();
64:         const timer = setTimeout(
65:           () =>
66:             finish(new Error('The update did not finish. Follow the manual refresh steps below.')),
67:           limits.updateTimeoutMs,
68:         );
69:         worker.addEventListener('statechange', changed);
70:         navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', controlled);
71:         try {
72:           worker.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
73:           changed();
74:         } catch (e) {
75:           finish(e instanceof Error ? e : new Error('Unable to activate the update.'));
76:         }
77:       });
78:     if (typeof location !== 'undefined') {
79:       location.reload();
80:     }
81:   } finally {
82:     applying = false;
83:   }
84: }

8: pub fn percent_decode(input: &str) -> String {
9:     let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(input.len());
10:     let mut chars = input.bytes();
11:     while let Some(b) = chars.next() {
12:         if b == b'%' {
13:             let h1 = chars.next();
14:             let h2 = chars.next();
15:             match (h1, h2) {
16:                 (Some(c1), Some(c2)) => {
17:                     let hex_str = [c1, c2];
18:                     if let Ok(s) = std::str::from_utf8(&hex_str) {
19:                         if let Ok(val) = u8::from_str_radix(s, 16) {
20:                             bytes.push(val);
21:                             continue;
22:                         }
23:                     }
24:                     bytes.push(b'%');
25:                     bytes.push(c1);
26:                     bytes.push(c2);
27:                 }
28:                 (Some(c1), None) => {
29:                     bytes.push(b'%');
30:                     bytes.push(c1);
31:                 }
32:                 _ => {
33:                     bytes.push(b'%');
34:                 }
35:             }
36:         } else {
37:             bytes.push(b);
38:         }
39:     }
40:     String::from_utf8(bytes).unwrap_or_else(|_| input.to_string())
41: }

43: /// Sanitizes thumbnail ID to prevent path traversal attacks, namespace collisions,
44: /// and Windows reserved device name collisions (e.g. CON, PRN, AUX, NUL).
45: /// Always hashes with an explicit "thumb_v1:" domain separator and "t_" prefix.
46: pub fn sanitize_id(id: &str) -> String {
47:     if id.is_empty() {
48:         return String::new();
49:     }
50:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
51:     hasher.update(b"thumb_v1:");
52:     hasher.update(id.as_bytes());
53:     format!("t_{:x}", hasher.finalize())
54: }
55: 
56: /// Generates a collision-resistant SHA-256 hash for variant cache keys with an explicit namespace.
57: pub fn hash_key(key: &str) -> String {
58:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
59:     hasher.update(b"variant_v1:");
60:     hasher.update(key.as_bytes());
61:     format!("v_{:x}", hasher.finalize())
62: }

129: pub async fn save_thumbnail(
130:     app: AppHandle,
131:     request: tauri::ipc::Request<'_>,
132: ) -> Result<(), String> {
133:     let (id, bytes) = match request.body() {
134:         tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Raw(raw_bytes) => {
135:             let id_header = request
136:                 .headers()
137:                 .get("x-id")
138:                 .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
139:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing x-id header".to_string())?;
140:             (percent_decode(id_header), raw_bytes.to_vec())
141:         }
142:         tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Json(json) => {
143:             let id = json
144:                 .get("id")
145:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
146:                 .unwrap_or("")
147:                 .to_string();
148:             let bytes = if let Some(arr) = json.get("bytes").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
149:                 let mut byte_vec = Vec::with_capacity(arr.len());
150:                 for (idx, item) in arr.iter().enumerate() {
151:                     let val = item.as_u64().ok_or_else(|| {
152:                         format!("Invalid byte entry at index {idx}: expected unsigned integer")
153:                     })?;
154:                     if val > 255 {
155:                         return Err(format!(
156:                             "Byte value {val} at index {idx} exceeds 255 (valid byte range 0..=255)"
157:                         ));
158:                     }
159:                     byte_vec.push(val as u8);
160:                 }
161:                 byte_vec
162:             } else {
163:                 return Err("Expected raw body or JSON 'bytes' array".into());
164:             };
165:             (id, bytes)
166:         }
167:     };
168: 
169:     if id.is_empty() {
170:         return Err("Thumbnail ID cannot be empty".into());
171:     }
172: 
173:     if bytes.len() > MAX_THUMBNAIL_BYTES {
174:         return Err(format!(
175:             "Thumbnail exceeds maximum size of {} bytes",
176:             MAX_THUMBNAIL_BYTES
177:         ));
178:     }
179: 
180:     let path = get_thumbnail_path(&app, &id)?;
181:     tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<(), String> {
182:         crate::commands::fs::write_atomic(&path, &bytes).map_err(|e| format!("{e}"))?;
183:         if !path.exists() {
184:             return Err("Failed to verify thumbnail file existence on disk".to_string());
185:         }
186:         Ok(())
187:     })
188:     .await
189:     .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to spawn blocking write: {e}"))?
190:     .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to write thumbnail to disk: {e}"))?;
191: 
192:     Ok(())
193: }

228: /// Prunes image variants cache directory if size exceeds 500 MiB or 1,000 files.
229: pub fn prune_cache(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
230:     let cache_dir = app
231:         .path()
232:         .app_cache_dir()
233:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to resolve cache dir: {e}"))?;
234:     let var_dir = cache_dir.join("variants");
235:     if !var_dir.exists() {
236:         return Ok(());
237:     }
238: 
239:     if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&var_dir) {
240:         let mut files: Vec<(PathBuf, std::time::SystemTime, u64)> = Vec::new();
241:         for entry in entries.flatten() {
242:             if let Ok(meta) = entry.metadata() {
243:                 if meta.is_file() {
244:                     let mtime = meta.modified().unwrap_or(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH);
245:                     files.push((entry.path(), mtime, meta.len()));
246:                 }
247:             }
248:         }
249: 
250:         let mut total_size: u64 = files.iter().map(|f| f.2).sum();
251:         let mut remaining = files.len();
252:         if total_size > 500 * 1024 * 1024 || remaining > 1000 {
253:             files.sort_by_key(|f| f.1); // oldest first
254:             for (p, _, len) in files {
255:                 if total_size <= 400 * 1024 * 1024 && remaining <= 800 {
256:                     break;
257:                 }
258:                 if std::fs::remove_file(p).is_ok() {
259:                     total_size = total_size.saturating_sub(len);
260:                     remaining = remaining.saturating_sub(1);
261:                 }
262:             }
263:         }
264:     }
265: 
266:     Ok(())
267: }

38:     pub fn update<F, R>(&self, app: &AppHandle, f: F) -> Result<R, String>
39:     where
40:         F: FnOnce(&mut AppConfig) -> R,
41:     {
42:         let mut lock = self.0.write().unwrap();
43:         let mut cloned = lock.clone();
44:         let res = f(&mut cloned);
45:         save_persisted_config(app, &cloned)?;
46:         *lock = cloned;
47:         Ok(res)
48:     }

51: fn get_config_path(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
52:     let app_dir = app
53:         .path()
54:         .app_data_dir()
55:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to resolve app data dir: {e}"))?;
56:     let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&app_dir);
57:     Ok(app_dir.join("app_config.json"))
58: }

60: pub fn load_persisted_config(app: &AppHandle) -> AppConfig {
61:     if let Ok(path) = get_config_path(app) {
62:         if path.exists() {
63:             if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
64:                 if let Ok(config) = serde_json::from_str::<AppConfig>(&content) {
65:                     return config;
66:                 }
67:             }
68:         }
69:         // Fallback recovery: check if a valid .tmp file exists from an interrupted rename
70:         let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
71:         if tmp.exists() {
72:             if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&tmp) {
73:                 if let Ok(config) = serde_json::from_str::<AppConfig>(&content) {
74:                     let _ = fs::rename(&tmp, &path);
75:                     return config;
76:                 }
77:             }
78:         }
79:     }
80:     AppConfig::default()
81: }

83: pub fn save_persisted_config(app: &AppHandle, config: &AppConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
84:     let path = get_config_path(app)?;
85:     let json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(config)
86:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to serialize config: {e}"))?;
87:     write_atomic(&path, json.as_bytes())
88:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to write config atomically: {e}"))?;
89:     Ok(())
90: }

142: #[tauri::command(async)]
143: pub fn record_opened_root(app: AppHandle, root_path: String) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
144:     let trimmed = root_path.trim().to_string();
145:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
146:         return Ok(Vec::new());
147:     }
148: 
149:     let raw_path = std::path::Path::new(&trimmed);
150:     let canonical = dunce::canonicalize(raw_path)
151:         .map_err(|e| format!("Cannot record unresolvable path: {e}"))?;
152: 
153:     let allowed = app.state::<super::fs::AllowedRoots>();
154:     if !allowed.is_allowed(&canonical) {
155:         return Err(format!(
156:             "Path '{}' is not under an authorized root",
157:             canonical.display()
158:         ));
159:     }
160: 
161:     let canonical_str = canonical.to_string_lossy().to_string();
162:     let state = app.state::<AppConfigState>();
163:     state.update(&app, |cfg| {
164:         // Remove duplicate if already present, push to front
165:         cfg.last_opened_roots
166:             .retain(|r| r != &canonical_str && r != &trimmed);
167:         cfg.last_opened_roots.insert(0, canonical_str);
168:         // Cap at 25 entries
169:         if cfg.last_opened_roots.len() > 25 {
170:             cfg.last_opened_roots.truncate(25);
171:         }
172:         cfg.last_opened_roots.clone()
173:     })
174: }

178:     let state = app.state::<AppConfigState>();
179:     Ok(state.get().last_opened_roots)
180: }

7: pub const MAX_DIAGNOSTICS: usize = 50;
8: pub const DEDUP_WINDOW_MS: u64 = 2_000;
9: 
10: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
11: #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
12: pub struct DiagnosticInput {
13:     pub operation: String,
14:     pub level: String,
15:     pub message: String,
16:     #[serde(default)]
17:     pub code: Option<String>,
18:     #[serde(default)]
19:     pub safe_identifier: Option<String>,
20:     #[serde(default)]
21:     pub retryable: Option<bool>,
22:     #[serde(default)]
23:     pub duration_ms: Option<u64>,
24: }

26: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
27: #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
28: pub struct DiagnosticRecord {
29:     pub id: String,
30:     pub timestamp: u64,
31:     pub operation: String,
32:     pub level: String,
33:     pub message: String,
34:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
35:     pub code: Option<String>,
36:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
37:     pub safe_identifier: Option<String>,
38:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
39:     pub retryable: Option<bool>,
40:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
41:     pub duration_ms: Option<u64>,
42: }
43: 
44: struct DiagnosticsStore {
45:     ring_buffer: VecDeque<DiagnosticRecord>,
46:     next_id: u64,
47: }
48: 
49: impl Default for DiagnosticsStore {
50:     fn default() -> Self {
51:         Self {
52:             ring_buffer: VecDeque::with_capacity(MAX_DIAGNOSTICS),
53:             next_id: 1,
54:         }
55:     }
56: }
57: 
58: #[derive(Default)]
59: pub struct DiagnosticsState(Mutex<DiagnosticsStore>);
60: 
61: pub fn sanitize_identifier(raw: Option<&str>) -> Option<String> {
62:     let raw_str = raw?;
63:     if raw_str.is_empty() {
64:         return None;
65:     }
66:     let normalized = raw_str.replace('\\', "/");
67:     let parts: Vec<&str> = normalized.split('/').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
68:     if parts.is_empty() {
69:         return None;
70:     }
71:     let start = parts.len().saturating_sub(2);
72:     Some(parts[start..].join("/"))
73: }
74: 
75: fn current_timestamp_ms() -> u64 {
76:     SystemTime::now()
77:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
78:         .unwrap_or_default()
79:         .as_millis() as u64
80: }
81: 
82: impl DiagnosticsState {
83:     pub fn record_with_timestamp(
84:         &self,
85:         entry: DiagnosticInput,
86:         now: u64,
87:     ) -> Option<DiagnosticRecord> {
88:         if entry.code.as_deref() == Some("AbortError")
89:             || entry.message.contains("Import cancelled")
90:             || entry.message.contains("aborted")
91:         {
92:             return None;
93:         }
94: 
95:         let mut store = self.0.lock().unwrap();
96: 
97:         if let Some(recent) = store.ring_buffer.back() {
98:             if recent.operation == entry.operation
99:                 && recent.level == entry.level
100:                 && recent.message == entry.message
101:                 && now.saturating_sub(recent.timestamp) < DEDUP_WINDOW_MS
102:             {
103:                 return Some(recent.clone());
104:             }
105:         }
106: 
107:         let id = format!("diag-{}", store.next_id);
108:         store.next_id += 1;
109: 
110:         let record = DiagnosticRecord {
111:             id,
112:             timestamp: now,
113:             operation: entry.operation,
114:             level: entry.level,
115:             message: entry.message,
116:             code: entry.code,
117:             safe_identifier: sanitize_identifier(entry.safe_identifier.as_deref()),
118:             retryable: entry.retryable,
119:             duration_ms: entry.duration_ms,
120:         };
121: 
122:         store.ring_buffer.push_back(record.clone());
123:         if store.ring_buffer.len() > MAX_DIAGNOSTICS {
124:             store.ring_buffer.pop_front();
125:         }
126: 
127:         Some(record)
128:     }
129: 
130:     pub fn record(&self, entry: DiagnosticInput) -> Option<DiagnosticRecord> {
131:         self.record_with_timestamp(entry, current_timestamp_ms())
132:     }
133: 
134:     pub fn get_all(&self) -> Vec<DiagnosticRecord> {
135:         let store = self.0.lock().unwrap();
136:         store.ring_buffer.iter().cloned().collect()
137:     }
138: 
139:     pub fn clear(&self) {
140:         let mut store = self.0.lock().unwrap();
141:         store.ring_buffer.clear();
142:     }
143: }
144:

146: pub fn sanitize_diagnostic_identifier(raw: Option<String>) -> Option<String> {

48: pub fn calculate_page_dimensions_internal(
49:     page: &PageInput,
50:     options: &GeometryOptions,
51: ) -> PageDimensions {
52:     let safe_zoom = if options.zoom == 0.0 || !options.zoom.is_finite() {
53:         1.0
54:     } else {
55:         options.zoom.max(0.1)
56:     };
57:     let page_w = (page.width.max(1)) as f64;
58:     let page_h = (page.height.max(1)) as f64;
59:     let native_width = page_w * safe_zoom;
60:     let page_aspect = page_w / page_h;
61: 
62:     let target_width = match options.layout.as_str() {
63:         "width" => options.container_width.min(native_width),
64:         "height" => {
65:             let by_height = options.viewport_height.max(1.0) * page_aspect * safe_zoom;
66:             options.container_width.min(by_height).min(native_width)
67:         }
68:         "auto" => options
69:             .container_width
70:             .min(920.0 * safe_zoom)
71:             .min(native_width),
72:         _ => {
73:             let reading_width = if options.max_width > 0.0 {
74:                 options.max_width * safe_zoom
75:             } else {
76:                 options.container_width
77:             };
78:             options.container_width.min(reading_width).min(native_width)
79:         }
80:     };
81: 
82:     let target_width = target_width.round().max(1.0);
83:     let target_height = (target_width / page_aspect).round().max(1.0);
84: 
85:     PageDimensions {
86:         width: target_width,
87:         height: target_height,
88:     }
89: }
90: 
91: pub fn compute_offsets_internal(
92:     pages: &[PageInput],
93:     options: &GeometryOptions,
94:     measured_heights: Option<&HashMap<usize, f64>>,
95: ) -> Vec<PageOffset> {
96:     let mut offsets = Vec::with_capacity(pages.len());
97:     let mut current_top = 0.0;
98: 
99:     for (i, page) in pages.iter().enumerate() {
100:         let measured = measured_heights
101:             .and_then(|m| m.get(&i).copied())
102:             .filter(|&h| h > 0.0 && h.is_finite());
103: 
104:         let height =
105:             measured.unwrap_or_else(|| calculate_page_dimensions_internal(page, options).height);
106:         let bottom = current_top + height;
107: 
108:         offsets.push(PageOffset {
109:             page: i,
110:             top: current_top,
111:             height,
112:             bottom,
113:         });
114:         current_top = bottom;
115:     }
116: 
117:     offsets
118: }

120: pub fn get_window_range_internal(
121:     offsets: &[PageOffset],
122:     scroll_y: f64,
123:     viewport_height: f64,
124:     buffer_screen_count: Option<f64>,
125:     threshold: Option<usize>,
126: ) -> WindowRange {
127:     let count = offsets.len();
128:     let thresh = threshold.unwrap_or(VIRTUALIZATION_THRESHOLD);
129: 
130:     if count <= thresh {
131:         return WindowRange {
132:             start_index: 0,
133:             end_index: count.saturating_sub(1),
134:             top_spacer: 0.0,
135:             bottom_spacer: 0.0,
136:         };
137:     }
138: 
139:     let safe_viewport_height = if viewport_height <= 0.0 || !viewport_height.is_finite() {
140:         800.0
141:     } else {
142:         viewport_height.max(1.0)
143:     };
144:     let buf_screens = buffer_screen_count.unwrap_or(3.0).max(1.0);
145:     let buffer = safe_viewport_height * buf_screens;
146:     let min_y = (scroll_y - buffer).max(0.0);
147:     let max_y = scroll_y + safe_viewport_height + buffer;
148: 
149:     let mut lo = 0usize;
150:     let mut hi = count - 1;
151:     while lo < hi {
152:         let mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
153:         if offsets[mid].bottom >= min_y {
154:             hi = mid;
155:         } else {
156:             lo = mid + 1;
157:         }
158:     }
159:     let start_index = lo;
160:     hi = count - 1;
161:     while lo < hi {
162:         let mid = (lo + hi).div_ceil(2);
163:         if offsets[mid].top <= max_y {
164:             lo = mid;
165:         } else {
166:             hi = mid - 1;
167:         }
168:     }
169:     let end_index = lo.max(start_index).min(count - 1);
170: 
171:     let top_spacer = offsets[start_index].top.max(0.0);
172:     let bottom_spacer = (offsets[count - 1].bottom - offsets[end_index].bottom).max(0.0);
173: 
174:     WindowRange {
175:         start_index,
176:         end_index,
177:         top_spacer,
178:         bottom_spacer,
179:     }
180: }

8: pub const MAX_DIMENSION_CACHE: usize = 1000;
9: 
10: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
11: #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
12: pub struct HeaderDimensions {
13:     pub width: u32,
14:     pub height: u32,
15: }
16: 
17: struct DimensionCache {
18:     map: HashMap<String, HeaderDimensions>,
19:     order: VecDeque<String>,
20: }
21: 
22: impl DimensionCache {
23:     fn new() -> Self {
24:         Self {
25:             map: HashMap::with_capacity(MAX_DIMENSION_CACHE),
26:             order: VecDeque::with_capacity(MAX_DIMENSION_CACHE),
27:         }
28:     }
29: 
30:     fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<HeaderDimensions> {
31:         self.map.get(key).copied()
32:     }
33: 
34:     #[allow(clippy::map_entry)]
35:     fn insert(&mut self, key: String, val: HeaderDimensions) {
36:         if self.map.contains_key(&key) {
37:             self.map.insert(key, val);
38:             return;
39:         }
40:         if self.map.len() >= MAX_DIMENSION_CACHE {
41:             if let Some(oldest) = self.order.pop_front() {
42:                 self.map.remove(&oldest);
43:             }
44:         }
45:         self.order.push_back(key.clone());
46:         self.map.insert(key, val);
47:     }
48: 
49:     fn clear(&mut self) {
50:         self.map.clear();
51:         self.order.clear();
52:     }
53: }
54: 
55: static DIMENSION_CACHE: LazyLock<Mutex<DimensionCache>> =
56:     LazyLock::new(|| Mutex::new(DimensionCache::new()));

58: fn read_u16_be(b: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u16 {
59:     u16::from_be_bytes([b[offset], b[offset + 1]])
60: }
61: 
62: fn read_u16_le(b: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u16 {
63:     u16::from_le_bytes([b[offset], b[offset + 1]])
64: }
65: 
66: fn read_u16_endian(b: &[u8], offset: usize, le: bool) -> u16 {
67:     if le {
68:         read_u16_le(b, offset)
69:     } else {
70:         read_u16_be(b, offset)
71:     }
72: }

74: fn read_u32_be(b: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u32 {
75:     u32::from_be_bytes([b[offset], b[offset + 1], b[offset + 2], b[offset + 3]])
76: }
77: 
78: fn read_u32_le(b: &[u8], offset: usize) -> u32 {
79:     u32::from_le_bytes([b[offset], b[offset + 1], b[offset + 2], b[offset + 3]])
80: }
81: 
82: fn read_u32_endian(b: &[u8], offset: usize, le: bool) -> u32 {
83:     if le {
84:         read_u32_le(b, offset)
85:     } else {
86:         read_u32_be(b, offset)
87:     }
88: }

90: /// Parses image dimensions from header bytes (PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG with EXIF orientation swap,
91: /// plus fallback to `imagesize::blob_size` for additional formats).
92: pub fn parse_header_bytes(b: &[u8]) -> Option<HeaderDimensions> {
93:     let mut width: u32 = 0;
94:     let mut height: u32 = 0;
95: 
96:     // 1. PNG
97:     if b.len() >= 24 && read_u32_be(b, 0) == 0x8950_4e47 && read_u32_be(b, 4) == 0x0d0a_1a0a {
98:         width = read_u32_be(b, 16);
99:         height = read_u32_be(b, 20);
100:     }
101:     // 2. GIF (GIF87a / GIF89a)
102:     else if b.len() >= 10 && (&b[0..6] == b"GIF87a" || &b[0..6] == b"GIF89a") {
103:         width = read_u16_le(b, 6) as u32;
104:         height = read_u16_le(b, 8) as u32;
105:     }
106:     // 3. WebP (RIFF....WEBP)
107:     else if b.len() >= 25 && read_u32_be(b, 0) == 0x5249_4646 && read_u32_be(b, 8) == 0x5745_4250
108:     {
109:         let chunk_type = read_u32_be(b, 12);
110:         if b.len() >= 30
111:             && chunk_type == 0x5650_3820
112:             && b[23] == 0x9d
113:             && b[24] == 0x01
114:             && b[25] == 0x2a
115:         {
116:             width = (read_u16_le(b, 26) & 0x3fff) as u32;
117:             height = (read_u16_le(b, 28) & 0x3fff) as u32;
118:         } else if chunk_type == 0x5650_384c && b[20] == 0x2f {
119:             let bits = read_u32_le(b, 21);
120:             width = (bits & 0x3fff) + 1;
121:             height = ((bits >> 14) & 0x3fff) + 1;
122:         } else if b.len() >= 30 && chunk_type == 0x5650_3858 {
123:             width = 1 + ((b[24] as u32) | ((b[25] as u32) << 8) | ((b[26] as u32) << 16));
124:             height = 1 + ((b[27] as u32) | ((b[28] as u32) << 8) | ((b[29] as u32) << 16));
125:         }
126:     }
127:     // 4. JPEG (with EXIF orientation 5..=8 dimension swap)
128:     else if b.len() > 4 && b[0] == 0xff && b[1] == 0xd8 {
129:         let mut i = 2usize;
130:         let mut swap_for_exif = false;
131: 
132:         while i + 3 < b.len() {
133:             if b[i] != 0xff {
134:                 break;
135:             }
136:             i += 1;
137:             while i < b.len() && b[i] == 0xff {
138:                 i += 1;
139:             }
140:             if i >= b.len() {
141:                 break;
142:             }
143:             let marker = b[i];
144:             i += 1;
145: 
146:             if marker == 0xda || marker == 0xd9 {
147:                 break;
148:             }
149:             if marker == 0x01 || (0xd0..=0xd7).contains(&marker) {
150:                 continue;
151:             }
152:             if i + 2 > b.len() {
153:                 break;
154:             }
155:             let length = read_u16_be(b, i) as usize;
156:             if length < 2 || i + length > b.len() {
157:                 break;
158:             }
159: 
160:             // EXIF APP1 marker
161:             if marker == 0xe1
162:                 && length >= 14
163:                 && b[i + 2] == 0x45
164:                 && b[i + 3] == 0x78
165:                 && b[i + 4] == 0x69
166:                 && b[i + 5] == 0x66
167:                 && b[i + 6] == 0
168:                 && b[i + 7] == 0
169:             {
170:                 let tiff = i + 8;
171:                 if tiff + 8 <= b.len() {
172:                     let le = read_u16_be(b, tiff) == 0x4949;
173:                     if read_u16_endian(b, tiff + 2, le) == 0x002a {
174:                         let ifd_offset = read_u32_endian(b, tiff + 4, le) as usize;
175:                         if let Some(ifd0) = tiff.checked_add(ifd_offset) {
176:                             if ifd0 + 2 <= b.len() {
177:                                 let entries = read_u16_endian(b, ifd0, le) as usize;
178:                                 for k in 0..entries {
179:                                     let entry = ifd0 + 2 + k * 12;
180:                                     if entry + 12 > b.len() {
181:                                         break;
182:                                     }
183:                                     if read_u16_endian(b, entry, le) == 0x0112 {
184:                                         let orientation = read_u16_endian(b, entry + 8, le);
185:                                         if (5..=8).contains(&orientation) {
186:                                             swap_for_exif = true;
187:                                         }
188:                                         break;
189:                                     }
190:                                 }
191:                             }
192:                         }
193:                     }
194:                 }
195:             }
196: 
197:             // SOF markers
198:             if matches!(
199:                 marker,
200:                 0xc0 | 0xc1
201:                     | 0xc2
202:                     | 0xc3
203:                     | 0xc5
204:                     | 0xc6
205:                     | 0xc7
206:                     | 0xc9
207:                     | 0xca
208:                     | 0xcb
209:                     | 0xcd
210:                     | 0xce
211:                     | 0xcf
212:             ) && length >= 7
213:             {
214:                 height = read_u16_be(b, i + 3) as u32;
215:                 width = read_u16_be(b, i + 5) as u32;
216:                 if swap_for_exif {
217:                     std::mem::swap(&mut width, &mut height);
218:                 }
219:                 break;
220:             }
221: 
222:             i += length;
223:         }
224:     }
225: 
226:     // 5. Fallback to imagesize for any other header formats (BMP, AVIF, TIFF, HEIC, etc.)
227:     if width == 0 || height == 0 {
228:         if let Ok(dim) = imagesize::blob_size(b) {
229:             if dim.width <= u32::MAX as usize && dim.height <= u32::MAX as usize {
230:                 width = dim.width as u32;
231:                 height = dim.height as u32;
232:             }
233:         }
234:     }
235: 
236:     if width > 0 && height > 0 && width <= MAX_IMAGE_SIDE && height <= MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
237:         let area = (width as u64).checked_mul(height as u64)?;
238:         if area > 0 && area <= MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
239:             return Some(HeaderDimensions { width, height });
240:         }
241:     }
242: 
243:     None
244: }
245: 
246: #[tauri::command]
247: pub async fn get_header_dimensions(
248:     request: tauri::ipc::Request<'_>,
249: ) -> Result<Option<HeaderDimensions>, String> {
250:     let (cache_key, bytes) = match request.body() {
251:         tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Raw(raw_bytes) => {
252:             let key = request
253:                 .headers()

127: pub fn get_format_capabilities(ext: &str) -> ImageFormatCapabilities {
128:     let clean = ext.trim_start_matches('.').to_ascii_lowercase();
129:     FORMAT_MATRIX
130:         .iter()
131:         .find(|f| f.extension == clean)
132:         .copied()

142: pub fn calculate_fitted_dimensions(src_w: u32, src_h: u32, max_w: u32, max_h: u32) -> (u32, u32) {
143:     if src_w == 0 || src_h == 0 || max_w == 0 || max_h == 0 {
144:         return (1, 1);
145:     }
146:     let scale = (max_w as f64 / src_w as f64)
147:         .min(max_h as f64 / src_h as f64)
148:         .min(1.0);
149:     let target_w = (src_w as f64 * scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
150:     let target_h = (src_h as f64 * scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
151:     (target_w, target_h)
152: }

166: pub fn resize_rgba_fir(
167:     rgba_slice: &[u8],
168:     src_w: u32,
169:     src_h: u32,
170:     target_width: u32,
171:     target_height: u32,
172: ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
173:     if target_width == 0 || target_height == 0 {
174:         return Err("Target dimensions must be greater than zero".into());
175:     }
176:     if target_width > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || target_height > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
177:         return Err("Target dimensions exceed maximum allowed image side".into());
178:     }
179:     let target_area = (target_width as u64) * (target_height as u64);
180:     if target_area > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
181:         return Err("Target pixel area exceeds limit".into());
182:     }
183:     if target_area * 4 > MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES {
184:         return Err("Target buffer exceeds job memory budget".into());
185:     }
186: 
187:     let src = ImageRef::new(src_w, src_h, rgba_slice, PixelType::U8x4)
188:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to create source image buffer: {e}"))?;
189: 
190:     let mut dst = Image::new(target_width, target_height, PixelType::U8x4);
191:     let mut resizer = fr::Resizer::new();
192:     resizer
193:         .resize(&src, &mut dst, None)
194:         .map_err(|e| format!("Image resize failed: {e}"))?;
195: 
196:     let dst_rgba = RgbaImage::from_raw(target_width, target_height, dst.into_vec())
197:         .ok_or_else(|| "Failed to construct destination RgbaImage".to_string())?;
198: 
199:     let out = webp::Encoder::from_rgba(dst_rgba.as_raw(), target_width, target_height)
200:         .encode(80.0)
201:         .to_vec();
202: 
203:     Ok(out)
204: }

208:     target_width: u32,
209:     target_height: u32,

211:     let rgba = src_img.to_rgba8();
212:     resize_rgba_fir(rgba.as_raw(), rgba.width(), rgba.height(), target_width, target_height)

217: pub fn create_placeholder_webp(width: u32, height: u32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
218:     if width == 0 || height == 0 {
219:         return Err("Placeholder dimensions must be greater than zero".into());
220:     }
221:     if width > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || height > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
222:         return Err(format!(

225:     }

227:     if pixel_area > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
228:         return Err(format!(

231:     }
232:     let estimated_bytes = pixel_area

235:     if estimated_bytes > MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES {

238:         ));
239:     }
240:

242:     let out = webp::Encoder::from_rgba(&raw, width, height)

244:         .to_vec();
245:     Ok(out)

248: /// Safely decodes an image with total job memory budget enforcement and catch_unwind
249: /// protection against decoder panics.
250: pub fn safe_decode_image(path: &Path) -> Result<DynamicImage, String> {
251:     let ext = path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
252:     let caps = get_format_capabilities(ext);
253:     if !caps.rust_decodable {
254:         return Err(format!(
255:             "Format '.{}' is recognized by library allowlist but not decodable in native Rust pipeline (WebView displayable: {}, header readable: {})",
256:             ext, caps.webview_displayable, caps.header_readable
257:         ));
258:     }
259: 
260:     // Check header dimensions before reading file body to enforce job budget
261:     if let (Some(w), Some(h)) = crate::commands::fs::parse_image_dimensions(path) {
262:         if w == 0 || h == 0 || w > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || h > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
263:             return Err(format!("Image dimensions ({w}x{h}) exceed limits"));
264:         }
265:         let pixel_area = (w as u64) * (h as u64);
266:         if pixel_area > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
267:             return Err(format!(
268:                 "Image pixel area ({pixel_area}) exceeds limit of {MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS}"
269:             ));
270:         }
271:         let raw_bytes = pixel_area * 4;
272:         if raw_bytes > MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES {
273:             return Err(format!(
274:                 "Estimated uncompressed RGBA image memory ({raw_bytes} bytes) exceeds total job budget of {MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES} bytes"
275:             ));
276:         }
277:     }
278: 
279:     let mut limits = image::Limits::default();
280:     limits.max_alloc = Some(MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES);
281:     limits.max_image_width = Some(MAX_IMAGE_SIDE);
282:     limits.max_image_height = Some(MAX_IMAGE_SIDE);
283: 
284:     let mut reader = image::ImageReader::open(path)
285:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to open image file: {e}"))?
286:         .with_guessed_format()
287:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to determine image format: {e}"))?;
288: 
289:     reader.limits(limits);
290: 
291:     let decode_result = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| reader.decode()));
292: 
293:     match decode_result {
294:         Ok(Ok(img)) => {
295:             let (w, h) = (img.width(), img.height());
296:             let pixel_area = (w as u64) * (h as u64);
297:             if w > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || h > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || pixel_area > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
298:                 return Err("Decoded image exceeds size or pixel limits".into());
299:             }
300:             if pixel_area * 4 > MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES {
301:                 return Err("Decoded image RGBA size exceeds job memory budget".into());
302:             }
303:             Ok(img)
304:         }
305:         Ok(Err(e)) => Err(format!("Failed to decode image: {e}")),
306:         Err(_) => Err("Image decoder panicked during decoding".into()),
307:     }
308: }

375: pub fn generate_sized_thumbnail_direct(
376:     app: &AppHandle,
377:     resolved: &Path,
378:     id: &str,
379:     target_size: u32,
380: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
381:     let norm_size = match target_size {
382:         1024 => 1024,
383:         768 => 768,
384:         _ => 512,
385:     };
386:     let target_path = crate::commands::cache::get_sized_thumbnail_path(app, id, norm_size)?;
387:     let p512 = crate::commands::cache::get_sized_thumbnail_path(app, id, 512)?;
388:     let p768 = crate::commands::cache::get_sized_thumbnail_path(app, id, 768)?;
389:     let p1024 = crate::commands::cache::get_sized_thumbnail_path(app, id, 1024)?;
390: 
391:     let should_regenerate = if p512.exists() && p768.exists() && p1024.exists() {
392:         match (std::fs::metadata(resolved), std::fs::metadata(&target_path)) {
393:             (Ok(src_meta), Ok(thumb_meta)) => match (src_meta.modified(), thumb_meta.modified()) {
394:                 (Ok(src_mtime), Ok(thumb_mtime)) => src_mtime > thumb_mtime,
395:                 _ => false,
396:             },
397:             _ => true,
398:         }
399:     } else {
400:         true
401:     };
402: 
403:     if !should_regenerate {
404:         return Ok(target_path);
405:     }
406: 
407:     IMAGE_RESIZE_POOL.install(|| -> Result<(), String> {
408:         let decoded = safe_decode_image(resolved)?;
409:         let rgba = decoded.to_rgba8();
410:         let (src_w, src_h) = (rgba.width(), rgba.height());
411: 
412:         for &size in THUMBNAIL_SIZES {
413:             let (target_w, target_h) = calculate_fitted_dimensions(src_w, src_h, size, size);
414:             let bytes = resize_rgba_fir(rgba.as_raw(), src_w, src_h, target_w, target_h)?;
415: 
416:             let path = crate::commands::cache::get_sized_thumbnail_path(app, id, size)?;
417:             if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
418:                 let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(parent);
419:             }
420:             crate::commands::fs::write_atomic(&path, &bytes)
421:                 .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to write sized thumbnail ({size}): {e}"))?;
422: 
423:             if size == 512 {
424:                 let default_path = crate::commands::cache::get_thumbnail_path(app, id)?;
425:                 let _ = crate::commands::fs::write_atomic(&default_path, &bytes);
426:             }
427:         }
428: 
429:         Ok(())
430:     })?;
431: 
432:     Ok(target_path)
433: }

471:     let variant_cache_key = format!(
472:         "{}:{}:{}:fit_{}x{}:{}",
473:         resolved.to_string_lossy(),
474:         file_size,
475:         mtime_millis,
476:         max_width,
477:         max_height,
478:         IMAGE_ENCODER_VERSION
479:     );
480: 
481:     let variant_cache_path =
482:         crate::commands::cache::get_variant_path(app, &variant_cache_key, max_width, max_height)?;
483: 
484:     if variant_cache_path.exists() {
485:         return Ok(variant_cache_path);
486:     }
487: 
488:     let variant_cache_path_clone = variant_cache_path.clone();
489:     let resolved_clone = resolved.to_path_buf();
490:     IMAGE_RESIZE_POOL.install(|| -> Result<(), String> {
491:         let decoded = safe_decode_image(&resolved_clone)?;
492:         let (src_w, src_h) = (decoded.width(), decoded.height());
493:         let (target_w, target_h) = calculate_fitted_dimensions(src_w, src_h, max_width, max_height);
494:         let bytes = resize_image_fir(decoded, target_w, target_h)?;
495: 
496:         if let Some(parent) = variant_cache_path_clone.parent() {
497:             let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(parent);
498:         }
499:         crate::commands::fs::write_atomic(&variant_cache_path_clone, &bytes)
500:             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to write image variant: {e}"))?;
501: 
502:         if !variant_cache_path_clone.exists() {
503:             return Err("Failed to verify image variant file on disk".into());
504:         }
505: 
506:         Ok(())
507:     })?;
508: 
509:     Ok(variant_cache_path)
510: }

17: /// Checks whether a file name or MIME type represents a supported image.
18: pub fn is_image_file_meta(name: &str, mime_type: &str) -> bool {
19:     if mime_type.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with("image/") {
20:         return true;
21:     }
22:     let ext = std::path::Path::new(name)
23:         .extension()
24:         .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
25:         .map(|s| s.to_ascii_lowercase());
26: 
27:     match ext {
28:         Some(e) => ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.contains(&e.as_str()),
29:         None => false,
30:     }
31: }

33: fn validate_dimensions(width: u32, height: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
34:     if width == 0 || height == 0 {
35:         return Err("Image dimensions must be positive integer pixels.".into());
36:     }
37:     if width > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE || height > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
38:         return Err(format!(
39:             "Image dimensions ({width}x{height}) exceed maximum side of {MAX_IMAGE_SIDE}."
40:         ));
41:     }
42:     let area = (width as u64)
43:         .checked_mul(height as u64)
44:         .ok_or_else(|| "Image area overflow.".to_string())?;
45:     if area > MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS {
46:         return Err(format!(
47:             "Image pixel area ({area}) exceeds limit of {MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS}."
48:         ));
49:     }
50:     let raw_bytes = area
51:         .checked_mul(4)
52:         .ok_or_else(|| "Estimated RGBA buffer size overflow.".to_string())?;
53:     if raw_bytes > MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES {
54:         return Err(format!(
55:             "Estimated uncompressed RGBA image memory ({raw_bytes} bytes) exceeds job budget of {MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES} bytes."
56:         ));
57:     }
58:     Ok(())
59: }

61: fn safe_decode_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<DynamicImage, String> {
62:     if bytes.is_empty() {
63:         return Err("Empty file.".into());
64:     }
65:     if (bytes.len() as u64) > MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES {
66:         return Err(format!(
67:             "Image size ({} bytes) exceeds safety limit of {MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES} bytes.",
68:             bytes.len()
69:         ));
70:     }
71: 
72:     if let Some(header) = parse_header_bytes(bytes) {
73:         validate_dimensions(header.width, header.height)?;
74:     }
75: 
76:     let mut limits = image::Limits::default();
77:     limits.max_alloc = Some(MAX_IMAGE_JOB_MEMORY_BYTES);
78:     limits.max_image_width = Some(MAX_IMAGE_SIDE);
79:     limits.max_image_height = Some(MAX_IMAGE_SIDE);
80: 
81:     let mut reader = image::ImageReader::new(Cursor::new(bytes))
82:         .with_guessed_format()
83:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to determine image format: {e}"))?;
84:     reader.limits(limits);
85: 
86:     let decoded = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| reader.decode()));
87: 
88:     match decoded {
89:         Ok(Ok(img)) => {
90:             validate_dimensions(img.width(), img.height())?;
91:             Ok(img)
92:         }
93:         Ok(Err(e)) => Err(format!("Corrupt image or unsupported format: {e}")),
94:         Err(_) => Err("Image decoder panicked during decoding.".into()),
95:     }
96: }

98: fn encode_resized_webp(
99:     src_img: DynamicImage,
100:     target_width: u32,
101:     target_height: u32,
102:     quality: f32,
103: ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
104:     validate_dimensions(target_width, target_height)?;
105: 
106:     let safe_quality = if quality.is_finite() {
107:         let scaled = if quality <= 1.0 {
108:             quality * 100.0
109:         } else {
110:             quality
111:         };
112:         scaled.clamp(1.0, 100.0)
113:     } else {
114:         80.0
115:     };
116: 
117:     let rgba = src_img.to_rgba8();
118:     let (src_w, src_h) = (rgba.width(), rgba.height());
119: 
120:     if src_w == target_width && src_h == target_height {
121:         let out = webp::Encoder::from_rgba(rgba.as_raw(), target_width, target_height)
122:             .encode(safe_quality)
123:             .to_vec();
124:         return Ok(out);
125:     }
126: 
127:     let src = ImageRef::new(src_w, src_h, rgba.as_raw(), PixelType::U8x4)
128:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to create source image buffer: {e}"))?;
129: 
130:     let mut dst = Image::new(target_width, target_height, PixelType::U8x4);
131:     let mut resizer = fr::Resizer::new();
132:     resizer
133:         .resize(&src, &mut dst, None)
134:         .map_err(|e| format!("Image resize failed: {e}"))?;
135: 
136:     let dst_rgba = RgbaImage::from_raw(target_width, target_height, dst.into_vec())
137:         .ok_or_else(|| "Failed to construct destination RgbaImage".to_string())?;
138: 
139:     let out = webp::Encoder::from_rgba(dst_rgba.as_raw(), target_width, target_height)
140:         .encode(safe_quality)
141:         .to_vec();
142: 
143:     Ok(out)
144: }

146: /// Decodes image dimensions from raw bytes: fast header parse first, full decode fallback second.
147: pub fn decode_dimensions_from_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<HeaderDimensions>, String> {
148:     if bytes.is_empty() {
149:         return Err("Empty file.".into());
150:     }
151:     if (bytes.len() as u64) > MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES {
152:         return Err(format!(
153:             "Image size ({} bytes) exceeds safety limit of {MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES} bytes.",
154:             bytes.len()
155:         ));
156:     }
157: 
158:     if let Some(dim) = parse_header_bytes(bytes) {
159:         return Ok(Some(dim));
160:     }
161: 
162:     match safe_decode_bytes(bytes) {
163:         Ok(img) => Ok(Some(HeaderDimensions {
164:             width: img.width(),
165:             height: img.height(),
166:         })),
167:         Err(_) => Ok(None),
168:     }
169: }

171: /// Generates a fitted WebP thumbnail (max 1024x1024) from raw image bytes.
172: /// Returns `Ok(None)` if header dimensions exceed thumbnail pixel/side limits.
173: pub fn thumbnail_from_bytes_internal(bytes: &[u8], quality: f32) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, String> {
174:     if bytes.is_empty() {
175:         return Err("Empty file.".into());
176:     }
177:     if (bytes.len() as u64) > MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES {
178:         return Err("Cover file exceeds maximum allowed size.".into());
179:     }
180: 
181:     if let Some(size) = parse_header_bytes(bytes) {
182:         let area = (size.width as u64).saturating_mul(size.height as u64);
183:         if area > THUMBNAIL_MAX_PIXELS || size.width.max(size.height) > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
184:             return Ok(None);
185:         }
186:     }
187: 
188:     let decoded = safe_decode_bytes(bytes)?;
189:     let (src_w, src_h) = (decoded.width(), decoded.height());
190:     let area = (src_w as u64).saturating_mul(src_h as u64);
191:     if area > THUMBNAIL_MAX_PIXELS || src_w.max(src_h) > MAX_IMAGE_SIDE {
192:         return Ok(None);
193:     }
194: 
195:     let (target_w, target_h) =
196:         calculate_fitted_dimensions(src_w, src_h, THUMBNAIL_MAX_SIDE, THUMBNAIL_MAX_SIDE);
197:     let encoded = encode_resized_webp(decoded, target_w, target_h, quality)?;
198:     Ok(Some(encoded))
199: }

206:     quality: f32,

209:     let decoded = safe_decode_bytes(bytes)?;
210:     encode_resized_webp(decoded, target_width, target_height, quality)

213: fn extract_raw_or_json_bytes(request: &tauri::ipc::Request<'_>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
214:     let bytes = match request.body() {
215:         tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Raw(raw) => raw.to_vec(),
216:         tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Json(json) => {
217:             if let Some(arr) = json.get("bytes").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
218:                 let mut vec = Vec::with_capacity(arr.len());
219:                 for item in arr {
220:                     let val = item
221:                         .as_u64()
222:                         .ok_or_else(|| "Invalid byte in bytes array".to_string())?;
223:                     if val > 255 {
224:                         return Err("Byte value out of range".to_string());
225:                     }
226:                     vec.push(val as u8);
227:                 }
228:                 vec
229:             } else {
230:                 return Err("Expected raw binary body or JSON 'bytes' array".into());
231:             }
232:         }
233:     };
234: 
235:     if (bytes.len() as u64) > MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES {
236:         return Err(format!(
237:             "Image payload ({} bytes) exceeds maximum allowed size of {MAX_FILE_READ_BYTES} bytes.",
238:             bytes.len()
239:         ));
240:     }
241: 
242:     Ok(bytes)
243: }

245: fn header_f32(request: &tauri::ipc::Request<'_>, header_name: &str, json_key: &str) -> Option<f32> {
246:     if let Some(val) = request
247:         .headers()
248:         .get(header_name)
249:         .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
250:         .and_then(|s| s.parse::<f32>().ok())
251:     {
252:         return Some(val);
253:     }
254:     if let tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Json(json) = request.body() {
255:         if let Some(val) = json.get(json_key).and_then(|v| v.as_f64()) {
256:             return Some(val as f32);
257:         }
258:     }
259:     None
260: }
