262: fn header_u32(request: &tauri::ipc::Request<'_>, header_name: &str, json_key: &str) -> Option<u32> {
263:     if let Some(val) = request
264:         .headers()
265:         .get(header_name)
266:         .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
267:         .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())
268:     {
269:         return Some(val);
270:     }
271:     if let tauri::ipc::InvokeBody::Json(json) = request.body() {
272:         if let Some(val) = json.get(json_key).and_then(|v| v.as_u64()) {
273:             if val <= u32::MAX as u64 {
274:                 return Some(val as u32);
275:             }
276:         }
277:     }
278:     None
279: }

146: pub const MAX_QUEUED_JOBS: usize = 64;
147: 
148: #[derive(Default)]
149: pub struct BackgroundQueueState {
150:     queue: Mutex<VecDeque<String>>,
151:     cancelled: Mutex<HashMap<String, Arc<AtomicBool>>>,
152:     running: AtomicBool,
153: }
154: 
155: impl BackgroundQueueState {
156:     pub fn stop(&self, id: &str) {
157:         if let Ok(mut q) = self.queue.lock() {
158:             q.retain(|item| item != id);
159:         }
160:         if let Ok(mut c) = self.cancelled.lock() {
161:             if let Some(flag) = c.remove(id) {
162:                 flag.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
163:             }
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:     pub fn stop_all(&self) {
168:         if let Ok(mut q) = self.queue.lock() {
169:             q.clear();
170:         }
171:         if let Ok(mut c) = self.cancelled.lock() {
172:             for (_, flag) in c.drain() {
173:                 flag.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
174:             }
175:         }
176:     }
177: 
178:     pub fn enqueue(&self, id: String) -> bool {
179:         let mut q = match self.queue.lock() {
180:             Ok(g) => g,
181:             Err(_) => return false,
182:         };
183:         let mut c = match self.cancelled.lock() {
184:             Ok(g) => g,
185:             Err(_) => return false,
186:         };
187:         if c.contains_key(&id) || q.contains(&id) || c.len() >= MAX_QUEUED_JOBS {
188:             return false;
189:         }
190:         c.insert(id.clone(), Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)));
191:         q.push_back(id);
192:         true
193:     }
194: 
195:     fn pop_next(&self) -> Option<(String, Arc<AtomicBool>)> {
196:         let mut q = self.queue.lock().ok()?;
197:         let id = q.pop_front()?;
198:         let c = self.cancelled.lock().ok()?;
199:         let flag = c.get(&id)?.clone();
200:         Some((id, flag))
201:     }
202: 
203:     fn finish_job(&self, id: &str, flag: &Arc<AtomicBool>) {
204:         if let Ok(mut c) = self.cancelled.lock() {
205:             if let Some(existing) = c.get(id) {
206:                 if Arc::ptr_eq(existing, flag) {
207:                     c.remove(id);
208:                 }
209:             }
210:         }
211:     }
212: 
213:     fn has_pending(&self) -> bool {
214:         self.queue.lock().map(|q| !q.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false)
215:     }
216: }

218: pub fn compute_chapter_previews(paths: &[String]) -> Vec<ChapterPreviewDto> {
219:     let mut groups: BTreeMap<String, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
220:     let mut order: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
221:     let total = paths.len();
222: 
223:     for path in paths {
224:         let parts: Vec<&str> = path.split('/').collect();
225:         if parts.len() == 1 && total > 1 {
226:             let lower = path.to_ascii_lowercase();
227:             if lower.starts_with("thumbnail.") || lower.starts_with("cover.") {
228:                 continue;
229:             }
230:         }
231:         let name = if parts.len() == 1 {
232:             "Root pages".to_string()
233:         } else {
234:             parts[..parts.len() - 1].join(" / ")
235:         };
236:         if !groups.contains_key(&name) {
237:             order.push(name.clone());
238:         }
239:         *groups.entry(name).or_insert(0) += 1;
240:     }
241: 
242:     order
243:         .into_iter()
244:         .filter_map(|name| {
245:             groups
246:                 .remove(&name)
247:                 .map(|page_count| ChapterPreviewDto { name, page_count })
248:         })
249:         .collect()
250: }

257: fn spawn_background_drain(app: AppHandle) {
258:     let bg_state = match app.try_state::<BackgroundQueueState>() {
259:         Some(s) => s,
260:         None => return,
261:     };
262: 
263:     if bg_state
264:         .running
265:         .compare_exchange(false, true, Ordering::SeqCst, Ordering::SeqCst)
266:         .is_err()
267:     {
268:         return;
269:     }
270: 
271:     let app_clone = app.clone();
272:     tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
273:         loop {
274:             let next_job = {
275:                 let state = app_clone.state::<BackgroundQueueState>();
276:                 state.pop_next()
277:             };
278: 
279:             let (manga_id, cancel_flag) = match next_job {
280:                 Some(job) => job,
281:                 None => break,
282:             };
283: 
284:             process_background_manga(&app_clone, &manga_id, &cancel_flag).await;
285: 
286:             {
287:                 let state = app_clone.state::<BackgroundQueueState>();
288:                 state.finish_job(&manga_id, &cancel_flag);
289:             }
290:         }
291: 
292:         let has_more = {
293:             let state = app_clone.state::<BackgroundQueueState>();
294:             state.running.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
295:             state.has_pending()
296:         };
297: 
298:         if has_more {
299:             tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
300:             spawn_background_drain(app_clone);
301:         }
302:     });
303: }

305: async fn process_background_manga(app: &AppHandle, manga_id: &str, cancel_flag: &Arc<AtomicBool>) {
306:     let db_state = match app.try_state::<crate::db::DbState>() {
307:         Some(s) => s,
308:         None => return,
309:     };
310: 
311:     let id_str = manga_id.to_string();
312:     let initial = match db_state
313:         .read(move |conn| crate::db::get_manga(conn, &id_str))
314:         .await
315:     {
316:         Ok(Some(m)) => m,
317:         _ => return,
318:     };
319: 
320:     let mut expected_updated_at = initial.updated_at;
321:     let mut expected_revision = initial.revision;
322:     let chapter_count = initial.chapters.len();
323: 
324:     for i in 0..chapter_count {
325:         if cancel_flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
326:             break;
327:         }
328: 
329:         let has_pending = initial
330:             .chapters
331:             .get(i)
332:             .map(|c| {
333:                 c.pages.iter().any(|p| {
334:                     p.dimensions_pending.unwrap_or(false) || p.width == 0 || p.height == 0
335:                 })
336:             })
337:             .unwrap_or(false);
338: 
339:         if !has_pending {
340:             continue;
341:         }
342: 
343:         tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
344:         if cancel_flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
345:             break;
346:         }
347: 
348:         let id_check = manga_id.to_string();
349:         let stored = match db_state
350:             .read(move |conn| crate::db::get_manga(conn, &id_check))
351:             .await
352:         {
353:             Ok(Some(m)) => m,
354:             _ => break,
355:         };
356: 
357:         if (stored.updated_at - expected_updated_at).abs() > 0.001
358:             || stored.revision != expected_revision
359:         {
360:             break;
361:         }
362: 
363:         let local_path_str = match stored.local_path.as_ref() {
364:             Some(lp) if !lp.trim().is_empty() => lp.trim().to_string(),
365:             _ => break,
366:         };
367: 
368:         let root_path = match dunce::canonicalize(Path::new(&local_path_str)) {
369:             Ok(p) if p.is_dir() => p,
370:             _ => break,
371:         };
372: 
373:         let allowed = app.state::<AllowedRoots>();
374:         if !allowed.is_allowed(&root_path) {
375:             break;
376:         }
377: 
378:         match prepare_chapter_core(app, manga_id, i, None, None, Some(cancel_flag.clone())).await {
379:             Ok(dto) => {
380:                 expected_updated_at = dto.updated_at;
381:                 expected_revision = Some(dto.revision);
382:                 if !dto.issues.is_empty() && dto.pages.iter().any(|p| p.dimensions_pending) {
383:                     break;
384:                 }
385:             }
386:             Err(_) => break,
387:         }
388:     }
389: }

391: #[tauri::command]
392: pub async fn schedule_background(app: AppHandle, manga_id: String) -> Result<bool, String> {
393:     let trimmed = manga_id.trim().to_string();
394:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
395:         return Ok(false);
396:     }
397:     let bg_state = app.state::<BackgroundQueueState>();
398:     let enqueued = bg_state.enqueue(trimmed);
399:     if enqueued {
400:         spawn_background_drain(app.clone());
401:     }
402:     Ok(enqueued)
403: }

419: #[tauri::command]
420: pub async fn resume_background(app: AppHandle) -> Result<usize, String> {
421:     let db_state = match app.try_state::<crate::db::DbState>() {
422:         Some(s) => s,
423:         None => return Ok(0),
424:     };
425: 
426:     let summaries = db_state
427:         .read(crate::db::list_library)
428:         .await
429:         .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
430: 
431:     let mut scheduled = 0;
432:     for summary in summaries {
433:         let id = summary.id.clone();
434:         if let Ok(Some(m)) = db_state.read(move |conn| crate::db::get_manga(conn, &id)).await {
435:             let has_pending = m.chapters.iter().any(|c| {
436:                 c.pages
437:                     .iter()
438:                     .any(|p| p.dimensions_pending.unwrap_or(false) || p.width == 0 || p.height == 0)
439:             });
440:             if !has_pending {
441:                 continue;
442:             }
443:             if let Some(ref lp) = m.local_path {
444:                 if let Ok(canonical) = dunce::canonicalize(Path::new(lp.trim())) {
445:                     let allowed = app.state::<AllowedRoots>();
446:                     if canonical.is_dir() && allowed.is_allowed(&canonical) {
447:                         let bg_state = app.state::<BackgroundQueueState>();
448:                         if bg_state.enqueue(m.id) {
449:                             scheduled += 1;
450:                         }
451:                     }
452:                 }
453:             }
454:         }
455:     }
456: 
457:     if scheduled > 0 {
458:         spawn_background_drain(app);
459:     }
460: 
461:     Ok(scheduled)
462: }

579:     let mut slug = String::new();
580:     let mut prev_dash = false;
581:     for c in name.chars() {
582:         if c.is_alphanumeric() || is_combining_mark(c) {
583:             for lc in c.to_lowercase() {
584:                 slug.push(lc);
585:             }
586:             prev_dash = false;
587:         } else if !prev_dash && !slug.is_empty() {
588:             slug.push('-');
589:             prev_dash = true;
590:         }
591:         if slug.len() >= 100 {
592:             break;
593:         }
594:     }
595:     let trimmed = slug.trim_matches('-');
596:     if trimmed.is_empty()
597:         || matches!(
598:             trimmed,
599:             "read" | "assets" | "api" | "bookmarks" | "index-html" | "index.html"
600:         )
601:     {
602:         "manga".to_string()
603:     } else {
604:         trimmed.to_string()
605:     }
606: }
607: 
608: /// Resolves a reading position against a chapter's newly indexed pages list.
609: pub fn matching_position(
610:     p: &PositionDto,
611:     pages: &[PageDto],
612:     old_pages: &[PreviousPageDto],
613: ) -> Option<PositionDto> {
614:     if pages.is_empty() {
615:         return None;
616:     }
617: 
618:     let target_path = p
619:         .path
620:         .clone()
621:         .or_else(|| old_pages.get(p.page).map(|pg| pg.path.clone()));
622: 
623:     let mut page_idx = target_path
624:         .as_ref()
625:         .and_then(|tp| pages.iter().position(|x| &x.path == tp));
626: 
627:     // If path not found, try matching by leaf file name
628:     if page_idx.is_none() {
629:         if let Some(tp) = target_path.as_ref() {
630:             let leaf = tp.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(tp);
631:             let matches: Vec<usize> = pages
632:                 .iter()
633:                 .enumerate()
634:                 .filter(|(_, x)| x.name == leaf)
635:                 .map(|(i, _)| i)
636:                 .collect();
637:             if matches.len() == 1 {
638:                 page_idx = Some(matches[0]);
639:             }
640:         }
641:     }
642: 
643:     // Fall back to clamping by index
644:     let valid_idx = page_idx.unwrap_or_else(|| p.page.min(pages.len().saturating_sub(1)));
645:     let fraction = p
646:         .fraction
647:         .map(|f| if f.is_nan() { 0.0 } else { f.clamp(0.0, 1.0) });
648: 
649:     Some(PositionDto {
650:         page: valid_idx,
651:         path: Some(pages[valid_idx].path.clone()),
652:         fraction,
653:         manga_bookmark: p.manga_bookmark,
654:         timestamp: p.timestamp,
655:     })
656: }
657: 
658: /// Matches a newly indexed chapter against an existing manga record.
659: pub fn chapter_match<'a>(
660:     name: &str,
661:     pages: &[PageDto],
662:     previous: Option<&'a PreviousMangaDto>,
663: ) -> Option<&'a PreviousChapterDto> {
664:     let prev = previous?;
665: 
666:     // 1. Exact name match
667:     if let Some(exact) = prev.chapters.iter().find(|c| c.name == name) {
668:         return Some(exact);
669:     }
670: 
671:     // 2. Renamed chapter matching: same page count and all page signatures match
672:     fn sig(name: &str, size: Option<u64>, modified: Option<f64>) -> String {
673:         format!(
674:             "{}\0{}\0{}",
675:             name,
676:             size.unwrap_or(0),
677:             modified.map(|m| m.round() as i64).unwrap_or(0)
678:         )
679:     }
680: 
681:     let current_signatures: HashSet<String> = pages
682:         .iter()
683:         .map(|p| sig(&p.name, p.size, p.modified))
684:         .collect();
685: 
686:     let candidate_matches: Vec<&'a PreviousChapterDto> = prev
687:         .chapters
688:         .iter()
689:         .filter(|c| {
690:             if c.pages.len() != pages.len() {
691:                 return false;
692:             }
693:             c.pages
694:                 .iter()
695:                 .all(|p| current_signatures.contains(&sig(&p.name, p.size, p.modified)))
696:         })
697:         .collect();
698: 
699:     if candidate_matches.len() == 1 {
700:         Some(candidate_matches[0])
701:     } else {
702:         None
703:     }
704: }
705: 
706: pub fn manga_record_to_previous_dto(rec: crate::db::MangaRecord) -> PreviousMangaDto {
707:     PreviousMangaDto {
708:         id: rec.id,
709:         title: rec.title,
710:         slug: rec.slug,
711:         last_chapter: Some(rec.last_chapter),
712:         added_at: Some(rec.added_at),
713:         revision: rec.revision,
714:         chapters: rec
715:             .chapters
716:             .into_iter()
717:             .map(|c| PreviousChapterDto {
718:                 name: c.name,
719:                 read: Some(c.read),
720:                 position: c.position.map(|p| PositionDto {
721:                     page: p.page as usize,
722:                     path: p.path,
723:                     fraction: Some(p.fraction),
724:                     manga_bookmark: p.manga_bookmark,
725:                     timestamp: p.timestamp,
726:                 }),
727:                 bookmarks: c.bookmarks.map(|bms| {
728:                     bms.into_iter()
729:                         .map(|p| PositionDto {
730:                             page: p.page as usize,
731:                             path: p.path,
732:                             fraction: Some(p.fraction),
733:                             manga_bookmark: p.manga_bookmark,
734:                             timestamp: p.timestamp,
735:                         })
736:                         .collect()
737:                 }),
738:                 pages: c
739:                     .pages
740:                     .into_iter()
741:                     .map(|p| PreviousPageDto {
742:                         name: p.name,
743:                         path: p.path,
744:                         width: Some(p.width),
745:                         height: Some(p.height),
746:                         size: p.size,
747:                         modified: p.modified,
748:                         dimensions_pending: p.dimensions_pending,
749:                     })
750:                     .collect(),
751:             })
752:             .collect(),
753:     }
754: }

756: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
757: struct ScannedFile {
758:     rel_path: String,
759:     abs_path: PathBuf,
760:     name: String,
761:     size: u64,
762:     modified: f64,
763:     cached_width: Option<u32>,
764:     cached_height: Option<u32>,
765: }
766: 
767: #[tauri::command]
768: pub async fn index_title(
769:     app: AppHandle,
770:     root: String,
771:     options: Option<IndexOptions>,
772:     on_progress: tauri::ipc::Channel<ScanProgress>,
773: ) -> Result<TitleDto, String> {
774:     let raw_path = Path::new(root.trim());
775:     if !raw_path.exists() || !raw_path.is_dir() {
776:         return Err(format!(
777:             "Target path '{}' is not an existing directory",
778:             root
779:         ));
780:     }
781: 
782:     let root_path = dunce::canonicalize(raw_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| raw_path.to_path_buf());
783: 
784:     // Security check: must be under allowed library roots
785:     let allowed = app.state::<AllowedRoots>();
786:     if !allowed.is_allowed(&root_path) {
787:         return Err(format!(
788:             "Path '{}' is not under an allowed library root",
789:             root_path.display()
790:         ));
791:     }
792: 
793:     let opts = options.unwrap_or_default();
794:     let sort_mode = opts.sort.unwrap_or_else(|| "natural".to_string());
795:     let warm_count = opts.warm_chapters.unwrap_or(5);
796: 
797:     if let Some(ref tid) = opts.target_id {
798:         if let Some(bg) = app.try_state::<BackgroundQueueState>() {
799:             bg.stop(tid);
800:         }
801:     }
802:     if let Some(ref prev) = opts.previous {
803:         if let Some(bg) = app.try_state::<BackgroundQueueState>() {
804:             bg.stop(&prev.id);
805:         }
806:     }
807: 
808:     let scan_mgr = app.state::<crate::commands::fs::ScanManager>();
809:     let handle = opts.job_id.as_deref().map(|id| scan_mgr.register(id));
810:     let cancel_flag = handle.as_ref().map(|h| std::sync::Arc::clone(&h.flag));
811: 
812:     struct JobGuard<'a> {
813:         mgr: &'a crate::commands::fs::ScanManager,
814:         id: Option<&'a str>,
815:     }
816:     impl<'a> Drop for JobGuard<'a> {
817:         fn drop(&mut self) {
818:             if let Some(id) = self.id {
819:                 self.mgr.unregister(id);
820:             }
821:         }
822:     }
823:     let _guard = JobGuard {
824:         mgr: &scan_mgr,
825:         id: opts.job_id.as_deref(),
826:     };
827: 
828:     let check_cancelled = |handle: Option<&crate::commands::fs::ScanHandle>| -> Result<(), String> {
829:         if let Some(h) = handle {
830:             if h.flag.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) || *h.receiver.borrow() {
831:                 return Err("Indexing cancelled".to_string());
832:             }
833:         }
834:         Ok(())
835:     };
836: 
837:     check_cancelled(handle.as_ref())?;
838: 
839:     let folder_name = root_path
840:         .file_name()
841:         .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
842:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "Manga".to_string());
843: 
844:     let root_clone = root_path.clone();
845: 
846:     // 0. Load previous manga from SQLite off the async executor thread if not provided in options
847:     let mut previous_manga = opts.previous;
848:     if previous_manga.is_none() {
849:         if let Some(db_state) = app.try_state::<crate::db::DbState>() {
850:             let db_clone = db_state.inner().clone();
851:             let target_id = opts.target_id.clone();
852:             let root_str = root_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
853:             if let Ok(Some(prev_rec)) = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
854:                 db_clone.get_previous_manga_for_indexing_sync(
855:                     target_id.as_deref(),
856:                     Some(&root_str),
857:                 )
858:             })
859:             .await
860:             {
861:                 if let Some(bg) = app.try_state::<BackgroundQueueState>() {
862:                     bg.stop(&prev_rec.id);
863:                 }
864:                 previous_manga = Some(manga_record_to_previous_dto(prev_rec));
865:             }
866:         }
867:     }
868: 
869:     // 1. Check for retained discovery snapshot to eliminate duplicate walkdir and dimension parsing
870:     let (mut scanned_files, mut traversal_issues) =
871:         if let Some(discovery_state) = app.try_state::<crate::commands::fs::DiscoveryState>() {
872:             if let Some(snapshot) = discovery_state.get_for_path(&root_path) {
873:                 let relevant: Vec<_> = snapshot
874:                     .candidates
875:                     .into_iter()
876:                     .filter(|c| {
877:                         let p = Path::new(&c.absolute_path);
878:                         p.starts_with(&root_path)
879:                     })
880:                     .collect();
881: 
882:                 if !relevant.is_empty() {
883:                     let root_clone2 = root_path.clone();
884:                     let cancel_clone = cancel_flag.clone();
885:                     tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
886:                         let mut files = Vec::new();
887:                         let mut issues = Vec::new();
888:                         for c in relevant {
889:                             if let Some(ref cf) = cancel_clone {
890:                                 if cf.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
891:                                     break;
892:                                 }
893:                             }
894:                             let abs = PathBuf::from(&c.absolute_path);
895:                             let meta = match std::fs::metadata(&abs) {
896:                                 Ok(m) => m,
897:                                 Err(e) => {
898:                                     issues.push(ScanIssue {
899:                                         path: c.absolute_path.clone(),
900:                                         reason: format!("File missing on commit: {e}"),
901:                                     });
902:                                     continue;
903:                                 }
904:                             };
905:                             if !meta.is_file() {
906:                                 continue;
907:                             }
908:                             let mtime = meta
909:                                 .modified()
910:                                 .ok()
911:                                 .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
912:                                 .map(|d| d.as_millis() as f64)
913:                                 .unwrap_or(0.0);
914:                             let size = meta.len();
915: 
916:                             let rel = match abs.strip_prefix(&root_clone2) {
917:                                 Ok(p) => p.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/"),
918:                                 Err(_) => c.relative_path.clone(),
919:                             };
920: 
921:                             let name = abs
922:                                 .file_name()
923:                                 .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
924:                                 .unwrap_or_else(|| rel.clone());
925: 
926:                             let (w, h) = if size == c.size
927:                                 && (mtime - c.modified).abs() < 1000.0
928:                                 && c.width.is_some()
929:                                 && c.height.is_some()
930:                             {
931:                                 (c.width, c.height)
932:                             } else {
933:                                 parse_image_dimensions(&abs)
934:                             };
935: 
936:                             files.push(ScannedFile {
937:                                 rel_path: rel,
938:                                 abs_path: abs,
939:                                 name,
940:                                 size,
941:                                 modified: mtime,
942:                                 cached_width: w,
943:                                 cached_height: h,
944:                             });
945:                         }
946:                         (files, issues)
947:                     })
948:                     .await
949:                     .unwrap_or_else(|_| (Vec::new(), Vec::new()))
950:                 } else {
951:                     (Vec::new(), Vec::new())
952:                 }
953:             } else {
954:                 (Vec::new(), Vec::new())
955:             }
956:         } else {
957:             (Vec::new(), Vec::new())
958:         };
959: 
960:     // If no retained snapshot or snapshot had no valid files, run standard recursive walkdir scan
961:     if scanned_files.is_empty() {
962:         let cancel_clone = cancel_flag.clone();
963:         let (files, issues) = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
964:             let mut files = Vec::new();
965:             let mut issues = Vec::new();
966:             let walker = walkdir::WalkDir::new(&root_clone)
967:                 .max_depth(MAX_DEPTH)
968:                 .follow_links(false)
969:                 .into_iter()
970:                 .filter_entry(|entry| {
971:                     if entry.depth() == 0 {
972:                         return true;
973:                     }
974:                     let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
975:                     if entry.file_type().is_dir() {
976:                         if name.starts_with('.') || IGNORED_FOLDER_NAMES.contains(&name.as_str()) {
977:                             return false;
978:                         }
979:                     }
980:                     true
981:                 });
982: 
983:             for entry_res in walker {
984:                 if let Some(ref cf) = cancel_clone {
985:                     if cf.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
986:                         break;
987:                     }
988:                 }
989:                 if files.len() >= MAX_SCAN_FILES {
990:                     issues.push(ScanIssue {
991:                         path: root_clone.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
992:                         reason: format!(
993:                             "Reached maximum scan limit of {MAX_SCAN_FILES} files; scan results may be incomplete"
994:                         ),
995:                     });
996:                     break;
997:                 }
998:                 let entry = match entry_res {
999:                     Ok(e) => e,
1000:                     Err(err) => {
1001:                         let p = err
1002:                             .path()
1003:                             .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string())
1004:                             .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
1005:                         issues.push(ScanIssue {
1006:                             path: p,
1007:                             reason: err.to_string(),
1008:                         });
1009:                         continue;
1010:                     }
1011:                 };
1012: 
1013:                 if !entry.file_type().is_file() {
1014:                     continue;
1015:                 }
1016: 
1017:                 let file_path = entry.path();
1018:                 let ext = match file_path.extension() {
1019:                     Some(e) => e.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase(),
1020:                     None => continue,
1021:                 };
1022: 
1023:                 if !ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS.contains(&ext.as_str()) {
1024:                     continue;
1025:                 }
1026: 
1027:                 let metadata = match entry.metadata() {
1028:                     Ok(m) => m,
1029:                     Err(err) => {
1030:                         issues.push(ScanIssue {
1031:                             path: file_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1032:                             reason: format!("Failed to read metadata: {err}"),
1033:                         });
1034:                         continue;
1035:                     }
1036:                 };
1037: 
1038:                 let rel_path = match file_path.strip_prefix(&root_clone) {
1039:                     Ok(p) => p.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/"),
1040:                     Err(_) => continue,
1041:                 };
1042: 
1043:                 let file_name = file_path
1044:                     .file_name()
1045:                     .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
1046:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| rel_path.clone());
1047: 
1048:                 let modified = metadata
1049:                     .modified()
1050:                     .ok()
1051:                     .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
1052:                     .map(|d| d.as_millis() as f64)
1053:                     .unwrap_or(0.0);
1054: 
1055:                 files.push(ScannedFile {
1056:                     rel_path,
1057:                     abs_path: file_path.to_path_buf(),
1058:                     name: file_name,
1059:                     size: metadata.len(),
1060:                     modified,
1061:                     cached_width: None,
1062:                     cached_height: None,
1063:                 });
1064:             }
1065:             (files, issues)
1066:         })
1067:         .await
1068:         .map_err(|e| format!("Scan error: {e}"))?;
1069: 
1070:         scanned_files = files;
1071:         traversal_issues.extend(issues);
1072:     }
1073: 
1074:     check_cancelled(handle.as_ref())?;
1075: 
1076:     let total_scanned = scanned_files.len();
1077:     if total_scanned == 0 {
1078:         return Err("No image pages found in this selection.".to_string());
1079:     }
1080: 
1081:     if on_progress
1082:         .send(ScanProgress {
1083:             phase: "discover".to_string(),
1084:             done: total_scanned,
1085:             total: total_scanned,
1086:             title: folder_name.clone(),
1087:         })
1088:         .is_err()
1089:     {
1090:         if let Some(ref h) = handle {
1091:             h.flag.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
1092:         }
1093:         return Err("Indexing cancelled: progress channel disconnected".to_string());
1094:     }
1095: 
1096:     // 2. Build lookup for previous dimensions reuse
1097:     let mut old_pages_map: HashMap<String, PreviousPageDto> = HashMap::new();
1098:     if let Some(ref prev) = previous_manga {
1099:         for ch in &prev.chapters {
1100:             for pg in &ch.pages {
1101:                 old_pages_map.insert(pg.path.clone(), pg.clone());
1102:             }
1103:         }
1104:     }
1105: 
1106:     // 3. Chapter grouping and cover detection
1107:     let mut cover_candidate: Option<PathBuf> = None;
1108:     let mut grouped_pages: HashMap<String, Vec<PageDto>> = HashMap::new();
1109:     let mut reused_count = 0;
1110: 
1111:     let has_multiple_files = total_scanned > 1;
1112: 
1113:     for file in &scanned_files {
1114:         let parts: Vec<&str> = file.rel_path.split('/').collect();
1115:         let is_root = parts.len() == 1;
1116: 
1117:         if is_root && has_multiple_files {
1118:             let lower = file.name.to_lowercase();
1119:             if lower.starts_with("cover.") || lower.starts_with("thumbnail.") {
1120:                 if cover_candidate.is_none() {
1121:                     cover_candidate = Some(file.abs_path.clone());
1122:                 }
1123:                 continue;
1124:             }
1125:         }
1126: 
1127:         let chapter_name = if is_root {
1128:             "Root pages".to_string()
1129:         } else {
1130:             parts[..parts.len() - 1].join(" / ")
1131:         };
1132: 
1133:         let mut width = 800;
1134:         let mut height = 1200;
1135:         let mut dimensions_pending = true;
1136: 
1137:         if let (Some(w), Some(h)) = (file.cached_width, file.cached_height) {
1138:             if w > 0 && h > 0 {
1139:                 width = w;
1140:                 height = h;
1141:                 dimensions_pending = false;
1142:                 reused_count += 1;
1143:             }
1144:         } else if let Some(cached) = old_pages_map.get(&file.rel_path) {
1145:             let not_pending = !cached.dimensions_pending.unwrap_or(false);
1146:             let size_matches = cached.size == Some(file.size);
1147:             let mtime_matches = cached
1148:                 .modified
1149:                 .map(|m| (m - file.modified).abs() < 1000.0)
1150:                 .unwrap_or(false);
1151: 
1152:             if not_pending && size_matches && mtime_matches {
1153:                 if let (Some(w), Some(h)) = (cached.width, cached.height) {
1154:                     if w > 0 && h > 0 {
1155:                         width = w;
1156:                         height = h;
1157:                         dimensions_pending = false;
1158:                         reused_count += 1;
1159:                     }
1160:                 }
1161:             }
1162:         }
1163: 
1164:         grouped_pages
1165:             .entry(chapter_name)
1166:             .or_default()
1167:             .push(PageDto {
1168:                 name: file.name.clone(),
1169:                 path: file.rel_path.clone(),
1170:                 width,
1171:                 height,
1172:                 size: Some(file.size),
1173:                 modified: Some(file.modified),
1174:                 dimensions_pending,
1175:             });
1176:     }
1177: 
1178:     if grouped_pages.is_empty() {
1179:         return Err("No valid chapters or readable pages found in selection.".to_string());
1180:     }
1181: 
1182:     // 4. Sort chapter names according to sort option
1183:     let sort_cmp = |a: &str, b: &str| -> std::cmp::Ordering {
1184:         match sort_mode.as_str() {
1185:             "name" => a.cmp(b),
1186:             "reverse" => natural_order(b, a),
1187:             _ => natural_order(a, b),
1188:         }
1189:     };
1190: 
1191:     let mut chapter_names: Vec<String> = grouped_pages.keys().cloned().collect();
1192:     chapter_names.sort_by(|a, b| sort_cmp(a, b));
1193: 
1194:     // Sort pages within each chapter
1195:     for pages in grouped_pages.values_mut() {
1196:         pages.sort_by(|a, b| sort_cmp(&a.name, &b.name));
1197:     }
1198: 
1199:     // 5. Dimension extraction for warm chapters (first N chapters, default 5)
1200:     let warm_names: Vec<String> = chapter_names.iter().take(warm_count).cloned().collect();
1201: 
1202:     // Collect pending pages from warm chapters
1203:     let mut pending_warm: Vec<(String, PathBuf)> = Vec::new();
1204:     for name in &warm_names {
1205:         if let Some(pages) = grouped_pages.get(name) {
1206:             for p in pages {
1207:                 if p.dimensions_pending {
1208:                     let abs = root_path.join(p.path.replace('/', std::path::MAIN_SEPARATOR_STR));
1209:                     pending_warm.push((p.path.clone(), abs));
1210:                 }
1211:             }
1212:         }
1213:     }
1214: 
1215:     let total_pending = pending_warm.len();
1216:     if total_pending > 0 {
1217:         if on_progress
1218:             .send(ScanProgress {
1219:                 phase: "index".to_string(),
1220:                 done: 0,
1221:                 total: total_pending,
1222:                 title: format!("{folder_name} · first {warm_count} chapters"),
1223:             })
1224:             .is_err()
1225:         {
1226:             if let Some(ref h) = handle {
1227:                 h.flag.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
1228:             }
1229:             return Err("Indexing cancelled: progress channel disconnected".to_string());
1230:         }
1231: 
1232:         let mut done = 0;
1233:         let mut parsed_results: HashMap<String, (u32, u32)> = HashMap::with_capacity(total_pending);
1234: 
1235:         for chunk in pending_warm.chunks(SCAN_BATCH_SIZE) {
1236:             check_cancelled(handle.as_ref())?;
1237: 
1238:             let chunk_vec = chunk.to_vec();
1239:             let parsed_batch: Vec<(String, Option<u32>, Option<u32>)> =
1240:                 tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
1241:                     chunk_vec
1242:                         .into_par_iter()
1243:                         .map(|(rel, abs)| {
1244:                             let (w, h) = parse_image_dimensions(&abs);
1245:                             (rel, w, h)
1246:                         })
1247:                         .collect()
1248:                 })
1249:                 .await
1250:                 .map_err(|e| format!("Parse join error: {e}"))?;
1251: 
1252:             done += parsed_batch.len();
1253:             for (rel, w, h) in parsed_batch {
1254:                 if let (Some(width), Some(height)) = (w, h) {
1255:                     if width > 0 && height > 0 {
1256:                         parsed_results.insert(rel, (width, height));
1257:                     } else {
1258:                         traversal_issues.push(ScanIssue {
1259:                             path: rel,
1260:                             reason: "Zero or invalid image dimensions in header".to_string(),
1261:                         });
1262:                     }
1263:                 } else {
1264:                     traversal_issues.push(ScanIssue {
1265:                         path: rel,
1266:                         reason: "Could not parse image dimensions from header".to_string(),
1267:                     });
1268:                 }
1269:             }
1270: 
1271:             if on_progress
1272:                 .send(ScanProgress {
1273:                     phase: "index".to_string(),
1274:                     done,
1275:                     total: total_pending,
1276:                     title: format!("{folder_name} · first {warm_count} chapters"),
1277:                 })
1278:                 .is_err()
1279:             {
1280:                 if let Some(ref h) = handle {
1281:                     h.flag.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
1282:                 }
1283:                 return Err("Indexing cancelled: progress channel disconnected".to_string());
1284:             }
1285:             tokio::task::yield_now().await;
1286:         }
1287: 
1288:         // Apply parsed dimensions back to warm chapters
1289:         for name in &warm_names {
1290:             if let Some(pages) = grouped_pages.get_mut(name) {
1291:                 pages.retain_mut(|p| {
1292:                     if !p.dimensions_pending {
1293:                         return true;
1294:                     }
1295:                     if let Some(&(w, h)) = parsed_results.get(&p.path) {
1296:                         p.width = w;
1297:                         p.height = h;
1298:                         p.dimensions_pending = false;
1299:                         true
1300:                     } else {
1301:                         false
1302:                     }
1303:                 });
1304:             }
1305:         }
1306:     }
1307: 
1308:     grouped_pages.retain(|_, pages| !pages.is_empty());
1309:     chapter_names.retain(|name| grouped_pages.contains_key(name));
1310: 
1311:     if chapter_names.is_empty() {
1312:         return Err(if let Some(first_issue) = traversal_issues.first() {
1313:             format!(
1314:                 "No readable pages. {}: {}",
1315:                 first_issue.path, first_issue.reason
1316:             )
1317:         } else {
1318:             "No image pages found in this selection.".to_string()
1319:         });
1320:     }
1321: 
1322:     check_cancelled(handle.as_ref())?;
1323: 
1324:     // 6. Re-link matching and chapters construction
1325:     let mut final_chapters = Vec::with_capacity(chapter_names.len());
1326: 
1327:     for name in chapter_names {
1328:         let pages = grouped_pages.remove(&name).unwrap_or_default();
1329:         let old_match = chapter_match(&name, &pages, previous_manga.as_ref());
1330: 
1331:         let (read, position, bookmarks) = if let Some(old) = old_match {
1332:             let old_names: HashSet<&str> = old.pages.iter().map(|p| p.name.as_str()).collect();
1333:             let read = old.read.unwrap_or(false)
1334:                 && pages.iter().all(|p| old_names.contains(p.name.as_str()));
1335: 
1336:             let position = old
1337:                 .position
1338:                 .as_ref()
1339:                 .and_then(|pos| matching_position(pos, &pages, &old.pages));
1340: 
1341:             let bookmarks = old
1342:                 .bookmarks
1343:                 .as_ref()
1344:                 .map(|bms| {
1345:                     bms.iter()
1346:                         .filter_map(|bm| matching_position(bm, &pages, &old.pages))
1347:                         .collect()
1348:                 })
1349:                 .unwrap_or_default();
1350: 
1351:             (read, position, bookmarks)
1352:         } else {
1353:             (false, None, Vec::new())
1354:         };
1355: 
1356:         final_chapters.push(ChapterDto {
1357:             name,
1358:             pages,
1359:             read,
1360:             position,
1361:             bookmarks,
1362:         });
1363:     }
1364: 
1365:     // 7. Cover identification, thumbnail generation, and SQLite commit off the async thread
1366:     let first_page_abs = final_chapters
1367:         .first()
1368:         .and_then(|c| c.pages.first())
1369:         .map(|p| root_path.join(p.path.replace('/', std::path::MAIN_SEPARATOR_STR)));
1370: 
1371:     let cover_abs = cover_candidate.or(first_page_abs);
1372: 
1373:     let title_name = opts
1374:         .title
1375:         .as_ref()
1376:         .map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
1377:         .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
1378:         .or_else(|| previous_manga.as_ref().map(|p| p.title.clone()))
1379:         .unwrap_or_else(|| folder_name.clone());
1380: 
1381:     let manga_id = previous_manga
1382:         .as_ref()
1383:         .map(|p| p.id.clone())
1384:         .unwrap_or_else(|| uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string());
1385: 
1386:     let base_slug = generate_slug(&title_name);
1387:     let preserve_prev_slug = previous_manga.as_ref().and_then(|prev| {
1388:         if opts.title.as_deref().map(|t| t.trim()) == Some(prev.title.as_str())
1389:             || opts.title.is_none()
1390:         {
1391:             prev.slug.clone()
1392:         } else {
1393:             None
1394:         }
1395:     });
1396: 
1397:     let now = SystemTime::now()
1398:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1399:         .unwrap_or_default()
1400:         .as_millis() as f64;
1401: 
1402:     let added_at = previous_manga
1403:         .as_ref()
1404:         .and_then(|p| p.added_at)
1405:         .unwrap_or(now);
1406: 
1407:     let revision = previous_manga
1408:         .as_ref()
1409:         .and_then(|p| p.revision)
1410:         .map(|r| r + 1)
1411:         .unwrap_or(1);
1412: 
1413:     let last_chapter = previous_manga
1414:         .as_ref()
1415:         .and_then(|p| p.last_chapter)
1416:         .unwrap_or(0)
1417:         .min(final_chapters.len().saturating_sub(1));
1418: 
1419:     let final_cover_path = cover_abs
1420:         .as_ref()
1421:         .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string());
1422: 
1423:     let chapter_count = final_chapters.len();
1424:     let page_count = final_chapters.iter().map(|c| c.pages.len()).sum();
1425:     let has_pending = final_chapters
1426:         .iter()
1427:         .any(|c| c.pages.iter().any(|p| p.dimensions_pending));
1428: 
1429:     let app_for_commit = app.clone();
1430:     let manga_id_for_commit = manga_id.clone();
1431:     let title_for_commit = title_name.clone();
1432:     let root_str_for_commit = root_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
1433:     let sort_for_commit = sort_mode.clone();
1434:     let chapters_for_commit = final_chapters.clone();
1435: 
1436:     let slug = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<String, String> {
1437:         let resolved_slug = if let Some(existing_slug) = preserve_prev_slug {
1438:             existing_slug
1439:         } else if let Some(db_state) = app_for_commit.try_state::<crate::db::DbState>() {
1440:             db_state.allocate_unique_slug_sync(&base_slug, &manga_id_for_commit)
1441:         } else {
1442:             base_slug
1443:         };
1444: 
1445:         if let Some(ref cover_file) = cover_abs {
1446:             let _ = crate::commands::image::generate_thumbnail_direct(
1447:                 &app_for_commit,
1448:                 cover_file,
1449:                 &manga_id_for_commit,
1450:             );
1451:         }
1452: 
1453:         if let Some(db_state) = app_for_commit.try_state::<crate::db::DbState>() {
1454:             let rec = crate::db::MangaRecord {
1455:                 id: manga_id_for_commit,
1456:                 slug: Some(resolved_slug.clone()),
1457:                 title: title_for_commit,
1458:                 local_path: Some(root_str_for_commit),
1459:                 last_chapter,
1460:                 added_at,
1461:                 updated_at: now,
1462:                 revision: Some(revision),
1463:                 sort: Some(sort_for_commit),
1464:                 chapters: chapters_for_commit
1465:                     .iter()
1466:                     .map(|c| crate::db::ChapterRecord {
1467:                         id: None,
1468:                         name: c.name.clone(),
1469:                         pages: c
1470:                             .pages
1471:                             .iter()
1472:                             .map(|p| crate::db::PageRecord {
1473:                                 name: p.name.clone(),
1474:                                 path: p.path.clone(),
1475:                                 width: p.width,
1476:                                 height: p.height,
1477:                                 size: p.size,
1478:                                 modified: p.modified,
1479:                                 dimensions_pending: Some(p.dimensions_pending),
1480:                             })
1481:                             .collect(),
1482:                         read: c.read,
1483:                         position: c.position.as_ref().map(|p| crate::db::PositionRecord {
1484:                             page: p.page as u32,
1485:                             path: p.path.clone(),
1486:                             fraction: p.fraction.unwrap_or(0.0),
1487:                             manga_bookmark: p.manga_bookmark,
1488:                             timestamp: p.timestamp,
1489:                         }),
1490:                         bookmarks: Some(
1491:                             c.bookmarks
1492:                                 .iter()
1493:                                 .map(|b| crate::db::PositionRecord {
1494:                                     page: b.page as u32,
1495:                                     path: b.path.clone(),
1496:                                     fraction: b.fraction.unwrap_or(0.0),
1497:                                     manga_bookmark: b.manga_bookmark,
1498:                                     timestamp: b.timestamp,
1499:                                 })
1500:                                 .collect(),
1501:                         ),
1502:                     })
1503:                     .collect(),
1504:             };
1505:             db_state
1506:                 .save_manga_sync(&rec)
1507:                 .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to save indexed manga to database: {e}"))?;
1508:         }
1509: 
1510:         Ok(resolved_slug)
1511:     })
1512:     .await
1513:     .map_err(|e| format!("Commit task join error: {e}"))??;
1514: 
1515:     Ok(TitleDto {
1516:         id: manga_id,
1517:         title: title_name,
1518:         slug,
1519:         local_path: root_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1520:         last_chapter,
1521:         added_at,
1522:         updated_at: now,
1523:         revision,
1524:         sort: sort_mode,
1525:         chapter_count,
1526:         page_count,
1527:         has_pending_dimensions: has_pending,
1528:         chapters: final_chapters,
1529:         cover_path: final_cover_path,
1530:         issues: traversal_issues,
1531:         reused: reused_count,
1532:     })
1533: }

1535: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
1536: #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
1537: pub struct PrepareChapterDto {
1538:     pub pages: Vec<PageDto>,
1539:     pub updated: bool,
1540:     pub updated_at: f64,
1541:     pub revision: u64,
1542:     pub issues: Vec<ScanIssue>,
1543: }
1544: 
1545: pub async fn prepare_chapter_core(
1546:     app: &AppHandle,
1547:     manga_id: &str,
1548:     chapter_index: usize,
1549:     job_id: Option<&str>,
1550:     on_progress: Option<&tauri::ipc::Channel<ScanProgress>>,
1551:     external_cancel: Option<Arc<AtomicBool>>,
1552: ) -> Result<PrepareChapterDto, String> {
1553:     let scan_mgr = app.state::<crate::commands::fs::ScanManager>();
1554:     let handle = job_id.map(|id| scan_mgr.register(id));
1555: 
1556:     struct JobGuard<'a> {
1557:         mgr: &'a crate::commands::fs::ScanManager,
1558:         id: Option<&'a str>,
1559:     }
1560:     impl<'a> Drop for JobGuard<'a> {
1561:         fn drop(&mut self) {
1562:             if let Some(id) = self.id {
1563:                 self.mgr.unregister(id);
1564:             }
1565:         }
1566:     }
1567:     let _guard = JobGuard {
1568:         mgr: &scan_mgr,
1569:         id: job_id,
1570:     };
1571: 
1572:     let check_cancelled = |handle: Option<&crate::commands::fs::ScanHandle>,
1573:                            ext: Option<&Arc<AtomicBool>>|
1574:      -> Result<(), String> {
1575:         if let Some(h) = handle {
1576:             if h.flag.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) || *h.receiver.borrow() {
1577:                 return Err("Indexing cancelled".to_string());
1578:             }
1579:         }
1580:         if let Some(flag) = ext {
1581:             if flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
1582:                 return Err("Indexing cancelled".to_string());
1583:             }
1584:         }
1585:         Ok(())
1586:     };
1587: 
1588:     check_cancelled(handle.as_ref(), external_cancel.as_ref())?;
1589: 
1590:     let db_state = app
1591:         .try_state::<crate::db::DbState>()
1592:         .ok_or_else(|| "Database state not initialized".to_string())?;
1593: 
1594:     let id_clone = manga_id.to_string();
1595:     let mut manga = db_state
1596:         .read(move |conn| crate::db::get_manga(conn, &id_clone))
1597:         .await
1598:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to read manga: {e}"))?
1599:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("Manga '{manga_id}' not found"))?;
1600: 
1601:     let local_path_str = manga
1602:         .local_path
1603:         .clone()
1604:         .ok_or_else(|| "Desktop manga is missing localPath".to_string())?;
1605: 
1606:     let root_path = dunce::canonicalize(Path::new(local_path_str.trim()))
1607:         .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to resolve manga root path: {e}"))?;
1608: 
1609:     let allowed = app.state::<AllowedRoots>();
1610:     if !allowed.is_allowed(&root_path) {
1611:         return Err(format!(
1612:             "Path '{}' is not under an allowed library root",
1613:             root_path.display()
1614:         ));
1615:     }
1616: 
1617:     if chapter_index >= manga.chapters.len() {
1618:         return Ok(PrepareChapterDto {
1619:             pages: Vec::new(),
1620:             updated: false,
1621:             updated_at: manga.updated_at,
1622:             revision: manga.revision.unwrap_or(1),
1623:             issues: Vec::new(),
1624:         });
1625:     }
1626: 
1627:     let title_name = manga.title.clone();
1628:     let pending_items: Vec<(usize, String)> = manga.chapters[chapter_index]
1629:         .pages
1630:         .iter()
1631:         .enumerate()
1632:         .filter(|(_, p)| p.dimensions_pending.unwrap_or(false) || p.width == 0 || p.height == 0)
1633:         .map(|(idx, p)| (idx, p.path.clone()))
1634:         .collect();
1635: 
1636:     let total_pending = pending_items.len();
1637:     let mut issues = Vec::new();
1638:     let mut updated = false;
1639: 
1640:     if total_pending > 0 {
1641:         let mut done = 0;
1642:         type PendingBatchResult = (usize, String, Result<(u32, u32, u64, f64), String>);
1643:         for chunk in pending_items.chunks(SCAN_BATCH_SIZE) {
1644:             check_cancelled(handle.as_ref(), external_cancel.as_ref())?;
1645: 
1646:             let chunk_vec = chunk.to_vec();
1647:             let base = root_path.clone();
1648:             let batch_results: Vec<PendingBatchResult> =
1649:                 tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
1650:                     chunk_vec
1651:                         .into_par_iter()
1652:                         .map(|(idx, rel_path)| {
1653:                             let resolved = match crate::commands::fs::resolve_relative_path(
1654:                                 &base, &rel_path,
1655:                             ) {
1656:                                 Ok(p) => p,
1657:                                 Err(e) => return (idx, rel_path, Err(e.to_string())),
1658:                             };
1659:                             let meta = match std::fs::metadata(&resolved) {
1660:                                 Ok(m) if m.is_file() && m.len() > 0 => m,
1661:                                 Ok(_) => return (idx, rel_path, Err("Empty file.".to_string())),
1662:                                 Err(e) => return (idx, rel_path, Err(e.to_string())),
1663:                             };
1664:                             let modified = meta
1665:                                 .modified()
1666:                                 .ok()
1667:                                 .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
1668:                                 .map(|d| d.as_millis() as f64)
1669:                                 .unwrap_or(0.0);
1670:                             match parse_image_dimensions(&resolved) {
1671:                                 (Some(w), Some(h)) if w > 0 && h > 0 => {
1672:                                     (idx, rel_path, Ok((w, h, meta.len(), modified)))
1673:                                 }
1674:                                 _ => (
1675:                                     idx,
1676:                                     rel_path,
1677:                                     Err("Corrupt image or unreadable header.".to_string()),
1678:                                 ),
1679:                             }
1680:                         })
1681:                         .collect()
1682:                 })
1683:                 .await
1684:                 .map_err(|e| format!("Prepare task join error: {e}"))?;
1685: 
1686:             for (idx, rel_path, res) in batch_results {
1687:                 done += 1;
1688:                 match res {
1689:                     Ok((w, h, size, modified)) => {
1690:                         if let Some(page) = manga.chapters[chapter_index].pages.get_mut(idx) {
1691:                             page.width = w;
1692:                             page.height = h;
1693:                             page.size = Some(size);
1694:                             page.modified = Some(modified);
1695:                             page.dimensions_pending = Some(false);
1696:                             updated = true;
1697:                         }
1698:                     }
1699:                     Err(reason) => {
1700:                         issues.push(ScanIssue {
1701:                             path: rel_path,
1702:                             reason,
1703:                         });
1704:                     }
1705:                 }
1706:             }
1707: 
1708:             if let Some(ch) = on_progress {
1709:                 let _ = ch.send(ScanProgress {
1710:                     phase: "index".to_string(),
1711:                     done,
1712:                     total: total_pending,
1713:                     title: title_name.clone(),
1714:                 });
1715:             }
1716: 
1717:             tokio::task::yield_now().await;
1718:         }
1719:     }
1720: 
1721:     check_cancelled(handle.as_ref(), external_cancel.as_ref())?;
1722: 
1723:     if updated {
1724:         let now = SystemTime::now()
1725:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1726:             .unwrap_or_default()
1727:             .as_millis() as f64;
1728:         manga.updated_at = now;
1729:         manga.revision = Some(manga.revision.unwrap_or(1) + 1);
1730: 
1731:         let manga_to_save = manga.clone();
1732:         db_state
1733:             .write(move |conn| crate::db::save_manga(conn, &manga_to_save))
1734:             .await
1735:             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to save prepared chapter: {e}"))?;
1736:     }
1737: 
1738:     let pages = manga.chapters[chapter_index]
1739:         .pages
1740:         .iter()
1741:         .map(|p| PageDto {
1742:             name: p.name.clone(),
1743:             path: p.path.clone(),
1744:             width: p.width,
1745:             height: p.height,
1746:             size: p.size,
1747:             modified: p.modified,
1748:             dimensions_pending: p.dimensions_pending.unwrap_or(false),
1749:         })
1750:         .collect();
1751: 
1752:     Ok(PrepareChapterDto {
1753:         pages,
1754:         updated,
1755:         updated_at: manga.updated_at,
1756:         revision: manga.revision.unwrap_or(1),
1757:         issues,
1758:     })
1759: }
1760: 
1761: #[tauri::command]
1762: pub async fn prepare_chapter(
1763:     app: AppHandle,
1764:     manga_id: String,
1765:     chapter_index: usize,
1766:     job_id: Option<String>,
1767:     on_progress: tauri::ipc::Channel<ScanProgress>,
1768: ) -> Result<PrepareChapterDto, String> {
1769:     prepare_chapter_core(
1770:         &app,
1771:         &manga_id,
1772:         chapter_index,
1773:         job_id.as_deref(),
1774:         Some(&on_progress),
1775:         None,
1776:     )
1777:     .await
1778: }

1780: #[cfg(test)]
1781: mod tests {
1782:     use super::*;
1783: 
1784:     #[test]
1785:     fn test_generate_slug() {
1786:         assert_eq!(generate_slug("One Piece (Digital)"), "one-piece-digital");
1787:         assert_eq!(
1788:             generate_slug("Attack on Titan: Vol 1"),
1789:             "attack-on-titan-vol-1"
1790:         );
1791:         assert_eq!(generate_slug("   "), "manga");

1966:     #[test]
1967:     fn test_indexing_grouping_logic() {
1968:         fn determine_chapter(rel_path: &str, is_cover: bool) -> Option<String> {
1969:             if is_cover {
1970:                 return None;
1971:             }
1972:             if let Some(idx) = rel_path.rfind('/') {
1973:                 let dir_part = &rel_path[..idx];
1974:                 let chapter_name = dir_part.replace('/', " / ");
1975:                 Some(chapter_name)
1976:             } else {
1977:                 Some("Root pages".to_string())
1978:             }
1979:         }
1980: 
1981:         // Subdirectory becomes chapter name with slash normalization
1982:         assert_eq!(
1983:             determine_chapter("Chapter 1/01.jpg", false),
1984:             Some("Chapter 1".into())
1985:         );
1986:         assert_eq!(
1987:             determine_chapter("Volume 1/Chapter 1/01.jpg", false),
1988:             Some("Volume 1 / Chapter 1".into())
1989:         );
1990: 
1991:         // Root file becomes "Root pages"
1992:         assert_eq!(
1993:             determine_chapter("01.jpg", false),
1994:             Some("Root pages".into())
1995:         );
1996: 
1997:         // Cover file excluded from regular chapters
1998:         assert_eq!(determine_chapter("cover.jpg", true), None);
1999:         assert_eq!(determine_chapter("thumbnail.png", true), None);
2000:     }

16: #[tauri::command(async)]
17: pub fn set_progress_bar(window: WebviewWindow, progress: f64) -> Result<(), String> {
18:     let state = if progress < 0.0 {
19:         ProgressBarState {
20:             progress: None,
21:             status: Some(ProgressBarStatus::None),
22:         }
23:     } else if progress > 1.0 {
24:         ProgressBarState {
25:             progress: None,
26:             status: Some(ProgressBarStatus::Indeterminate),
27:         }
28:     } else {
29:         let percent = (progress * 100.0).round().clamp(0.0, 100.0) as u64;
30:         ProgressBarState {
31:             progress: Some(percent),
32:             status: Some(ProgressBarStatus::Normal),
33:         }
34:     };
35: 
36:     let _ = window.set_progress_bar(state);
37:     Ok(())

49: pub fn restore_backup_tx(
50:     conn: &mut Connection,
51:     payload: &crate::validation::BackupPayload,
52: ) -> DbResult<serde_json::Value> {
53:     let tx = conn.transaction()?;
54: 
55:     // Load existing local_path and slug for preservation
56:     let mut existing_info: std::collections::HashMap<String, (Option<String>, String)> =
57:         std::collections::HashMap::new();
58:     {
59:         let mut stmt = tx.prepare("SELECT id, local_path, slug FROM manga")?;
60:         let rows = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
61:             Ok((
62:                 row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
63:                 row.get::<_, Option<String>>(1)?,
64:                 row.get::<_, String>(2)?,
65:             ))
66:         })?;
67:         for (id, local_path, slug) in rows.flatten() {
68:             existing_info.insert(id, (local_path, slug));
69:         }
70:     }
71: 
72:     for valid_m in &payload.manga {
73:         let mut m_rec = MangaRecord::from(valid_m.clone());
74:         if let Some((existing_path, existing_slug)) = existing_info.get(&m_rec.id) {
75:             if m_rec.local_path.is_none() && existing_path.is_some() {
76:                 m_rec.local_path = existing_path.clone();
77:             }
78:             if m_rec.slug.is_none() {
79:                 m_rec.slug = Some(existing_slug.clone());
80:             }
81:         }
82:         insert_or_replace_manga(&tx, &m_rec)?;
83:     }
84: 
85:     let norm_settings = crate::validation::normalize_settings(&payload.settings);
86:     let settings_str = serde_json::to_string(&norm_settings)?;
87:     tx.execute(
88:         "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('global', ?1)",
89:         rusqlite::params![settings_str],
90:     )?;
91: 
92:     tx.execute(
93:         "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO settings (key, value) VALUES ('migrated', '1')",
94:         rusqlite::params![],
95:     )?;
96: 
97:     tx.commit()?;
98: 
99:     Ok(norm_settings)
100: }

22:     Conflict(String),
23: 
24:     #[error("Task execution error: {0}")]
25:     Task(String),
26: 
27:     #[error("IO error: {0}")]
28:     Io(String),
29: 
30:     #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
31:     Serialization(String),

45: /// Generates a stable chapter ID resilient to renames and reordering.
46: pub fn derive_chapter_id(manga_id: &str, chapter: &ChapterRecord, chapter_idx: usize) -> String {
47:     if let Some(ref id) = chapter.id {
48:         let trimmed = id.trim();
49:         if !trimmed.is_empty() {
50:             return trimmed.to_string();
51:         }
52:     }
53:     if let Some(first_page) = chapter.pages.first() {
54:         if let Some(parent) = std::path::Path::new(&first_page.path).parent() {
55:             let parent_str = parent.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
56:             if !parent_str.is_empty() && parent_str != "." {
57:                 return format!("{}:{}", manga_id, parent_str);
58:             }
59:         }
60:         return format!("{}:p:{}", manga_id, first_page.path);
61:     }
62:     let slug: String = chapter
63:         .name
64:         .chars()
65:         .map(|c| {
66:             if c.is_alphanumeric() {
67:                 c.to_ascii_lowercase()
68:             } else {
69:                 '-'
70:             }
71:         })
72:         .collect();
73:     format!("{}:{}:{}", manga_id, chapter_idx, slug.trim_matches('-'))
74: }

220: pub fn save_progress(
221:     conn: &mut Connection,
222:     manga_id: &str,
223:     chapter_index: usize,
224:     position: &PositionRecord,
225:     read: bool,
226:     bookmarks: Option<&[PositionRecord]>,
227:     update_last: bool,
228:     expected_revision: Option<u64>,
229:     expected_updated_at: Option<f64>,
230: ) -> DbResult<String> {
231:     let tx = conn.transaction()?;
232: 
233:     let manga_info: Option<(f64, i64)> = tx
234:         .query_row(
235:             "SELECT updated_at, revision FROM manga WHERE id = ?1",
236:             params![manga_id],
237:             |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)),
238:         )
239:         .optional()?;
240: 
241:     let (cur_updated_at, cur_revision) = match manga_info {
242:         Some(t) => t,
243:         None => {
244:             tx.rollback()?;
245:             return Ok("missing".to_string());
246:         }
247:     };
248: 
249:     if let Some(exp_rev) = expected_revision {
250:         if exp_rev != cur_revision as u64 {
251:             tx.rollback()?;
252:             return Ok("stale".to_string());
253:         }
254:     } else if let Some(exp_up) = expected_updated_at {
255:         if (exp_up - cur_updated_at).abs() > 0.001 {
256:             tx.rollback()?;
257:             return Ok("stale".to_string());
258:         }
259:     }
260: 
261:     let chapter_info: Option<(String, String)> = tx
262:         .query_row(
263:             "SELECT chapter_id, name FROM chapters WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND chapter_idx = ?2",
264:             params![manga_id, chapter_index as i64],
265:             |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)),
266:         )
267:         .optional()?;
268: 
269:     let (ch_id, ch_name) = match chapter_info {
270:         Some(t) => t,
271:         None => {
272:             tx.rollback()?;
273:             return Ok("missing".to_string());
274:         }
275:     };
276: 
277:     let existing_read: Option<i64> = tx
278:         .query_row(
279:             "SELECT read FROM progress WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3)",
280:             params![manga_id, ch_id, ch_name],
281:             |row| row.get(0),
282:         )
283:         .optional()?;
284: 
285:     let is_read = if read || existing_read == Some(1) {
286:         1
287:     } else {
288:         0
289:     };
290:     let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
291:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
292:         .unwrap_or_default()
293:         .as_millis() as f64;
294: 
295:     tx.execute(
296:         r#"
297:         INSERT INTO progress (manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, read, page, path, fraction, updated_at)
298:         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)
299:         ON CONFLICT(manga_id, chapter_id) DO UPDATE SET
300:             chapter_name = excluded.chapter_name,
301:             read = excluded.read,
302:             page = excluded.page,
303:             path = excluded.path,
304:             fraction = excluded.fraction,
305:             updated_at = excluded.updated_at
306:         "#,
307:         params![
308:             manga_id,
309:             ch_id,
310:             ch_name,
311:             is_read,
312:             position.page as i64,
313:             position.path,
314:             position.fraction,
315:             now,
316:         ],
317:     )?;
318: 
319:     if let Some(bms) = bookmarks {
320:         tx.execute(
321:             "DELETE FROM bookmarks WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3)",
322:             params![manga_id, ch_id, ch_name],
323:         )?;
324:         for bm in bms {
325:             let is_manga_bm = if bm.manga_bookmark.unwrap_or(false) {
326:                 1
327:             } else {
328:                 0
329:             };
330:             tx.execute(
331:                 r#"
332:                 INSERT INTO bookmarks (manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, page, path, fraction, manga_bookmark, timestamp)
333:                 VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)
334:                 "#,
335:                 params![
336:                     manga_id,
337:                     ch_id,
338:                     ch_name,
339:                     bm.page as i64,
340:                     bm.path,
341:                     bm.fraction,
342:                     is_manga_bm,
343:                     bm.timestamp.unwrap_or(now),
344:                 ],
345:             )?;
346:         }
347:     }
348: 
349:     if update_last {
350:         tx.execute(
351:             "UPDATE manga SET last_chapter = ?1, updated_at = ?2 WHERE id = ?3",
352:             params![chapter_index as i64, now, manga_id],
353:         )?;
354:     }
355: 
356:     tx.commit()?;
357:     Ok("saved".to_string())
358: }

360: pub fn add_bookmark(
361:     conn: &mut Connection,
362:     manga_id: &str,
363:     chapter_name: &str,
364:     position: &PositionRecord,
365: ) -> DbResult<Vec<PositionRecord>> {
366:     let tx = conn.transaction()?;
367:     let is_manga_bm = if position.manga_bookmark.unwrap_or(false) {
368:         1
369:     } else {
370:         0
371:     };
372: 
373:     let chapter_id: String = tx
374:         .query_row(
375:             "SELECT chapter_id FROM chapters WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (name = ?2 OR chapter_id = ?2) LIMIT 1",
376:             params![manga_id, chapter_name],
377:             |row| row.get(0),
378:         )
379:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| chapter_name.to_string());
380: 
381:     let exists: bool = if is_manga_bm == 1 {
382:         tx.query_row(
383:             "SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3) AND manga_bookmark = 1 LIMIT 1",
384:             params![manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name],
385:             |_| Ok(true),
386:         )
387:         .unwrap_or(false)
388:     } else if let Some(path) = &position.path {
389:         tx.query_row(
390:             "SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3) AND path = ?4 AND manga_bookmark = 0 LIMIT 1",
391:             params![manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, path],
392:             |_| Ok(true),
393:         )
394:         .unwrap_or(false)
395:     } else {
396:         tx.query_row(
397:             "SELECT 1 FROM bookmarks WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3) AND page = ?4 AND manga_bookmark = 0 LIMIT 1",
398:             params![manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, position.page as i64],
399:             |_| Ok(true),
400:         )
401:         .unwrap_or(false)
402:     };
403: 
404:     if !exists {
405:         let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
406:             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
407:             .unwrap_or_default()
408:             .as_millis() as f64;
409: 
410:         tx.execute(
411:             r#"
412:             INSERT INTO bookmarks (manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, page, path, fraction, manga_bookmark, timestamp)
413:             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8)
414:             "#,
415:             params![
416:                 manga_id,
417:                 chapter_id,
418:                 chapter_name,
419:                 position.page as i64,
420:                 position.path,
421:                 position.fraction,
422:                 is_manga_bm,
423:                 position.timestamp.unwrap_or(now),
424:             ],
425:         )?;
426:     }
427: 
428:     let mut result = Vec::new();
429:     {
430:         let mut stmt = tx.prepare(
431:             "SELECT page, path, fraction, manga_bookmark, timestamp FROM bookmarks WHERE manga_id = ?1 AND (chapter_id = ?2 OR chapter_name = ?3) ORDER BY id ASC",
432:         )?;
433:         let rows = stmt.query_map(params![manga_id, chapter_id, chapter_name], |row| {
434:             let is_mb: i64 = row.get(3)?;

436:                 page: row.get::<_, i64>(0)? as u32,
437:                 path: row.get(1)?,
438:                 fraction: row.get(2)?,

440:                 timestamp: Some(row.get(4)?),
441:             })
442:         })?;
443: 
444:         for r in rows {
445:             result.push(r?);
446:         }
447:     }
448:     tx.commit()?;

539: pub fn query_bookmark_cards(
540:     conn: &Connection,
541:     query: &BookmarkCardsQuery,
542: ) -> DbResult<BookmarkCardsResult> {
543:     let where_clause = match query.tab.as_deref() {
544:         Some("manga") => " WHERE b.manga_bookmark = 1",
545:         Some("individual") => " WHERE b.manga_bookmark = 0",
546:         _ => "",
547:     };
548: 
549:     let count_sql = format!(
550:         "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookmarks b JOIN manga m ON b.manga_id = m.id{}",
551:         where_clause
552:     );
553:     let total: usize = conn
554:         .query_row(&count_sql, [], |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0))
555:         .map(|c| c as usize)?;
556: 
557:     let sort_clause = match query.sort.as_deref() {
558:         Some("newest") => "ORDER BY b.timestamp DESC, b.id DESC",
559:         Some("oldest") => "ORDER BY b.timestamp ASC, b.id ASC",
560:         Some("title-asc") => {
561:             "ORDER BY m.title COLLATE NOCASE ASC, c.chapter_idx ASC, b.page ASC, b.id ASC"
562:         }
563:         Some("title-desc") => {
564:             "ORDER BY m.title COLLATE NOCASE DESC, c.chapter_idx ASC, b.page ASC, b.id ASC"
565:         }
566:         Some("chapter") => {
567:             "ORDER BY m.title COLLATE NOCASE ASC, c.chapter_idx ASC, b.page ASC, b.id ASC"
568:         }
569:         _ => "ORDER BY b.timestamp DESC, b.id DESC",
570:     };
571: 
572:     let mut select_sql = format!(
573:         "SELECT
574:             b.manga_id,
575:             m.title,
576:             m.slug,
577:             m.local_path,
578:             m.updated_at,
579:             COALESCE(c.chapter_idx, 0),
580:             b.chapter_name,
581:             b.page,
582:             COALESCE(b.path, p.path) AS page_path,
583:             b.fraction,
584:             b.manga_bookmark,
585:             b.timestamp
586:         FROM bookmarks b
587:         JOIN manga m ON b.manga_id = m.id
588:         LEFT JOIN chapters c ON b.manga_id = c.manga_id AND b.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
589:         LEFT JOIN pages p ON b.manga_id = p.manga_id AND c.chapter_id = p.chapter_id AND b.page = p.idx
590:         {}
591:         {}",
592:         where_clause,
593:         sort_clause
594:     );
595: 
596:     if let Some(limit) = query.limit {
597:         let offset = query.offset.unwrap_or(0);
598:         select_sql.push_str(&format!(" LIMIT {} OFFSET {}", limit, offset));
599:     }
600: 
601:     let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&select_sql)?;
602:     let rows = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
603:         Ok(BookmarkCardDto {
604:             manga_id: row.get(0)?,
605:             manga_title: row.get(1)?,
606:             manga_slug: row.get(2)?,
607:             local_path: row.get(3)?,
608:             updated_at: row.get(4)?,
609:             chapter_idx: row.get::<_, i64>(5)? as usize,
610:             chapter_name: row.get(6)?,
611:             page: row.get::<_, i64>(7)? as usize,
612:             page_path: row.get(8)?,
613:             fraction: row.get(9)?,
614:             manga_bookmark: row.get::<_, i64>(10)? == 1,
615:             timestamp: row.get(11)?,
616:         })
617:     })?;
618: 
619:     let mut cards = Vec::new();
620:     for r in rows {
621:         cards.push(r?);
622:     }
623: 
624:     Ok(BookmarkCardsResult { cards, total })
625: }
